jobs.title: Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
• Design and implement features for PracticeMatch products that drive impact for the business and its customers.
• Contribute to the design of software systems, and review the code of other engineers.
• Apply software engineering best practices, including automated testing, clean code, peer review, and documentation, to build maintainable and adaptable applications.
• Improve the performance, security, and compliance of PracticeMatch products.
• Contribute to the repository context, conventions, automated tests, quality gates, and executable plans that make agentic coding reliable.
• Find repetitive or time-intensive engineering work that can move to AI-assisted or automated workflows, keeping human review where it protects quality, accuracy, and compliance.
• Troubleshoot production web applications and help fix the causes of system problems.
• Work with people inside and outside engineering to meet team and company objectives.
• Contribute to projects that benefit M3 USA as a whole, collaborating across business units beyond your own team when the company needs it.

• Associate or bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience in software engineering.
• 2+ years of professional software development experience.
• Able to review code in Python and TypeScript.
• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical people.
• Knowledge of ColdFusion and SQL Server, including stored procedures and relational database design, plus React and version control with Git, preferred,
• Knowledge of the physician recruiting and sourcing domain, with a commitment to deepening it, preferred.

Company Emphasis on Agentic AI:

M3 USA's engineering organization is committed to using agentic AI across the full engineering lifecycle, from planning and development through testing, deployment, and production operation. Engineers in this role use agentic coding with tools such as Claude Code and Codex, and apply generative AI to building systems, as a standard part of daily work. This includes reviewing what these tools produce: engineers are accountable for the correctness, quality, and security of AI-generated plans and code, and for curating the documentation and repository context that keep the tools effective over time. Active, daily use of agentic coding is a core expectation of the role.

Benefits:

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

• Health and Dental
• Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
• Prescription Plan

jobs.title: Sr. Account Executive, Large Customer, Marketing Solutions
jobs.description:
The role is open to Washington D.C or New York City.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive to join our Marketing Solutions team and play a pivotal role in driving LinkedIn’s position as the premier platform for connecting with the world’s professionals. In this highly strategic enterprise role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to your customers within the Government and Education vertical, owning executive relationships, influencing marketing and media strategy, and driving long-term business growth. As a Senior Account Executive, you will take a consultative, account-based approach to deeply understand your customers' business objectives and architect integrated LinkedIn strategies across marketing organizations and agency partners. You will focus on expanding into new buying centers, while partnering closely with your Client Solutions Manager to accelerate growth within existing programs. Success in this role is driven by your ability to build multi-threaded relationships, uncover enterprise-level opportunities, and position LinkedIn as a core strategic partner.

Internally, we seek a collaborative leader who contributes to a high-performance team culture, brings strategic rigor to the business, and elevates the broader organization through partnership and knowledge sharing.

Responsibilities:

• Build and deepen executive relationships (VP–CMO level) across client and agency teams
• Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned to customer business priorities
• Identify and unlock new buying groups to expand LinkedIn’s footprint
• Lead consultative conversations that position LinkedIn as a core part of marketing and media strategy
• Drive multi-threaded engagement across marketing, demand gen, brand, and agency stakeholders
• Partner cross-functionally to deliver integrated, outcome-driven solutions
• Own the full sales cycle including pipeline development, deal strategy, and accurate forecasting
• Deliver compelling executive narratives and proposals tied to business impact
• Consistently meet and exceed revenue targets
• Contribute to a collaborative, high-performance team culture
• Travel requirements: approximately 20% for client meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

Basic Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
• 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, media and/or business development
• 2+ years of media sales or digital media account management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in both B2B and B2C selling
• Ability to develop authentic, senior-level relationships
• Experience preparing sales proposals, forecasts and account planning
• Ability to demonstrate an understanding of advertising technology and marketing automation
• Ability to achieve results by understanding the needs of the customer and connecting a customer’s pressures with business and product solutions
• Ability to story tell with insights and data, applying key learnings to strategic recommendations
• Proven track record of exemplifying leadership behaviors
• Organizational strength, robust planning and sales operational excellence
• Experience in government and education vertical

Suggested Skills:

• Sales Strategy
• Client Relationship Building
• Consultative Selling
• Data-Driven Insights

jobs.title: Sous Chef
jobs.description:
WHAT’S THE JOB?

The Sous Chef is fully responsible for the food service operation at a Dexterra workforce accommodations facility. This role provides strategic and hands‑on leadership across all culinary functions, ensuring food safety, quality, consistency, and client satisfaction at scale.

The operation will initially serve approximately 500 people per day and is expected to grow rapidly to more than 4,000 meals served daily.

The Sous Chef is responsible for leading and developing a high‑performing culinary team capable of delivering consistent, high‑quality food service throughout this growth.

Reporting to the Executive Chef, the Sous Chef participates in menu planning, procurement, food production, staffing, training, and compliance, while maintaining strict adherence to Dexterra food safety standards, contractual scope, and quality expectations.

YOUR WORK WILL INCLUDE

• Responsible for leadership within all food service operations
• Preparing, presenting, designing, and serving high‑quality rotational menus at scale
• Leading the kitchen operation to safely and efficiently service 500+ guests daily, with rapid growth to 4,000+ guests per day
• Ensuring strict adherence to food safety, quality, and contractual scope requirements
• Enforcing compliance with Dexterra Food Safety programs, including FOODSAFE Handling and ASNI requirements
• Leading, training, developing, and mentoring the entire culinary team
• Supervising kitchen staff productivity, performance, and compliance with policies and procedures
• Managing labor, food, and chemical resources to ensure efficiency and cost control
• Overseeing ordering, inventory control, and bi‑weekly inventory counts
• Applying expertise in dietary requirements including allergies, vegan, vegetarian, and special diets
• Maintaining high standards of cleanliness, organization, and professionalism
• Serving clients and guests in a personable, professional, and service‑oriented manner
• Supporting the Executive Chef with culinary input related to planning, forecasting, and operational execution

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

• Collaboration with experienced operations and service delivery teams.
• A remote work location where living accommodations and meals are provided
• A team focused on safety, service quality, and operational execution.
• Whereas other companies are downsizing, we are growing!
• Comprehensive U.S. health and welfare benefits are available through employee-paid or employee-contributory plans, with enrollment options based on individual and family coverage needs
• 401K Plan – Offered with automatic Enrollment and discretionary Company matching contribution

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

• Culinary professional, with culinary education and/or Chef designation
• Authorized to work in the United States
• Valid Food Handler Card through an ASNI-accredited Provider
• Minimum 5 years of experience in the hospitality or food service industry
• Minimum 5 years of experience in progressive culinary leadership roles , including hotels, resorts, restaurants, or workforce lodges
• Physically able to stand for extended periods and lift up to 35 pounds
• Demonstrated experience operating large‑volume food service environments
• Advanced practical and theoretical knowledge across all kitchen areas:Hot KitchenCold KitchenPastry / BakeryButcheryBanquets and mass‑service operations
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and food service systems
• Proven ability to lead, develop, and retain culinary teams
• A leadership style that demonstrates ownership, accountability, strong communication, and professionalism

Dexterra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Tax (Alternative Assets)
jobs.description:
**This role will be working directly for one of our premiere clients; onsite at their NYC office three (3) days a week**

You will be working directly with a leading private equity firm in the alternative asset industry under the guidance and direction from the Tax Director. You will be providing the following for clients in the alternative asset industry:

What you’ll do

• You’ll prepare and file federal, state, and local partnership tax returns, extensions, and quarterly estimates, along with foreign filings (5471, 8865, 8858, 8621, 926).
• You’ll manage compliance tasks including 1099/1042 reporting, FBAR filings, FATCA (8966), and tax certification forms (W‑8s/W‑9s).
• You’ll handle entity elections by preparing 8832s, calculating tax basis for partnership interests and PFICs, and performing quarterly REIT testing.
• You’ll collaborate with clients by maintaining strong relationships, communicating engagement status, and resolving notices with federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
• You’ll apply tax expertise through multi‑state income tax planning, performing tax research to support positions, and ensuring accurate, timely compliance.

What we offer

• IQ-EQ offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being and work-life balance.
• Employees receive generous paid time off, including 4 weeks of PTO that increases over time, sick time and paid holidays, and financial wellness is supported through a 401(k) plan with a company match (subject to eligibility).
• Health benefits include medical, dental, vision, mental health support and additional ancillary insurance plans.
• Additional benefits include paid parental leave and a hybrid work schedule, promoting both personal and professional fulfillment.
• The salary for this position will be dependent on experience and location ($80,000 - $90,000).

• You have 3–5 years of progressive federal tax consulting and/or compliance experience, either in public accounting or at an alternative asset investment firm.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, with CPA or a master’s in Taxation preferred.
• You demonstrate exceptional customer service skills and the ability to build strong client relationships.
• You bring analytical, technical, and technology skills, with proficiency in basic office software and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• You thrive in a fast‑paced environment, willing to work overtime when needed to meet deadlines.

Principal Product Manager (Hyperscalers)
jobs.description:
Product managers will own the product development process and will be immersed in the execution of a key product, from NPI through volume ramp, ensuring seamless execution on the project milestones and direct the team to resolve any technical or logistical obstacles.

This role serves as the leader for the product development process, driving accountability, visibility, and on-time delivery across engineering, product management, operations, quality, and sales.

The Product Manager ensures that customer commitments — including project milestones, engineering samples, and volume ramps — are executable, scalable, and delivered with excellence in a supply-constrained and fast-paced environment.

Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling its AI-focused power delivery business. Products include high-performance digital power VRMs, multiphase controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), Vertical Power Stages (SPS with integrated capacitors and multiple silicon die), Power Towers (power modules integrating multiple SPS-equivalents with capacitors and inductors), and power MOSFETs.

Key Responsibilities:

• End-to-End Program Execution:Own the successful execution of assigned customer programs. Align internal development timelines with customer expectations. Identify program risks and drive mitigation plans proactively. Lead regular internal and customer-facing program reviews.

• Volume Ramp & Supply Coordination:Understand customer forecast and volume ramp requirements. Coordinate with supply chain, manufacturing, and capacity planning to ensure readiness. Monitor ramp execution and escalate constraints early. Ensure alignment between customer demand and supply capabilities

• Engineering Samples & NPI Management Track requested ship dates, lead times, and build status. Lead cross-functional coordination to meet sample commitments.Ensure proper governance through NPI planning gates and readiness reviews.

• Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance Act as a single point of program coordination across: Product Line Management Design Engineering, Applications / FAEs, Operations & Supply Chain, Quality, Sales.Establish execution dashboards and KPIs. Provide transparent status updates on schedule, quality, supply, and risks. Escalate critical issues with data-driven recommendations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field.
• 10+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or operations within semiconductors, (preferably power electronics, or infrastructure markets).
• Strong understanding of NPI processes, supply chain operations, and volume ramp execution.
• Experience managing complex, high-visibility customer programs.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
• Excellent communication, organization, and executive presentation skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with ability to create structured execution dashboards.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $210K-$270K. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Renesas offers a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD&D, and pet insurance. In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive company-paid life insurance and AD&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as paid sick time, paid holidays, and accrued paid vacation. jobs.title: Sr. New Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The individual will lead design, development, and testing of components and sub-systems for existing and next generation Endoluminal instruments, steerable catheter-based devices, and accessories that will interface with a robotic system. This role serves as a key technical contributor and leader, responsible for complex design challenges, project leadership, and advancing solutions through the product development process. The candidate will work within a technical team and with outside suppliers to develop and evaluate new technology solutions, establish design requirements to meet customer and company needs, prototype and refine designs, and advance them through the product development process to commercialization.

The successful candidate must excel in a fast-paced team environment and be capable of creative and efficient problem solving while ensuring attention to detail and quality when faced with time pressures. The individual must possess the technical expertise to understand complex mechanical designs and a passion for integrating quality into products. A strong sense of shared responsibility and commitment to high product quality is essential.

Essential Job Duties

• Design, prototype, troubleshoot, and optimize components and subassemblies of rigid and flexible catheter structures
• Evaluate component and subsystem designs within the context of overall system performance, reliability, manufacturability, and user experience.
• Establish technical direction, driving trade-off decisions, and influencing cross functional teams
• Collaborate cross functionally to understand and drive clarity on clinical, usability, and business needs, and decompose these needs into design requirements.
• Drive rigorous understanding of design risks by learning not just how a design behaves, but why.
• Complete detailed drawings and conduct tolerance analysis statistical best practices appropriately.
• Drive failure investigations using rigorous but efficient experimental plans.
• Prepare protocols/reports/summaries/readouts to capture and communicate design progress and defend / propose design decisions.
• Develop and improve test methods and assembly fixturing to support building and testing on prototypes.
• Collaborate cross functionally with supplier engineers, manufacturing process development engineers.
• Review design changes on existing products for impact on regulatory and manufacturing
• Mentor and guide technicians and junior engineers.

Required Education and Training

·         Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 6 years of experience in a mechanical design or catheter design role.
• Proficiency using CAD to create, fabricate, and document medical device designs.
• Experience with a range of prototyping and fabrication methods, including 3D printing, extrusion, injection molding, machining, wire EDM, welding, etc.
• Proven ability to apply (or learn where needed, then apply) engineering first principles to understand and achieve quick and reliable solutions to engineering problems.
• Exceptional mechanical aptitude and visual thinking skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, utilizing engineering tools such as finite element analysis, statistics, and experimental designs.
• Proven ability to iterate prototypes and mock-ups rapidly.

• Experience applying GD&T, tolerance stack analysis, and design-for-manufacturing principles.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to present to a wide range of audiences.

• Experience collaborating with multi-disciplinary internal functions like quality engineering, manufacturing engineering, clinical engineering, human factors, supplier engineering etc. and external suppliers

• Strong understanding of all phases of Design Control
• Proven ability to work well in a team environment as well as “solo” assignments.
• Demonstrated ability to follow through / sense of urgency.
• Self-starting, hands-on, and habitually curious.
• Demonstrated ability to handle multiple complex priorities as a matter of routine.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• MS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
• Experience with catheter design and manufacturing.
• Understanding of mechatronics, robotics, and servo-controlled systems.
• Experience developing requirements and performing risk assessment of candidate designs.
• Demonstrated ability to be resilient, creative, and make progress when faced with organizational and project complexity and constraint.

Working under the guidance of senior engineers and platform leaders, this role develops knowledge of contact center technologies, customer engagement processes, solution delivery practices, and operational support models. jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Associate
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

This role requires an individual to verify and maintain records on incoming and outgoing shipments. Prepare items for shipment by assembling, addressing, stamping, and then shipping merchandise or material. Other aspects of the role include receiving, unpacking, verifying, and recording incoming merchandise or material, and arranging for the transportation of products.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Shipping

• Package materials in boxes of varying sizes and ensure closure by tape or strapping. Insert items into containers using spacers, fillers, and protective padding. Affix shipping labels on packed cartons or markings identifying shipping information on all cartons
• Input all shipment information into enterprise resource planning (ERP) computer system
• Prepare pallets for storage or shipment using stretch wrapping process. Examine outgoing shipments to ensure shipments meet specifications
• Assemble cardboard containers, or select preassembled containers
• Maintain inventory of shipping materials and supplies
• Operate pallet stacker, pallet jack, hand-truck or cart to move shipments from shipping and receiving platform to storage or work area
• Perform other duties that may be assigned by management to meet business needs
• Cross-train in other areas of the department
• Complete HazMat training
• Process and prepare instrument orders

Receiving/Material Handling

• Restock parts on the manufacturing floor via KANBAN promptly
• Deliver and issue material requisitions
• Maintain warehouse overstock organization through iterative consolidation and material movements
• Move items in/out of Receiving Inspection and then put items away as they are passed through to their corresponding overstock or manufacturing floor location
• Communicate material shortages as they arise to the Planning team
• Receive delivered materials in SAP and label them so that they may be put away
• Maintain organization in the Receiving staging area as deliveries are made throughout the day

Key Characteristics:

• A team player who works well with others
• Flexible with work assignments and willing to work additional hours to complete daily volumes

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Forklift/pallet jack certifications
• Experience in international or dangerous goods shipping
• Familiarity with SAP system
• Excellent computer skills, including Google Workspace
• Excellent organizational skills
• Good verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
• Ability to prioritize workload and shift work activities to meet business needs and department goals
• Ability to meet tight deadlines

Education & Experience:

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent

Preferred

• 2 years or more work experience in a warehouse setting picking and packing

Working Environment and Physical Demands:

• Work environment is in a warehouse environment with a typical building-regulated temperature
• Nearly 100 % of your day will be on your feet. Safety Shoes are required
• You must be able to lift upwards of 55lbs; anything above that requires a team lift
• You will have some interaction with a small amount of hazardous material, so you will be trained and certified

The working environment and physical demands, as well as the essential functions and responsibilities, are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Assistant Manager(05065) - 21073 Powerline Rd #39
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager

Born to Lead

Being a Domino's Assistant Manager is more than just a job - it's a career. We're all about fun, but we take your career ambitions very seriously. As someone that likes a challenge, you'll love sinking your teeth into life as a Domino's manager. We want our people to enjoy coming to work, and Domino's managers are no different. Yes, you're responsible for the success of the store and its staff, but we still want you to enjoy achieving it. Chances are if you're having fun, everyone is.

Domino's Pizza loves Domino's people

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential. In other words, we want you to be yourself, and as a Domino's Asst Manager that's exactly what you can be. You'll get to flex your creative muscles, thinking up new ways to drive Domino's fun culture. Sell more pizza, have more fun! It's as simple as that. You'll have the chance to progress far quicker here. If you like the thought of managing your own million-dollar business, then Domino's Pizza is the place for you.

Drive your own career

Being a Domino's Assistant Manager isn't your average management gig. Domino's managers aren't just concerned with their own training; they're constantly supporting and pushing the team to go that one better. It's what makes it such a rewarding place to work. And the way Domino's works, it could be just the beginning. Many of our team members began their careers as Assistant Managers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager to franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

Job Requirements and Duties

As an Assistant Manager, you are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition, you’ll be responsible for Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash Control, Food Management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and Adherence to Standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & Punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store Cleanliness, Marketing, and Profitability

Those are the basics, but here’s what else you can expect:

General Job Duties

· Operate all equipment

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler

· Prepare product

· Receive and process telephone orders

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator)

· Must be able to make correct monetary change

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders

· Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen

Work Conditions

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside

· Fumes from food odors

· Exposure to cornmeal dust

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

Sensing

· Talking and hearing on telephone

· Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks

· Depth perception

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces

Temperaments

· The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions

Physical Requirements including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

· Most tasks are performed from a standing position

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72high

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push

· Trays may also be pulled

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients

Crouching/Squatting

· Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential; use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands

· Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists

Summary:

The Regional Tool Specialist is responsible for driving sales growth, technical expertise, and market penetration for the company's tools and related product categories throughout the assigned region. This position partners with branch personnel, outside sales representatives, supplier partners, and customers to identify opportunities, provide technical recommendations, conduct demonstrations and training, and execute regional growth initiatives.

The Regional Tool Specialist serves as the primary resource for tool applications, product knowledge, supplier engagement, and business development within the assigned territory. The position supports regional sales strategy by developing customer relationships, creating demand, and delivering solutions that improve customer productivity, safety, and operational performance.

What You'll Do:

• Develop and maintain expert knowledge of industrial power tools, cordless platforms, hand tools, cutting tools, fastening systems, tool storage solutions, safety-related tooling products, and related applications.
• Drive regional sales growth through collaboration with branch personnel, outside sales teams, key customers, and supplier partners.

jobs.description:

This position will report to the Operations or Practice Administrator and will be responsible for managing the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, managing practice collections, ensuring service excellence and performing service recovery as necessary. This role supervises and personally provides direct clerical tasks twenty percent of the time.

Responsibilities:

• Manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks.
• Responsible for front-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity.
• May perform day-to-day clerical functions twenty percent of the time in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.
• Supervise and direct the office’s front-line clerical staff.
• Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
• Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
• Manage providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
• Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
• Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co-pays and patient balances, in-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
• Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
• Manage office and supplies within budget.
• Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring, and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
• Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis in coordination with Operations Administrator.
• Attend and actively participate in leadership meetings.
• Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.

Additional Functions:

• Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
• Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
• Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one-on-one coaching and mentoring as needed.
• Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc)
• Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with policies and procedures.
• Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
• Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost-savings, and operational efficiencies.
• Implement new policies and procedures created by RMG or department leadership.

• Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO, PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid.
• Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office.
• Leadership experience.
• Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel.
• Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.

• Communicate clearly, professionally, and courteously with all internal and external contacts.

• Portfolio showcasing strong book design and typography including children’s design

The Triage Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Triage Nurse provides clinically expert triage service within a physicians’ practice. Must demonstrate competency for age related responsibilities.Quality control must be maintained during all aspects of patient care. jobs.title: CEI Project Administrator
jobs.description:
AECOM is currently seeking an experienced CEI Project Administrator to join our growing team and support a variety of transportation infrastructure projects located in the Tampa, FL area. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful work that helps shape the region’s infrastructure while working alongside a collaborative and professional team.

• Responsible for client/project development, resource management, and supervision of construction activities as they relate to contract administration and management of scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and change management
• Receives general instructions regarding assignments and exercises initiative and independent judgment in the solution of work problems
• Directs and assigns specific tasks to administrative and field staff and assists in all phases of the construction project
• Prepares and reviews progress estimates and final estimates throughout the construction project duration
• Responsible for the overall management administration of the project and assists in establishing project-specific objectives and policies
• Provides management and guidance to subordinate managers, enforces company and project policies, and serves as a primary liaison between AECOM and client interface.
• Oversees and ensures all facets of the project are constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors
• Responsible for administering the project from the pre-construction budgeting/schedule stage through procurement, shop drawing/coordination development, construction, space turnover, and contract closeout. Position has significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned construction project.
• Develops and maintains project schedules, ensuring timely completion of milestones and deliverables
• Coordinates with various stakeholders, including contractors, subcontractors, and regulatory agencies, to ensure compliance with project requirements and regulations
• Conducts regular site inspections to monitor construction progress, quality, and safety standards.
• Prepares and presents project status reports to senior management and clients, highlighting key performance indicators, risks, and mitigation strategies
• Manages project documentation, including contracts, change orders, and correspondence, ensuring proper record-keeping and compliance with organizational standards
• Identifies potential issues or conflicts and implements proactive solutions to minimize project delays and cost overruns
• Participates in project meetings, representing the organization's interests and facilitating effective communication among team members and stakeholders
• Mentors and develops junior staff members, promoting professional growth and fostering a collaborative team environment

• BA/BS degree plus 4 years of related experience, or AS Degree plus 6 years of related experience, or HS/GED plus 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency and/or education

• Experience in relevant transportation projects

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Contract Management

jobs.description:
This role owns the strategy and roadmap for the products hospitals and health systems use to load, model, and monitor their payer contracts — ensuring reimbursement is calculated accurately, underpayments are caught, and contract terms are applied correctly across the revenue cycle. You’ll own discovery and strategy for the most significant, often multi-threaded opportunities in this space, guide the organization’s largest or most complex engineering teams and bets, and set the standard other Billing Office product managers look to for contract-modeling rigor, requirements quality, and launch excellence.

Location

At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. You will report to the VP of Product Management, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs:

REMINDER: Select the locations for this specific role prior to posting.

Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA

You will have opportunity to:

• Own the contract modeling and rate management, fee schedule and contract loading, underpayment and variance detection, contract compliance and renegotiation support, and contract analytics and reporting capabilities hospitals and health systems use to manage payer contracts.
• Own discovery and strategy for the most significant, often multi-threaded opportunities in contract modeling, fee schedule management, and underpayment detection, sometimes running more than one strategic thread at a time.
• Set strategic direction and investment priorities at the portfolio level, informed by competitive and market monitoring in contract management.
• Build and defend business cases with credible cost, revenue, and ROI modeling to secure investment in new contract-modeling and underpayment-detection capabilities, and set the bar for business case quality and outcome-based OKRs across the Billing Office portfolio.
• Guide the largest, most complex engineering teams and bets within Contract Management, or lead discovery for the area’s most impactful new opportunities, setting the standard for discovery rigor, requirements analysis, and launch excellence.
• Use AI and prototyping to de-risk ambiguous, cross-team, or regulated contract-modeling bets, coaching others on responsible use in messy, high-stakes contexts.
• Own the organization’s most strategic customer relationships in Contract Management, leading the most strategic or contentious conversations on contract performance, underpayment recovery, and reimbursement accuracy.
• Maintain deep fluency in payer contracting practices, reimbursement methodologies, and the regulatory landscape, and help streamline Experian’s internal processes (PLM, compliance, procurement, regulatory, data protection) for launching new payer contracts and rate-related capabilities.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of product management experience, including a track record of owning the largest or most complex product areas within a portfolio.
• Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, payer contracting, or reimbursement methodology — direct experience with contract modeling, fee schedules, or underpayment detection strongly preferred; familiarity with related regulatory and data-protection requirements (e.g., HIPAA) is a plus.
• Experience independently guiding large or complex engineering teams, or leading discovery for an organization’s most impactful new bets.
• Experience building business cases and financial models, with a track record of securing investment through cost, revenue, and ROI analysis.
• Experience owning and repairing strategic, high-stakes customer relationships.
• Hands-on experience with AI tools spanning chat-based assistants, agentic tools, and dev-integrated/prototyping tools, including coaching others on responsible use.
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 40% of the time.
• Reside in, or near the designated Collaboration Hub(s) for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Latam Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Analyst, LATAM Tax, you will be responsible for preparing and supporting timely, accurate compliance with direct and indirect tax requirements across multiple jurisdictions in LATAM. This individual-contributor role involves preparing income tax filings, VAT filings, and tax provisioning workpapers, and coordinating closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors for our global subsidiaries. The role offers a dynamic work environment within a multinational corporation operating in over 100 countries, with strong potential for growth into more senior tax positions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Prepare Corporate Income Tax (CIT) returns, withholding tax compliance filings, VAT compliance filings, and advance tax calculations and payments across assigned LATAM jurisdictions.
• Prepare tax provision workpapers for statutory and group reporting purposes (ASC 740), including current and deferred tax calculations.
• Maintain and reconcile tax accounts on a monthly/quarterly basis, ensuring complete and accurate supporting documentation.
• Prepare Return-to-Provision reconciliations and supporting schedules as required.
• Liaise with internal stakeholders (R2R, FP&A, Treasury, Statutory Audit) and external consultants to support accurate and timely tax reporting.
• Assist with responses to tax audits, assessments, and inquiries from tax authorities across jurisdictions, under the guidance of senior team members.
• Support the implementation and testing of tax process improvements and automation initiatives.
• Provide support to the broader tax team as needed, including ad hoc analysis, data requests, and cross-functional collaboration.

• 2-5 years of relevant experience in direct and/or indirect tax, ideally within a global or multinational environment (industry, Big 4, or professional services).
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, or a related field.
• Working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation laws and accounting standards applicable to one or more LATAM jurisdictions.
• Familiarity with tax provisioning concepts (ASC 740) and general ledger reconciliations.
• Proficiency in Excel; experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is a plus.
• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines across jurisdictions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese proficiency is a plus.

jobs.title: Tax Manager
jobs.description:
As Manager, LATAM Tax, you will lead and oversee the accurate, timely compliance with direct and indirect tax requirements across multiple jurisdictions in LATAM. You will manage and review the work of tax analysts, take ownership of the regional tax compliance calendar, and act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, external advisors, and tax authorities. This role combines people leadership with technical tax oversight, and offers a dynamic work environment within a multinational corporation operating in over 100 countries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Review and approve Corporate Income Tax (CIT) returns, withholding tax compliance, VAT compliance filings, and advance tax calculations and payments prepared by the team across LATAM jurisdictions.
• Own and manage tax provision processes for statutory and group reporting purposes (ASC 740), reviewing current and deferred tax calculations prepared by analysts.
• Oversee the maintenance and reconciliation of tax accounts, ensuring complete and accurate supporting documentation and proper internal controls.
• Review and finalize Return-to-Provision templates and reconciliations in line with group requirements.
• Manage relationships with internal stakeholders (R2R, FP&A, Treasury, Statutory Audit) and external consultants, ensuring accurate and timely tax reporting across the region.
• Lead responses to tax audits, assessments, and inquiries from tax authorities across jurisdictions, coordinating with external advisors as needed.
• Coach, mentor, and develop tax analysts, including reviewing their work product and supporting their professional growth.
• Drive the design, implementation, and testing of tax process improvements and automation initiatives across the region.
• Identify and help manage tax risk across LATAM jurisdictions, escalating key issues to senior finance leadership as appropriate.
• Provide support to the broader tax function as needed, including ad hoc assignments, special projects, and cross-functional collaboration.

• 6-9+ years of relevant experience in direct and/or indirect tax within a global or multinational environment (industry, Big 4, or professional services), including prior experience reviewing others' work.
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, or a related field; CPA, Contador Público, or equivalent tax/accounting certification preferred.
• Strong knowledge of direct and indirect taxation laws and accounting standards across multiple LATAM jurisdictions.
• Solid experience with tax provisioning (ASC 740) and reconciliation of tax accounts under a multinational reporting framework.
• Prior experience managing or mentoring analysts, or leading workstreams, strongly preferred.
• Advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and tax technology/automation tools is a plus.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and coordinate across finance, business, and external advisors.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on tax risk and the ability to manage competing priorities across jurisdictions and deadlines.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese proficiency is a plus

jobs.description:
As a System Engineer, you will define and validate system-level solutions for server power products in the growing AI server market. In this hardware system engineering role, you will interface with customers to define power products, IC requirements, and system specifications, generate validation plans, and develop reference designs to ensure robust integration of 48V IBC in server, telecom, and industrial systems. Relationship to Patient/Family and Community

Care Coordination

• Utilizes appropriate nursing diagnosis and data from the assessment to derive realistic outcomes and documents them as measurable goals on the plan of care; modifies care plan, if indicated, in order to identify realistic patient goals.

jobs.description:

📍 Location: Remote – Los Angeles, CA (10% travel required for client workshops and meetings)

We are looking for an experienced Principal IAM Architect to lead identity and access management architecture, AWS security, authorization policies, and enterprise access controls. • Integrate identity and authorization solutions using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and identity federation.
• Automate IAM provisioning and policy deployment using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
• Establish security controls for APIs, service identities, workloads, and AI-enabled applications.
• Collaborate with cloud security, application development, DevSecOps, and enterprise architecture teams.

Required Skills

• 15+ years of experience in IT, cloud security, IAM architecture, or enterprise security.
• Strong hands-on experience with AWS IAM, roles, policies, permissions, and least-privilege access.
• Experience developing IAM policy templates and reusable authorization frameworks.
• Knowledge or hands-on experience with Cedar Policy Language and fine-grained authorization.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - Southpoint Mall
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $14.00 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior EHS Specialist
jobs.description:
Responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of specific environmental, health and safety (EHS) programs as assigned to ensure regulatory and internal compliance, reduce risk to the operations and employees, and minimize AbbVie’s liability. As related to the EHS programs assigned, the position will assess risk and will create programs, policies, procedures, assessments, and training materials as appropriate.

Responsibilities:

• Align and integrate the EHS strategy with the supporting organization’s mission, goals, and strategies.
• Monitor regulatory requirements/trends, conduct impact analyses, and implement programs to ensure compliance with both regulatory and internal standards.
• Monitor EHS trends and develop recommendations for input into the EHS LRP
• Develop and conduct training course material to meet the needs of the learner or business.
• Make timely decisions which reflect a consideration of facts and data at hand. Use persuasive techniques to influence others without reliance on formal authority, define the needs of various parties, and negotiate agreements acceptable to all parties.
• Actively identify and promote process improvements or new processes that strengthen the EHS function and the overall organization and minimizes/eliminates risk.
• Assess and quantify EHS risks and their consequences and implement appropriate actions.
• Communicate compliance status, key performance Indicators, trends, priority issues and business impact to key stakeholders.
• Conduct incident investigations, identify root causes, and implement improvement/action plans to prevent similar incidents from occurring.
• Lead and/or participate on cross functional teams to represent EHS objectives related to the subject matter and meet the team’s overall objectives and deliverables.

#LI-JW1

• Bachelor’s Degree (EHS related, Engineering) plus 5+ years of EHS related experience or Master’s Degree (EHS related, Engineering) plus 3 years require of EHS related experience.
• EHS or Engineering professional certification is preferred, but not required.
• Working experience in implementing EHS regulations, conducting incident investigations, interacting with regulatory agencies and external organizations and managing cross functional teams
• Ability to establish measurable project goals and implementation plans, balance conflicting work demands, and develop action plans including the identification of resource requirements.
• Ability to develop standards and/or policies that meet business objectives.
• Ability to actively listen, build and maintain effective working relationships with internal/ external colleagues and stakeholders, and resolve conflict constructively.
• Ability to successfully manage project and programs.
• Key Stakeholders: Patients, Company employees, company management, cross functional teams, global regulatory authorities and external organizations

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician I
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

A CDL-B is strongly preferred.

The Maintenance Technician I, inspects, maintains, repairs and installs mechanical, electromechanical, pneumatic and/or hydraulic equipment at plant and/or pump stations. Operate Centrifuge, Dump Truck, Sewer Cleaning Jet/Vac Equipment. Perform Maintenance and Operational Task with minimum oversight.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Operate the centrifuge and drive a 10 ton dump truck and sewer jet truck as well as lift station inspection and repairs.
• Performs routine and preventative maintenance, lubrication and minor adjustments on machines and related equipment which may include pumps, engines, centrifuges, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors, blowers, dryers, chemical feed and odor control, disinfection equipment, vacuum filters and belt presses. Promptly reports any operational problems with machines or equipment to Lead or Supervisor.
• Learns to inspect and becomes proficient at mechanical troubleshooting to determine repairs needed. Dismantles equipment to gain access to and repairs defective parts using hand tools, power tools and precision measuring and testing devices. Re-assembles and tests equipment ensuring safe and efficient operating conditions are restored. Learns to troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and electronic equipment and instrumentation.
• Performs facility maintenance and repair and may replace or install light bulbs, fluorescent tubes, damaged glass, windows, doors, partitions, ceiling or floor tiles, door locks, carpet, and/or paint.
• May perform manual labor including cleaning equipment, facilities and grounds as required and properly dispose of waste according to safety and environmental policies. Operates vehicles for plant operational purposes.
• Cover on call rotation for both the Water and Wastewater plants.
• Learn to estimate time and material costs for various projects. May assist in other areas of the plant as directed.

Work Environment:

• Spends 100% of the time in the operations environment.
• Typically spends 25 – 35% of time exposed to outdoor and sometimes inclement weather.
• Company service vehicles are used as required.
• Travels 1 – 2 times per year for company provided training.
• Serves rotational 24 hour emergency on-call.
• Possible Work Hazards: May be exposed to possible operations hazards including fumes, dust, toxic and caustic chemicals, noise, rotating machinery, high pressure and hot and cold temperatures, slippery surfaces, water and electrical hazards.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma or GED with the ability to read, write and comprehend English (operational, process, safety and quality instructions) and be able to carry out verbal and written instructions.
• Six months to two years of experience in a related position with ability to comprehend specifications, blueprints and manuals.
• Experience using power, pneumatic, hydraulic, and hand tools and shop tools such as drill press, band saw, bench grinder, and torque wrench preferred.
• Experience using material handling equipment, pressure gauges and precision measuring instruments.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
• Some vocational training and mechanical aptitude preferred, with the ability to read, interpret and record data from meters, gauges, scales, panels, computer consoles and other equipment.
• Must have ability to operate Computer Maintenance Management System (software).
• Must consistently demonstrate the ability to learn and independently perform assigned duties and meet or exceed production and quality goals.
• Must demonstrate ability to work in a team environment and willingness to assume additional or new responsibilities readily

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must possess, or be able to obtain within three months, a commercial license class B (CDL-B) with air brakes and tanker endorsement.
• Minimum water / wastewater license as required by regulatory agency at site - preferred
• Ability to be certified to perform public drinking water analysis within six months - required.
• Must possess a valid driver’s license and a safe driving record.
• Employee Orientation, Departmental Operating Procedures, Safety, Confined Space training, OSHA and Quality Training.
• HAZWOPER (Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response) Level I and II First Responder Certification if required by site.
• Must become proficient in the care and use of all site specific, facility required PPE (Personal Protection Equipment), including respirators, gas detectors, confined space equipment, etc.)
• Forklift Certification if required by site.
• Training in operation of mechanical drives, hydraulic pumps and valves, pneumatics, electronics and control systems.
• Obtain or maintain HVAC, Electrician, Plumber’s or other trade License if assigned to that area.
• Note: Tech will not perform duties unless properly licensed.
• Training in the use of energy management systems as needed.
• Works toward increasing skills in additional functional areas or in obtaining advanced skills / maintenance certifications.

Physical Requirements:

• Amount of time spent – Standing 25%, Walking 75% for as many as five miles per shift.
• Requires close visual and hearing observation to detect non-conformance and machine malfunction.
• Constantly uses hands to finger, handle or feel and frequently reaches with hands and arms.
• Works in various positions; works on ladders, catwalks, and supports at heights of 50 feet above the ground; and works with hands extended above and below head and body up to 40 minutes using hand tools weighing up to 15 pounds.
• Must be able to lift and carry 50 pounds (occasionally 60 pounds) distances of 10 feet.
• Occasional stooping, bending or kneeling and entering confined spaces.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

• Works directly with the Key Government Representatives to drive Program Compliance, Submittal of funding requests, billing, contract modifications, creation of White Papers.
• Experience with development of a PM plan, defining scope, planning, developing cost and risk plans, procurement, manufacturing, performing QC, testing, delivering product according to customer defined schedule of deliveries, and working the program through final payment.

jobs.title: Line Cook III
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Cook III is responsible for assisting in the preparation, setup, production, and quality control of food items across various kitchen stations. This role supports the culinary team by preparing meats, fish, vegetables, breads, sauces, stocks, seasonings, and other menu components in accordance with established recipes, standards, and health regulations to ensure consistent, high-quality products for guests.

Essential Functions

• Prepare food items according to standard recipes or as directed by the supervisor to ensure consistency, quality, and timely service.
• Assist in the setup and breakdown of assigned kitchen stations.
• Transport and handle food products and supplies, including lifting heavy items as required for production.
• Visually inspect, select, and use only the freshest and highest-quality fruits, vegetables, meats, and other ingredients.
• Monitor proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food products, with particular attention to fresh produce and portion control.
• Maintain cleanliness and organization of all refrigeration units, storage areas, and workstations in compliance with Health Department regulations.
• Ensure all kitchen equipment in assigned work areas is clean, sanitized, and in proper working condition.
• Accurately read and follow recipes, applying basic mathematical skills for measurements, portions, and scaling.
• Prepare requisitions for food and supply items needed for daily production at the workstation.
• Follow all food safety, sanitation, and hygiene standards at all times.
• Work effectively as part of a team to support smooth kitchen operations and service flow.

Supportive Functions

In addition to essential duties, this position may be required to perform the following supportive functions based on operational needs:

• Perform general cleaning tasks using approved hotel or kitchen cleaning products as assigned.
• Keep floors clean and dry to prevent slip and fall hazards.
• Assist with moving supplies, equipment, and deliveries as required.
• Respond promptly to spills and assist with unexpected cleaning or operational needs.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor or kitchen management

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Radiation Therapist-Radiology Oncology Full Time Days
jobs.description:
The Radiation Therapist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Therapist is responsible for delivering radiation therapy treatments to patients while adhering to all policies and procedures that ensure high-quality, safe, and compassionate care. This role requires consistent compliance with established standards governing radiation therapy treatments and simulations. The Therapist collaborates effectively with team members to ensure all treatment procedures are performed accurately, compassionately, and in accordance with the prescribing physician’s orders.

Responsibilities:

• Delivers the prescribed course of radiation treatment to the patient.

• Verifies treatment daily and cumulative treatment dose.

• Positions patients using patient specific devices created in the simulation procedure.

• Monitors patient throughout entire duration of treatment delivery process.

• Acquires treatment imaging per the prescription.

• Matches daily imaging with reference image and applies resultant shifts prior to treatment.

• Monitors therapy peer image matching and consults on final positioning discrepancies.

• Collaborates openly on image matching and suggests revision as needed.

• Maintains complete and accurate treatment delivery records.

• Reports and documents treatment deviations in accordance with department policy.

• Prepares supplies and equipment needed for treatment setup and simulation.

• Documents patient setup instructions in accordance with department format.

• Fabricates custom devices per physician order during simulation.

• Establishes optimal, reproduceable patient position during simulation.

• Acquires all ordered simulation images.

• Documents in writing and photos simulated patient position and alignment markings.

• Creates proper documentation for simulation and treatment procedures.

• Submits correct charges for services rendered per department policy.

• Assesses patient visually and verbally for performance status changes through treatment course.

• Charts relevant treatment dose details and changes in patient condition.

• Notifies appropriate ancillary personnel to assess patients as needed.

• Adheres to all departmental policies and procedures, ensuring patient, visitor and staff safety.

• Completes and documents daily QA per department procedure.

• Completes initial, boost, and plan change chart parameter verification.

• Provides timely patient education aligned with the patient’s ability to learn.

• Identifies and overcomes barriers to patient education utilizing department resources.

• Refers patients to physician, nurse or social worker as needed.

• Communicates with patients in a timely manner regarding any delay or wait time.

• Ensures that all patients are treated in a safe and timely manner.

• Offers service recovery resources to patients when appropriate.

• Assists in problem solving daily operational issues.

• Assesses supply inventory and reports purchasing needs to therapy leadership.

• Identifies quality concerns and communicates them to therapy leadership.

• Operates and maintains equipment.

• Triages equipment issues per department protocol.

• Elevates concerns to leadership when unable to self-rectify.

• Establishes and maintains collegial relationships with all intra/inter department NM employees.

• Promotes an environment of cultural safety and dignity in verbal and written actions.

• Maintains a positive attitude, even in difficult or challenging situations.

• Supports all department and hospital quality and safety initiatives.

• Maintains infection control standards in procedure rooms/areas of patient care services.

• Ensures assigned work area meets hospital safety and professional appearance standards.

• Identifies and addresses maintenance and facility issues as needed.

• Renews and submits all required licensure and certifications prior to expiration.

• Maintains competencies and complies with credentialing continuing education requirements.

• Completes other duties as assigned by Manager.

Required:

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent (Radiologic Technologist with advanced training and board certification in Radiation Therapy)

Licensure:

• IEMA- Illinois Emergency Management Agency in Medical Radiation Technology licensure

Certification:

• ARRT- American Registry of Radiologic Technology certification

• AHA BLS- Basic Life Support certification through the American Heart Association certification

Preferred:

• Multilingual Proficiency in other languages

• Extensive computer proficiency

• Prior experience as a Radiation Therapist in a comparable clinical setting
