jobs.title: Director, Field Access and Reimbursement - Psych
jobs.description:
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within the United States.

The Director, Psychiatry Field Reimbursement Managers (FRM) will lead the national strategy and execution of the Psychiatry FRM team. This role provides direct leadership to 3 Associate Directors and indirect leadership to 23 Field Reimbursement Managers across the country.

This is a leadership position operating at the intersection of field execution, market access strategy, and commercial performance. The Director owns the performance framework that translates FRM activity into measurable business value, influences senior stakeholder decisions with insight and data.

This is not a role for a manager who coaches upward. The right candidate brings enterprise thinking, has built or significantly scaled high-performing organizations, and can hold a seat at the table with Market Access, Commercial, and Patient Services leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

• Set the vision and execution priorities for the Psych FRM team, aligned to brand strategy and patient access goals, while owning the measurement framework that demonstrates impact on revenue, access velocity, pull-through, and patient starts.
• Ensure FRM operating procedures and field activities comply with applicable regulations, AbbVie policies, and MLR-approved ways of working.
• Develop and execute a national strategy for patient services, access resources, and programs.
• Identify training needs and support in-field, regional, and national meeting execution.
• Build the access infrastructure, training, and deployment models needed to support new indication launches, new modalities, and geographic expansion.
• Monitor team performance, activity, and capacity through analytics, and close gaps in measurement by shifting the organization from activity metrics to impact metrics.
• Drive a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, compliance, and customer-centricity.
• Identify and develop succession candidates at the AD and FRM levels, building talent from within.
• Partner with Market Access, Trade, Legal, Compliance, Patient Support Services, and IT to navigate healthcare landscape changes, maintain program integrity, and ensure accurate vendor data exchange.
• Ensure both teams consistent, compliant, and differentiated reimbursement support — covering coding, coverage, billing, patient affordability, and product acquisition.

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MPH, PharmD, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
• 8–12+ years of progressive experience in field leadership, access and reimbursement market access, and healthcare strategy
• Minimum 5 years leading field-based teams, with demonstrated experience managing managers (not just individual contributors).
• Proven track record of building or scaling an infield team — hiring, structuring, and developing teams through periods of rapid growth.
• Proven ability to navigate regulatory requirements and mitigate compliance risks.
• Deep understanding of Medicare Parts A, B, C, and D reimbursement, specialty drug acquisition, and distribution.
• Excellent communication (oral, written, and presentation) and interpersonal skills.
• Demonstrated leadership impact and ability to work effectively across functions

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Analytics & Market Research
jobs.description:
The Analytics and Performance Excellence (APEX) team is an industry-recognized center of research excellence and strategic vision. We function as in-house strategic counsel — translating advanced analytics into business decisions and patient impact. We invest in diverse talent, cultivate new capabilities, and foster an inclusive culture where the best ideas win.

Role Summary

As Senior Manager within the Market Access & Patient Services Insights group, you will independently lead analytics and market research initiatives that shape U.S. Immunology brand strategy. You will identify payer opportunities, assess risk scenarios, and deliver actionable recommendations that advance patient access and provider reimbursement — with a particular emphasis on the medical benefit landscape, buy-and-bill dynamics, and ASP-driven pricing strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Data Science

• Lead advanced analytics across utilization management, medical policy, pricing, and competitive launch assessment.
• Apply modeling, data science, and visualization tools to surface actionable business insights.
• Develop contracting strategies grounded in quantitative analysis of specialty pharmacies, PBMs, GPOs, health plans, and medical benefit access dynamics.
• Analyze reimbursement and access trends spanning buy-and-bill, ASP, site of care, and provider-administered therapies.
• Mine healthcare and operational datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improved access and execution.

Market Research

• Design and execute market research initiatives assessing payer dynamics, access barriers, and competitive positioning.
• Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into clear, strategy-ready insights.
• Track competitive launches and evolving healthcare policy through rigorous research methodologies.
• Inform medical benefit access, provider-administered therapy, and reimbursement strategy through targeted insights development.

Strategic Leadership & Collaboration

• Present analytics and research findings to senior leadership; influence high-impact, cross-functional decisions.
• Mentor junior team members in analytics and market research capabilities.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with market access, field teams, analytics partners, and external stakeholders to convert insights into action.
• Champion an innovative, high-performing, and inclusive team culture.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Science, Business, Analytics, Health Economics, or a related field.
• 6+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare analytics, market access, or a closely related role.
• Direct industry experience across payer, manufacturer, consulting, or vendor environments supporting pharma/healthcare clients.
• Proficiency in one or more analytic tools (SQL, Python, R, Dataiku, or equivalent) and data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI).
• Proven ability to independently lead projects and deliver strategic insights in fast-paced, cross-functional settings.
• Superior communication skills — able to distill complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
• Working knowledge of medical benefit access, reimbursement dynamics, and provider-administered therapy models.

Preferred

• Advanced degree (Master's, MBA, MPH, or equivalent).
• In-depth U.S. market access experience: value/contracting strategy, reimbursement policy analytics, or access barrier assessment.
• Hands-on experience with syndicated pharma data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony Health, DRG, MMIT).
• Familiarity with statistical modeling, machine learning, or predictive analytics methodologies.

jobs.description:
Manufacturing equipment and processes require a high degree of specialized attention around the clock. The primary objective is to maximize efficiency and prevent any interruption of production by achieving control over the systems the manufacturing cycle depends on. Primarily these systems include facility, equipment, utility, and controls. These systems are maintained and continually improved by Engineer Technician I’s. They also contribute to the design of products and processes. The role will provide technical support for industrial automation and controls systems, including PLCs, HMIs, Vision systems, and associated manufacturing equipment, with a focus on troubleshooting and minimizing production downtime.

Responsibilities

• Works in an independent manner under the guidance of a supervisor or technical lead. Assignments have clear and specified objectives and require the investigation of a limited number of variables. Examples of supporting assignments include: system maintenance, equipment or process design and development, validation of equipment, materials and processes, preparation of specifications.
• Complies with applicable policies and procedures, regulatory and safety requirements.
• Provides technical service. Daily monitoring and troubleshooting of assigned systems. Troubleshoots industrial automation and control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, sensors, instrumentation, Vision systems, and associated equipment. Expected to recommend improvements in design, installation, start-up or execution of a project or task as well as the maintenance of a program.
• Maintains documentation, monitoring logs, Best Operating Practices (BOPs), training manuals, etc. for regulatory compliance. Assists in the implementation of long-term projects to maintain efficiency.
• Assists operations in the process of troubleshooting to determine potential impacts on production and facility systems.
• Exchanges information with project team members, designers, management, and other engineering or production personnel. Delivers recommendations and suggestions to project team members and management within the department.
• Provides limited technical assistance and information to production, engineering groups and outside consultants, contractors, and various departments within the Company.
• Participates and/or assists engineers in the design of process equipment or systems for optimal performance. Assists in the start-up of new and troubleshoots existing facilities/equipment to ensure optimal operation and performance. Supports the installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automation and controls equipment and systems.
• Identifies issues and implements troubleshooting techniques necessary to avoid production downtime. Closely monitors systems as assigned for potential issues and/or improvements. Utilizes PLC diagnostics, HMI information, electrical drawings, and equipment documentation to identify and resolve automation-related issues.
• Responds to requests, evaluates problems, determines causes and communicates and implements solutions in the most efficient manner.

• High School/GED is required. Technical school completion/certification preferred.
• At least 5 years prior technical experience in area(s) of specialty with basic knowledge of systems described.
• Working knowledge of PLC-based control systems, preferably Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation or Siemens platforms.
• Basic understanding of Vision systems, preferably Cognex or Keyence platforms.
• Basic understanding of PC hardware, Windows operating systems, Ignition, and industrial network communications used in manufacturing and automation systems.
• Ability to use PLC diagnostics, HMI information, electrical schematics, and technical documentation to identify and troubleshoot equipment issues.
• Knowledge of basic regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Cost Manager / Estimator - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager / Estimator to serve as the day-to-day client lead, delivering proactive cost management services across the full project lifecycle for data center developments.

The successful candidate will have experience in cost planning, cost modeling, and pre-construction activities, supporting informed decision-making from early-stage feasibility through project delivery. While working closely with our dedicated Data Center estimating team, this role will be responsible for leading client-facing commercial discussions, reviewing estimates, and ensuring robust cost management strategies are implemented.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work independently, lead project teams, and drive successful outcomes in complex, fast-paced environments. As a senior member of the team, you will champion Turner & Townsend's purpose, values, and vision while providing leadership and mentorship to colleagues.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and manage project budgets, cost plans, forecasts, and benchmark analyses throughout the project lifecycle.
• Prepare and present cost reports, commercial updates, and financial analyses to project stakeholders and senior leadership.
• Lead cost planning, estimating reviews, and budget validation activities from project initiation through completion.
• Support procurement activities, including bid package development, contractor selection, proposal evaluation, leveling, and commercial recommendations.
• Review contractor and subcontractor pricing, proposals, and change order requests.
• Manage commercial change control processes, evaluating impacts to cost, schedule, scope, and project risk.
• Monitor project expenditures, commitments, contingency utilization, and forecasted final costs.
• Perform cost checks, valuations, benchmarking exercises, and budget reconciliations.
• Collaborate with project teams to identify value engineering and cost optimization opportunities.
• Maintain oversight of project cash flow forecasting and financial reporting.
• Support commercial risk management efforts, including contingency planning, cost risk assessments, and contract compliance reviews.
• Assist in the resolution of commercial issues, claims, and disputes while minimizing project risk exposure.
• Review project controls documentation and ensure alignment between scope, schedule, and budget objectives.
• Produce monthly cost reports and participate in client and project team meetings.
• Manage project financial closeout activities, including final account negotiations and vendor settlements.
• Maintain cost databases and benchmarking information to support future project planning and delivery.
• Mentor junior cost management professionals and contribute to team development.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and implementation of best practices across project delivery.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, delivery methodologies, and governance requirements.
• Be a role model that drives a one-business culture and delivers successful outcomes for clients, colleagues, and stakeholders.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related construction field.
• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in cost management, quantity surveying, estimating, or commercial management within the construction industry.
• Experience supporting mission-critical, data center, advanced technology, industrial, infrastructure, or other highly technical construction projects is required.
• Demonstrated experience managing project costs from planning and procurement through construction and closeout.
• Experience reviewing estimates, contractor pricing, change orders, and commercial negotiations.
• Knowledge of construction procurement strategies, value engineering, cost control, and risk management principles.
• Experience working in active operational environments is preferred.
• Construction consultancy experience strongly preferred.
• RICS accreditation or progress toward chartership preferred.
• Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and client-facing skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and www.heery.com/

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
The Reliability Engineer is responsible for improving equipment availability, performance, and lifecycle reliability by applying structured problem-solving, data analysis, and predictive maintenance methodologies. This role focuses on identifying chronic losses, reducing unplanned downtime, and driving long-term corrective actions that improve Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and reduce Mean Time To Repair (MTTR).

By applying the Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) methodology, the engineer ensures that maintenance strategies are risk-based, cost-effective, and aligned with Bosch’s TPM objectives. Through technical expertise and cross-functional collaboration, the Reliability Engineer drives sustainable improvements in equipment reliability, production stability, and total cost of ownershi

FMECA and Risk Management

· Develops and maintains Failure Mode, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA) for critical

assets and systems.

· Evaluates failure consequences and criticality to prioritize maintenance actions within the RCM

framework.

· Updates risk assessments based on operational learnings and ensures compliance with Bosch

reliability standards.

· Participates in new MAE projects to ensure FMECA is applied as standard practice in equipment

design.

Predictive and Preventive Maintenance Optimization

· Develops and continuously improves preventive and predictive maintenance strategies based on RCM

principles.

· Implements predictive maintenance techniques such as vibration analysis, thermography, and oil

diagnostics.

· Optimizes preventive maintenance frequencies using equipment performance trends and reliability

data.

· Collaborates with the Maintenance System Specialist to ensure updated strategies are reflected in

SAP PM.

· Supports new equipment commissioning and Early Equipment Management (EEM) by validating

maintainability and reliability design requirements. 20%

Equipment Reliability and Performance Analysis

· Monitors equipment reliability KPIs, including MTBF, MTTR, and OEE-related losses.

· Reviews maintenance and production data to identify chronic failures and performance degradation.

· Coordinates with Maintenance and Production teams to validate root causes and define improvement

priorities.

· Ensures proper use of reliability platforms (e.g., QRS) to identify bad actors and track equipment

performance. 25%

Root Cause and Continuous Improvement Activities

· Leads structured problem-solving processes (5Why, Fishbone, Shainin, or 8D) for high-impact

failures.

· Facilitates cross-functional workshops to eliminate recurring issues and standardize best practices.

· Drives complex corrective maintenance initiatives, ensuring implementation of sustainable corrective 25%

actions. · Tracks and verifies the effectiveness of corrective actions and ensures learnings are documented and shared.

Reliability Cost and Failure Impact Analysis

· Analyzes cost of failures and downtime to identify technical or process-related cost drivers.

· Evaluates maintenance and spare-part data to correlate failure impact and total cost of ownership

(TCO).

· Provides design, process, or maintenance strategy recommendations to reduce reliability-related

costs.

· Coordinates with the Maintenance System Specialist to ensure analytical findings are reflected in

maintenance plans. 10%

Documentation, Reporting, and Best Practice Sharing

· Documents reliability analyses, lessons learned, and improvement actions using standardized

templates.

· Prepares monthly reports and dashboards for TEF3 management and global reliability networks.

· Shares best practices across departments to strengthen continuous improvement culture.

· Provides coaching and mentoring to supervisors and technicians to reinforce reliability principles and

knowledge transfer

Education

Bachelor’s Degree X Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or related field

Post-Graduate Degree X Reliability Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field

Special License/Certification X Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), Shainin Red X, or equivalent.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: H&M Seasonal Sales Advisor - The Avenues
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $15.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

• Compassionate, calm, and patient-focused
• A dependable team player and strong communicator

What You Get To Do:

The Nursing Services Manager is responsible for the Wellness Coordination program as well as supervising and managing nursing operations in a select area.  This position develops and monitors the oversight of medical policies and procedures used within Dungarvin and ensures they meet all licensing requirements. The Nursing Services Manager will assure that each individual receives quality, individualized health care management resulting in optimal health.

• Nursing Leadership: Supervise, support, and develop nursing staff while promoting accountability, consistency, and high-quality care.
• Wellness Coordination: Ensure required assessments, wellness plans, face-to-face visits, and documentation are completed accurately and on time.
• Clinical Oversight: Monitor healthcare needs, clinical services, and care delivery for individuals supported across assigned programs.
• Clinical Consultation: Partner with Area Directors, Program Directors, nurses, and other team members on medical concerns, healthcare practices, and regulatory requirements.
• Program Growth: Help develop healthcare systems and nursing supports for new individuals and new programs.
• Compliance & Quality: Ensure nursing services and documentation meet licensing requirements, organizational standards, and person-centered care expectations.

What Makes You A Great Fit:

• Active Indiana RN License: Current, unrestricted license to practice as a Registered Nurse in Indiana.
• Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of experience leading, supervising, coaching, or developing nursing or healthcare staff.
• Communication & Documentation: Strong ability to communicate clinical information clearly and maintain accurate healthcare documentation.
• Valid Driver’s License: Must be able to travel between programs as needed.
• Successful Background Clearance: Must successfully complete required background and compliance checks.

Nice to Have:

• Residential Services Experience: Experience in ICF/IID, Medicaid waiver, group home, supported living, or community-based settings.
• Clinical Leadership: Experience supervising nurses, LPNs, or other healthcare staff.
• Staff Training: Experience educating clinical and non-clinical staff on health-related needs, medication administration, and care procedures.
• Healthcare Planning: Knowledge of assessments, care plans, medication management, MARs, and physician orders.
• Clinical Documentation: Experience with electronic health records, audits, regulatory documentation, and quality improvement.
• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Experience partnering with physicians, guardians, pharmacies, case managers, and program leadership.
• On-Call Leadership: Experience providing clinical guidance during evenings, weekends, or urgent situations.

Skills Crucial for Success:

• Clinical Judgment: Assess health concerns, recognize changes in condition, and determine appropriate next steps.
• Leadership & Communication: Coach staff and clearly explain medical information to both clinical and non-clinical teams.
• Organization & Prioritization: Manage competing clinical needs, documentation, appointments, trainings, audits, and follow-up across multiple programs.
• Compliance & Attention to Detail: Maintain accurate healthcare records and ensure services meet regulatory and organizational standards.
• Collaboration: Build strong relationships with individuals served, families, nurses, DSPs, providers, guardians, and program leaders.
• Adaptability & Initiative: Stay calm under pressure, adjust to changing needs, and proactively improve healthcare systems and services.
• Person-Centered Care: Balance health and safety needs with individual rights, preferences, and independence.

Why You'll Love this Role:

You’ll love this role if you’re passionate about using your nursing leadership to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families. You’ll help ensure people who have traditionally been underserved have access to high-quality, individualized healthcare and the support they need to thrive in their communities. As a Nursing Services Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to develop and support a talented nursing team while collaborating with a larger group of professionals who genuinely support one another. It’s a great fit for someone who wants their clinical expertise and leadership to have an impact beyond the bedside.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. jobs.description:

Based in our Austin office alongside the North American regional team, you will report to the Global Influencer Team in London and connect global strategy with strong regional execution.

You will be accountable for the overall direction and performance of the North American influencer channel. Your remit will span three core priorities: owning the overarching strategy for North America, supporting our US Influencer Manager; directly leading and scaling our influencer activity in Canada; and developing our influencer strategy for Wise Business.

Responsibilities

North America Strategy and Leadership

• Own the North American influencer strategy, setting clear priorities across the US and Canada.
• Build annual and quarterly plans covering audiences, creators, channels and investment.
• Own regional forecasting and budget recommendations, using performance insights to scale opportunities, improve efficiency and redirect investment.
• Represent influencer marketing in regional planning and bring North American insights into our global strategy.

Market Growth

• Directly own and scale Wise’s influencer strategy in Canada, from market planning and creator identification through to execution and optimisation.
• Support the existing US Influencer Manager with strategic direction and opportunity sizing while they retain ownership of market execution.
• Build a locally relevant Canadian programme and test new propositions, formats and partnerships to define the market’s long-term growth roadmap.
• Ensure all North American influencer activity follows applicable regulatory, disclosure, brand-safety and procurement requirements.
• Manage senior relationships with relevant agencies, creator partners, platforms and tools to improve programme quality and scale.

Wise Business Influencer Strategy

• Develop and lead the global influencer strategy for Wise Business, beginning in North America and defining the role creators can play in reaching and converting business customers.
• Identify priority audiences and creator segments, and partner with the Wise Business team on positioning and messaging.
• Run structured tests to determine which creators, messages, formats and commercial models drive qualified customers, using the results to build a scalable roadmap.

• You have extensive influencer marketing experience across the US and Canada, with a track record of building programmes that drive measurable customer growth
• You focus on meaningful insights and the metrics that drive real impact.
• You can set a clear regional strategy while remaining close enough to execution to understand what is working.
• You have experience marketing to small businesses, entrepreneurs or freelancers.
• You are commercially and analytically strong, with experience managing budgets, forecasts and performance.
• You are an effective cross-functional collaborator who can connect regional and global teams around shared priorities.
• You are comfortable operating within a global reporting structure while being embedded in a regional team, and you can connect both groups through clear communication and shared priorities.

Nice-to-have

• Experience building influencer or ambassador programmes in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry.
• Affiliate or performance-partnership experience.
• Experience leading and developing high-performing marketers.
• French-language skills or experience marketing in Quebec; proficiency in other languages is also valuable.

• Workplace Model: This is a hybrid role requiring office presence (at least 3 days); it is not a fully remote position. During your first 3 months in the role, you will be expected to be 100% in the office.
• Find out more about our benefits in our Austin location.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

jobs.title: Class A Commercial Driver

Frequent bending, kneeling, twisting, reaching, and climbing in and out of tractor-trailer cabs.

jobs.title: Merchant Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Remote. Open to candidates in Canada or in the following US states: Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, and Virginia (excluding the New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, and Washington DC metro areas).

Who Are We?

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural “core behaviors” with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say “Thanx” Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

Who Are You?

You like figuring out why something broke. A reward didn't apply, a location stopped sending transactions, an order failed. You keep digging until you have an answer you can back up with data.

You're comfortable with technical tools and you pick up new systems quickly. You may not have worked with restaurant POS systems or payments before, and that's fine. You can explain what you found to a merchant or a teammate who doesn't know the technical details.

You already use AI in your daily work, and you want to be somewhere that expects it.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

Position Overview

Merchant Operations makes sure our restaurant partners' setup works: their loyalty programs, mobile apps, online ordering, and the POS and other integrations behind them. We work closely with the Implementation team to launch merchants, then with Customer Success to make sure the program keeps operating effectively. Our part is the technical configuration, and after launch we monitor location health, investigate issues, and get root causes fixed.

You'll report to the Director of Merchant Operations and Support and work day to day with Support, Customer Success, Implementation, Product, and Engineering. You'll own a real piece of the work from your first months, not a narrow ticket queue.

How We Work With AI

“With great power comes great responsibility.” Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.

These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

Key Responsibilities

• Configure merchant setups. Set up and update loyalty, rewards, app, and online ordering for new and existing merchants. This is a high-volume part of the job, so accuracy and speed both matter.

• Connect partner integrations. Link merchants to their POS, ordering, and delivery partners, handle credentials, and work with partner teams when something needs their side.

• Investigate and resolve issues. Take escalations from Support and Customer Success, work out what is actually happening, and either fix it or give Engineering a clear bug report with the evidence.

• Monitor location health. Catch locations that go quiet, integrations that break, and cards that stop transacting before merchants report them.

• Manage card network enrollment. Enroll locations with Visa, Mastercard, and Amex, and troubleshoot when transactions don't flow the way they should.

• Build and improve automations. Turn repetitive manual work into monitors, lookups, and workflows the whole team can use.

• Communicate clearly. Write updates for merchants and teammates that people can act on without a follow-up question.

How We Will Know It's Working

At six months, you're handling the team's core configuration and investigation work on your own, your diagnoses hold up when Engineering reviews them, and you've shipped at least one automation the team uses.

At twelve months, you own an area end to end, such as an integration, a card network, or a monitoring area, and you've made a visible difference in how the team works.

What We're Looking For

We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves:

• Experience in a technical support, operations, implementation, or similar role where you diagnosed problems across multiple systems.

• A track record of finding root causes, not just closing tickets.

• Comfort with data. SQL is a big plus, and we'll teach what you need if you have the aptitude.

• Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analysis, troubleshooting, or workflows.

• Clear written communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A habit of automating repetitive work when you see it.

• Comfort in a lean, fast-moving environment where priorities shift.

• Experience with restaurant technology, POS systems, payments, or APIs is a plus.

Ready to change your life? Apply now!

Compensation

US
$22.00 - $25.00 USD per hour

Canada
$25.00 - $29.00 CAD per hour

Leveling & Location

Thanx uses structured internal leveling and location-based compensation. Final leveling and compensation are determined through the interview process based on experience, scope, and work location, and any offer will align with the appropriate range.

How We Review Applications

We use AI-assisted tools to help review applications. Every application is also reviewed by a person, and no hiring decision is made by an automated system alone. If you'd like to know more about how we use these tools, ask your recruiter at any point in the process.

Accommodations

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process, contact people@thanx.com and we will work with you to arrange it.

jobs.description:
As an IDD Services Senior Director, you’ll play a vital role in leading and growing Dungarvin’s services in Indiana. You’ll provide strategic direction and operational oversight while developing leaders, driving business growth, and ensuring high-quality, compliant services for the individuals we support. You’ll build and strengthen relationships with community partners, government agencies, advocacy groups, and other key stakeholders while overseeing financial performance, program development, and operational excellence. In this role, you’ll help expand our impact while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Strategic Leadership & Business Growth: Develop and implement strategic, programmatic, and fiscal initiatives to drive business growth, operational excellence, and expansion into new markets.
• Program Quality & Compliance: Oversee the development, evaluation, and continuous improvement of programs and services while ensuring compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, licensing requirements, and quality standards.
• Financial & Operational Oversight: Lead budget development, resource allocation, and financial performance management while maintaining accountability for profit and loss (P&L) outcomes.
• Leadership & Team Development: Hire, coach, mentor, train, and supervise up to six direct reports while fostering professional development, accountability, and staff retention.
• Business Development & Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective business partners, government representatives, advocacy groups, trade associations, and other key stakeholders.
• Performance Management & Reporting: Monitor key performance indicators, service metrics, compliance measures, and operational outcomes, providing regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Community & Industry Representation: Represent Dungarvin at community events, legislative meetings, industry forums, and other stakeholder engagement opportunities.

MUST HAVE:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a human services field, such as Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, Educational Psychology, Sociology, or Human Services.
• IDD Industry Experience: 7–8 years of experience in the human services industry, specifically supporting individuals with developmental and intellectual disabilities.
• Senior Leadership Experience: 5 years of progressive senior-level management experience.
• Program Experience: Experience overseeing supportive living, waiver sites, residential group homes, and/or day programs.
• Financial Management & P&L: Strong financial management and budgeting experience with budgets exceeding $30 million, including personal accountability for profit and loss (P&L).

NICE TO HAVE:

• Advanced Education: Master’s degree in a related field.
• Indiana Systems & Medicaid Waivers: Previous experience working with Indiana’s service systems and Medicaid Waiver programs.
• ICF Experience: Experience overseeing Intermediate Care Facilities (ICFs) serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).

SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:

• Strategic & Financial Leadership: Leads large teams, manages significant budgets, maintains P&L accountability, and connects operational decisions to business goals and organizational growth.
• Leadership & Team Development: Builds cohesive teams through transparency, integrity, direct communication, employee development, and a strong culture of accountability.
• Relationship Building & Industry Engagement: Collaborates effectively with peers, employees, state agencies, trade associations, and community partners to strengthen relationships and support business growth.
• Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance: Understands IDD service requirements, with strong ICF and Indiana Medicaid Waiver experience preferred, and ensures high standards of care, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.
• Problem Solving & Accountability: Identifies issues proactively, develops corrective action plans, ensures staff receive proper training, and addresses concerns directly to protect service quality and improve performance.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE:

Join a family-owned, values-driven company with a strong culture, supportive leadership, and a genuine commitment to its people. You’ll make a meaningful impact by partnering with leaders to strengthen teams, shape culture, and drive business growth. Be part of a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, professional growth, and shared learning, where your contributions are valued and your work makes a difference.

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. jobs.title: Principal Analog Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Architect, design and verify CMOS analog blocks for custom ASICs to meet stringent performance, area, power and timeline constraints. Blocks include Tx, Rx, PLL and miscellaneous high-precision analog circuits.

Responsibilities:

• DDR I/O Design: Develop and optimize high-speed DDR I/O interfaces, ensuring signal integrity, noise immunity, and compatibility with industry standards.
• Principal Liaison: Liaise between Analog Design Team and Verification/Validation/Test teams.
• Analyze Si ATE/Bench data against product spec. Use Excel/MATLAB/scripts to efficiently parse through large data set extracting actionable information.
• Collaboration: Work closely with digital design engineers, systems engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of analog and digital components.

• Innovation: Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies. Propose and implement innovative solutions to enhance product performance and capabilities with focus on low power circuit design.
• Circuit Reliability: Ensure designs meet EM/IR/Aging requirements.
• Layout: Ensure layouts meet high analog standards for matching and performance.

• Advanced degree in Electronics/Microelectronics Engineering or related discipline.
• 10-15 years of analog circuit design experience.
• Expertise in high-speed DDR I/O interface design and optimization - emphasis on DDR5/DDR6 IO architecture, Client/Data Center Server circuits and system design, validation.
• In-depth knowledge of analog Rx/Tx design, including signal integrity and noise immunity.
• Proficiency with analog design tools (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Maestro, Spectre, HSPICE) and simulation techniques.
• Strong understanding of signal integrity.
• Strong understanding of general analog design principles and methodologies.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, School Operations
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

About the Role

The Senior Associate, School Operations, is an experienced professional who serves as a critical driver for systems and continuous improvement across the network. Reporting directly to the Leader of School Operations Process Improvement, you will be responsible for the seamless development, execution, and continuous iteration of core operational programs and policies that ensure a high bar of quality and consistency across all our schools.

This role requires a blend of specialized program management skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. You will be the primary point person for translating strategic operational priorities into clear, actionable, and consistently executed standard work for our school-based operations teams, directly impacting areas such as school safety, quality assurance, technology integration, and financial compliance.

Key Responsibilities

The Senior Associate will own and drive the following core workstreams and responsibilities:

• Operational Program Management & Scaling: Lead the end-to-end management of critical network-wide operations programs Own the development, maintenance, and dissemination of core operational standard work and playbooks Manage operational deliverables communicated to schools via the project management platform (Trello), ensuring clear guidance, timely publishing, and consistent follow-up on completion rates.

• Systems and Technology Implementation: Partner closely with the Technology team (CX Tech, SIS) to support the network-wide rollout of operational technology enhancements. Design and document system improvements to streamline and automate school-based processes, ensuring technology platforms reduce administrative burden and enhance efficiency.

• Policy and Compliance Oversight: Drive cross-functional initiatives to codify and clarify network policies with operational implications. Analyze and report on school compliance and performance against operational metrics. Act as the Operations point-of-contact in cross-functional meetings, ensuring operational systems align with requirements from network partners.

• Data Analysis & Quality Assurance: Conduct data collection, analysis, and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality metrics. Prepare and present executive memos and resources that summarize program results, trends, and next steps for school leadership and network partners.

Qualifications

• A minimum of 2-3 years of professional experience in project/program management, operations, or a related highly analytical role. Experience in an education or high-growth environment is preferred.

• Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects from concept to launch, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and drive high-quality outcomes.

• Expert-level attention to detail and organizational skills, particularly in developing clear, rigorous standard work, policies, and system documentation.

• Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, comfortable working with compliance data, performance metrics, and system usage reports.

• Exceptional communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate technical, policy, and compliance changes to diverse audiences.

• Ability to work independently with minimal guidance and effectively manage multiple competing priorities.

• Proficiency with project management and data analysis tools (e.g., Trello, Salesforce, Excel/Google Sheets).

Compensation, Benefits, & Perks

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

• Day-One Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.

• Financial Security: 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.

• Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.

• Perks & Stipends: A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. This position is not bonus eligible.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response (SOC)
jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

We're maturing Information Security's detection, incident response, and forensics capabilities, and we're looking for a seasoned SOC engineer to help lead that effort alongside the existing team. This is a hands-on role spanning monitoring, triage, response, and forensics, with real ownership over how the program evolves from here.

What you'll do:

• Own Detection & Monitoring: Own how we monitor and triage events and alerts ingested into the SIEM, working with the team to tune detection content, reduce false positives, and close coverage gaps.

• Build the Playbooks: Lead the design and continuous improvement of incident response playbooks, so response is consistent and repeatable across the team, even when you're not the one running it.

• Threat Hunt: Lead our threat hunting practice, proactively hunting for malicious or anomalous activity that alerting and automated detection don't catch.

• Mature Forensics Capability: Strengthen our digital forensics capability, including the processes and tooling that support investigations and evidence handling.

• Automate the Response: Drive automation for alerting, enrichment, and triage across the team's workflows to cut manual toil and reduce time to respond.

• Respond to Incidents: React to and lead response on incidents as they fire, coordinating across business partners as needed.

• Document and Learn: Document incidents, root cause, and remediation with clarity and rigor.

• Own Post-Incident Reviews: Build a structured, blameless post-incident review process, with real root-cause analysis, action items tracked to closure, and follow-through that goes beyond a debrief call.

jobs.title: Market Manager
jobs.location: Washington, United States, California, United States
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Manager, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimization of host entrepreneurs and professional hosts in your assigned territory. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimize their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Market Manager, you will be responsible for the growth of a book of business in your assigned territories by managing professional host accounts and supply acquisition of high quality inventory. You will build Airbnb’s strong market presence in your assigned region in collaborating with other teams as the local in-market expert. As someone who knows the Airbnb mission and values inside out, you will drive all phases of supply acquisition and market success from acquisition strategy development to strategic partner relationship management. You will help develop and iterate scalable, localized supply strategies in your territory aiming to secure our long-term success.

A Typical Day:

• Build and manage partner relationships within assigned territory

• Directly manage accounts to meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales goals

• Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and action on strategic opportunities in your region to drive increase in sales

• Prospect and onboard new, high quality supply in your assigned geography

• Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integration of various software partners so that you can provide the right support to your clients

• Represent Airbnb in external meetings with Professional Hosts and at industry conferences in your market

• Educate clients on all significant product changes, and cascade feedback on product and policy to the relevant internal stakeholders — including staying current on evolving Canadian short-term rental regulations at the federal, provincial, and municipal levels

• Hold regular optimization calls and business reviews with your partners

• Develop strong and long lasting partnerships

• Develop deep knowledge of your assigned geographic markets and become the go-to source for all information relating to local trends and market dynamics for internal and external partners

• Respond to and deliver exceptional service to your professional hosts in a timely and efficient manner, occasionally traveling to your market to provide in-person support and guidance

• Work cross-functionally with product, communications, public policy and customer support teams to ensure our long-term market success.

Your Expertise:

• 6+ years of experience in new sales, account management, and partner support, showcasing a deep understanding and capability in fostering business relationships.

• 2+ years of tech/travel industry experience is a plus, highlighting the value of sector-specific knowledge.

• Proven track record of being able to effectively work a leads pipeline and a book of business, demonstrating expertise in nurturing and converting potential opportunities.

• Proficient quantitative skills and proven ability to interpret and apply data throughout your day-to-day work, emphasizing the importance of data-driven decision-making.

• The ability to work at both strategic and tactical levels, with a proven track record to execute in ambiguous environments, highlighting adaptability and strategic foresight.

• Proven experience working cross-functionally, ensuring the ability to collaborate effectively with various teams to drive collective success.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with clients via phone, email, and in-person, underscoring the importance of strong interpersonal skills.

• Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient, paired with strong time management and prioritization skills, showcasing the initiative and organizational capabilities required for the role.

• Highly proficient in using CRM software, specifically in working with leads, opportunities, and other core objects - Salesforce experience is a plus, indicating the technical tools proficiency needed for effective relationship management.

• Washington or California and must be willing to regularly travel to your assigned territory. Typical expectation would be once every quarter.

• Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy - being an Airbnb host is a plus, culminating the profile with a personal alignment and enthusiasm for the company's mission and sector.

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Washington or California to be able to conduct their work. Currently, employees can not be located in: Alaska, Indiana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Delaware And Rhode Island. This list is continuously being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list.  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$111,000—$123,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager - Sierra Leone
jobs.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

About the Role

The Quality Assurance Manager will work closely with Imagine’s Director of Technical Services and local implementing partners to fulfill several areas of responsibility. The first area is quality assurance of the learning software - Learning Content Provider’s software for Android and iOS . The QA Manager will work with our partner Learning Content Provider and global technology team to test new child-facing activities locally, providing feedback to help improve and iterate with them. They will be required to source, manage and support a team of adhoc testers during major software releases. The second area of quality assurance is targeted A/B experiments conducted on learners as test new or improved versions of the software, and collecting data before rolling out across all schools. The other area of responsibility is quality assurance of the data collection and monitoring systems installed in schools that provide oversight of our programs. This includes testing for and identifying failure points in the system and troubleshooting. The Quality Assurance Manager’s responsibilities will include - but will not be limited to the following:-

Key Responsibilities

Technology Quality Assurance

• Design, implement, conduct and oversee testing and quality assurance processes for Learning Content Provider’s software or any other software on an ongoing basis as well as during major software updates

• Setup and manage Imagine test labs in the office and various schools to support the quality assurance work and provide a showcase to funders and external stakeholders

• Functional testing of software including assessment of:

○ onecourse learning units (4000 per localisation) o for content errors, incorrect graphics or poor pronunciation and other unexpected behaviours

○ User experience and journey across adaptive learning sessions, correctness of adaptive algorithm outputs, navigation and menus of the software

○ Configuration and settings in terms of user profiles, switching languages, OTA update process, and other advanced settings

○ Data outputs from the software in terms of analytic data correctness

• Source and manage a team of testers on an adhoc basis before major software releases: ○ Ensure testers are adequately trained to conduct tests

○ Ensuring quality of issue reporting

○ Manage division of labour across testers

○ Tracking individual tester performance.

● Acting as a main local liaison with Learning Content Provider.

A/B Experimentation

• Design, implement and conduct testing processes for customized versions of software on learners in schools, against defined objectives

• Data collection and compilation from experiments to inform further decision-making and improvements

• Contribute to ideation and problem solving to enhance the learner experience and improve learning outcomes

• Testing device performance for various scenarios related to software updates

• Supporting global analytics team with collection of logs and related data from devices being used during program implementation

Data Quality Assurance

• Design, implement and conduct testing processes for data quality of data obtained from tablets, monitoring systems and other tools used to support the program

• Develop and implement strategies to ascertain data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, consistency, and integrity

• Develop and implement strategies to conduct data validation and cleansing where required

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field: Technology, Data Science, Quality Assurance

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in Technology, Software and Data Management

• Good knowledge of computer hardware and software

• Experience of both iOS and Android operating systems

• Experience of using Github issues or similar to report and triage bugs

• Mac OS experience is beneficial

Ideal Candidate Profile

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills

• Ability to work effectively in multicultural environments and teams

• Strong organization skills and superior attention to detail

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

• Ability to proactively manage and resolve conflicts

• Ability to prioritize and display a high level of adaptability/flexibility while handling job responsibility

Qualities

• Passion for Imagine’s mission and vision

• Demonstrated commitment to equity in educational access and outcomes

• Passion for project management

• Demonstrated ability to think independently and solve problems

• Collaborative team player; clear and proactive communicator

• Flexible, adaptable, and able to work in a fast-paced, changing environment

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Location

The Quality Assurance Manager must be based in Freetown, Sierra Leone, and will travel frequently within the country.

* * *
