jobs.title: Head of Mission Operations, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on leader to stand up and scale our Mission Operations function within AIS. As Head of Mission Operations, you will own the end-to-end operational success of our deployments — building and leading a team of Mission Operations Engineers while establishing the processes, standards, and playbooks that enable repeatable, high-quality delivery across a rapidly growing portfolio of IC programs. This role requires someone who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level: setting the vision for how we deploy, integrate, train, and support our products in the field while remaining close enough to the work to unblock problems in real time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build & Lead the Team: Recruit, develop, and manage a team of Mission Operations Engineers. Set clear expectations, drive accountability, and foster a high-performance culture rooted in mission focus and operational excellence.

• Define the Mission Ops Playbook: Establish scalable frameworks for system deployment, integration, operator training, and ongoing field support — turning what has been ad hoc execution into a repeatable, measurable discipline.

• Own Deployment & Operational Readiness: Oversee the technical configuration, deployment, and integration of systems across multiple programs, ensuring every site reaches full operational capability on time and to standard.

• Drive Operator Adoption & Training Strategy: Design and standardize training curricula for military, security, and tactical operators — ensuring consistency and quality as the team and customer base scale.

• Serve as the Voice of the Field: Aggregate operational feedback, deployment lessons learned, and real-world user requirements to influence product roadmap priorities and engineering investments.

• Build Strategic Customer Relationships: Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior military officers, IC stakeholders, and program leadership to drive adoption, uncover future mission needs, and shape account strategy.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Program Management, Engineering, Legal, and Business Development to ensure seamless delivery and alignment across the organization.

• Establish Metrics & Reporting: Define and track KPIs for deployment success, operator readiness, system uptime, and customer satisfaction to drive continuous improvement across the function.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven Leadership: Demonstrated experience building, scaling, and managing technical operations or field engineering teams in a defense, intelligence, or national security environment.

• Mission-First Mindset: You put the needs of the customer and the mission first. You are motivated by the opportunity to radically evolve national and allied defense capabilities.

• Operational & Technical Depth: Strong technical aptitude with hands-on experience in system deployments, software configuration, troubleshooting, IP networking, APIs, and data integration — credible enough to lead a team of engineers and earn the trust of customers.

• Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate organizational goals and customer needs into a clear operational strategy, then execute against it with discipline.

• Adaptability: You thrive in unstructured, fast-moving environments. You can context-switch between strategic planning and tactical problem-solving without missing a beat.

• Stellar Communication: Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to influence across all levels — from tactical operators to senior military leadership and internal executives.

• Collaboration & Low-Ego: You lead by example in a flat, fast-moving organization that values teamwork, action, and execution over hierarchy.

• Must be willing to travel up to 30%.

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior military service (tactical ops, signals, intelligence, or C2) with leadership experience.

• Track record of standing up or significantly scaling a field operations, mission support, or deployment function from early stage to mature operation.

• Experience designing and institutionalizing operator training programs at scale.

• Degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director of Nursing
jobs.description:
The Director of Nursing provides clinical leadership and oversight for Cambrian Homecare’s skilled nursing respite program, supporting individuals with developmental disabilities who receive nursing services in their homes. Working closely with operational leadership, this role helps ensure nursing services meet California regulatory requirements, clinical standards, and individual care needs.

This position focuses on supporting and overseeing field nurses, reviewing clinical documentation, monitoring care quality, and ensuring the program remains compliant and prepared for regulatory review. You’ll partner with nursing staff and operational leadership to address clinical questions, strengthen documentation practices, resolve concerns, and promote consistent, high-quality care.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

• Clinical Leadership & Nurse Support: Provide clinical oversight and guidance to field RNs and LVNs, independently evaluate clinical situations, answer clinical questions, support professional accountability, and address performance concerns when needed. Partner with operational leadership to resolve clinical concerns and support appropriate care delivery.
• Clinical Documentation & Quality Assurance: Review, develop, update, and maintain individualized plans of care, physician orders, medication profiles, nursing assessments, and other clinical records to ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Regulatory Compliance & Survey Readiness: Help maintain compliance with California Title 22 regulations, applicable state and federal requirements, and company policies. Monitor records and practices to support ongoing readiness for regulatory reviews.
• Care Coordination & Clinical Oversight: Support appropriate admissions, transfers, discharges, assessments, and care planning. Coordinate with physicians, clients, families, payers, and other healthcare partners to support continuity of care.
• Staff Development & Performance Management: Provide clinical guidance to field nurses, address performance concerns when necessary, and reinforce clinical standards and expectations. Build productive relationships with nursing staff while promoting accountability and quality care

MUST HAVE:

• Education & Experience: Meet at least one of the following qualification pathways:A bachelor’s degree or higher in nursing or a health-related field, at least three years of nursing experience within the last five years in a home health agency, clinic, or healthcare facility, and at least one year of supervisory experience; orAt least four years of experience in home-based healthcare or a healthcare facility, including at least one year of supervisory experience.
• Licensure: Graduate of an accredited school of nursing and maintain an active, clear California Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing.
• Leadership Experience: At least one year of supervisory experience.
• Transportation & Field Requirements: Valid driver’s license, dependable insured transportation, and the ability and willingness to independently conduct nursing assessments, supervisory visits, and clinical oversight activities in client homes throughout Los Angeles County.
• Health & Safety Requirements: Current CPR certification, required TB clearance, and the ability to meet applicable health and physical requirements of the role, including lifting, bending, squatting, and transferring clients as required.
• On-Call Availability: Ability to fulfill after-hours clinical on-call responsibilities and provide clinical guidance when needed.
• Microsoft 365 & Data Skills: Advanced Microsoft 365 skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).

NICE TO HAVE:

• Developmental Disabilities Experience: Strongly preferred experience supporting individuals with intellectual or developmental disabilities and their families in community-based or home-based service environments.
• Home-Based Services: Experience in home health, home care, respite services, or other community-based healthcare settings.
• Regional Center Experience: Familiarity with California regional center services and the systems supporting individuals with developmental disabilities.
• Quality & Compliance: Experience with clinical audits, regulatory reviews, documentation improvement, and corrective action.
• Bilingual Communication: English/Spanish bilingual skills are a plus.
• Clinical Documentation: Experience reviewing nursing notes, assessments, physician orders, care plans, and clinical records.

SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:

• Clinical Judgment & Oversight: Independently evaluate clinical situations, provide guidance to field nurses, address clinical concerns, and make sound nursing decisions while recognizing when escalation is necessary and partnering with operational leadership on non-clinical matters.
• Documentation & Regulatory Compliance: Maintain accurate clinical records, orders, and care plans; follow up on physician signatures and assessments; and support ongoing compliance and survey readiness.
• Communication, Emotional Intelligence & Accountability: Build positive relationships with field-based nursing staff and healthcare partners, communicate expectations clearly, navigate team dynamics with professionalism and sound judgment, address performance concerns appropriately, and foster a collaborative work environment while maintaining accountability.
• Relationship Building & Influence: Demonstrated ability to build trust with field-based nursing staff, foster collaboration, gain cooperation, and hold clinicians accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
• Organization & Follow-Through: Track outstanding documentation and clinical requirements, prioritize tasks, and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
• Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Learn Cambrian’s skilled nursing respite model and established processes, adapt to the needs of the program, and identify opportunities for improvement.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB:

As Director of Nursing, you’ll play an important role in ensuring quality care for individuals with developmental disabilities while building meaningful, long-term relationships with clients, families, and nursing staff. You’ll contribute to a stable, established program where consistency, collaboration, and continuity of care make a lasting difference.

Unlike traditional home health, Medicare-focused home health, or high-intensity acute care environments, this role offers a primarily office-based work environment focused on clinical oversight, nursing support, documentation, and regulatory compliance. Travel is limited, with client home visits typically occurring a few times per month. This allows you to maintain meaningful connections with clients and nursing staff without the constant field travel and pace often associated with other healthcare settings.

This opportunity may be especially appealing to an experienced RN ready to transition from a demanding nursing leadership position into a more structured role where you can apply your clinical judgment, strengthen care quality, support your team, and make a meaningful impact on individuals and their families.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. jobs.title: Launch Fluids Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what’s already been done, this is where it happens.

About the Role:

• Responsible for the design, fabrication, operation, and maintenance of the launch pad and support facilities for Terran R

• Design launch pad propellant and gas infrastructure, to include fluid system design, modeling, pipe stress analysis, fabrication drawings, process and instrumentation diagrams, component lists, and detailed work instructions

• Supervise the construction activation & commissioning, and initial operations of these facilities

• Solve technically challenging problems across a variety of disciplines under varying programmatic pressures

About You:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field and minimum 2 years of combined engineering experience is required

• Experience in thermal and fluid analyses

• General experience with fluid components such as valves, regulators, and instrumentation

Nice to haves but not required:

• Experience safely operating complex fluid systems, including high pressure gas, cryogenic fluids, flammable liquids and gases, and hydraulics

• General knowledge of launch vehicle ground support equipment and operations, including cryogenic tanks, pumps, valves, instrumentation, or related experience

• Fundamental understanding with ANSYS and other piping analysis software (Caesar, Bentley Autopipe, etc.)

• Experience Working with DOD, USAF, and NASA personnel

• Able to work in high pressure environments and meet aggressive deadlines

• Demonstrated problem solving and critical thinking skills as well as demonstrated customer service excellence and ability to communicate highly effectively in verbal/written form with internal and external customers

Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

jobs.title: Americas Regional EHS Manager

As Americas Regional EHS Manager the primary responsibility is to manage the environmental, industrial, health, and safety regulation compliance for Smiths Detection Americas. Ensures compliance with federal, state, and local regulations pertaining to environmental safety and handles all contact with appropriate agencies. Oversees licensed hazardous and radioactive waste disposal and monitors waste handling. Develops and supervises company training programs for employees in areas such as compliance training, lab/plant inspection, hazardous material handling, emergency response, industrial hygiene, and life safety. Maybe the point of contact for emergency personnel and management of workers' compensation program administration. Ensures appropriate corrective action is taken where health and safety hazards exist.

• Provide leadership and guidance on HSE&R-related matters, serving as a subject matter expert and championing a safety culture throughout the organization.

• Manage and track regional Key Performance Indicators and drive improvements toward goals.
• Support problem resolution and provide leadership and guidance for the site and field HSE teams.
• Ensure the timely & accurate reporting of HSE&R performance data and incidents.
• Ensure that site-specific environmental targets are met and challenged for improvement.
• Provide analysis and trending information for the Smiths Detection Global HSE Director.
• Provide business leadership and global Smiths Detection HSE leader with analysis of trends and drivers of environmental metrics.

• Plan and direct HSE activities and programs; establish priorities for project execution based on site resources and the cost of implementation.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Authentic is a tech-enabled MGA (managing general agent). We design and run insurance programs for specific kinds of businesses, like restaurants, gyms, and power producers. Brokers bring us the businesses that need coverage, and carriers back our policies. Every program runs on a platform we built ourselves, and we own every line of code behind it. Engineers and insurance experts build it side by side in New York and Dayton, Ohio. Since our founding in 2022, we’ve grown to 80+ people and been named to the 2026 CB Insights Insurtech 50.

The Role

We are looking for a high-agency generalist to join as our first Strategy & Operations hire. Our rapid growth over the past year has created a substantial opportunity to bring structure and automation to our core business processes. You will take ownership of some of our most pressing operational challenges, solve problems across teams, and help build the technology and systems that will allow our business to scale with best-in-class efficiency.

What You'll Do

• Own the outcomes - starting with financial operations, you will own the core workflows and KPIs across payments, collections, reconciliation, reporting, compliance, and more. Understand where things break down, set priorities, and drive measurable improvements.

• Build technology to increase efficiency - use the subject matter expertise you develop to serve as a product lead, identifying the highest-impact opportunities, defining what we should build, and working with engineering to turn manual workflows into software and agents that create operating leverage.

• Build repeatable processes - establish clear owners, handoffs, and documentation so routine work runs reliably without requiring you to manage every step.

• Drive cross-functional execution - work with GMs, Finance, and other teams to resolve complex issues. Get the right people involved, make decisions, and carry solutions through to completion.

Who You Are

• 2-4 years of experience in a high-intensity environment like investment banking, consulting, private equity, venture capital, or startups.

• Proactive - you don't wait for explicit instructions. You seek out problems, scope solutions, and drive them to resolution with minimal oversight.

• Low ego - you have no problem rolling up your sleeves to do whatever it takes to help the business win. No task is beneath you.

• Wants ownership and responsibility - being fully responsible for an outcome gives you energy. You're someone who wants to choose the approach and be accountable for the result.

• Reliable - you follow through on commitments and consistently deliver. You are known as someone who never drops the ball.

• Self-sufficient and a quick learner - you are resourceful and naturally try to figure things out before asking for help. You pick things up quickly and can find solutions to problems without an existing playbook.

Why This Role

• Set the foundation - as our first Strategy & Operations hire, you will help define the function, how it works with each team, and what good looks like. You’ll have the opportunity to create the playbook, so what you build becomes the standard.

• Room for growth - you will have significant opportunities to expand your scope, take on more responsibility, and own more of the product roadmap as you build expertise and deliver results.

• Define AI-native operations - you will be on the frontlines of figuring out how to build software and leverage AI to fundamentally improve the economics of running a tech-enabled services business.

Compensation

This role pays a base salary of $130,000-$160,000 and includes meaningful equity, so you’ll have real ownership in what we’re building. Your offer will depend on your experience and skills.

Our (FTE) benefits

• Competitive salary, equity, and role trajectory

• Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

About Authentic

Authentic builds the infrastructure that program insurance runs on. We partner with leading brokerages to design and manage custom insurance programs, backed by A and A- rated carriers operating nationwide. Brokers bring the data and distribution. We bring everything else: the technology, the capacity, and the underwriting expertise to stand up specialized programs at speed and build them to last.  We’re a Series A company backed by top investors, including FirstMark Capital, Zigg Capital, Slow Ventures, Clocktower, Commerce Ventures, and Altai. We’ve grown over 15x in the past year with a massive market opportunity ahead.

Authentic is committed to building an inclusive working environment regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race, education, age, or other personal characteristics. We believe that people do their best work when they can be themselves, and different perspectives and experiences make us stronger as a team. We’re proud of the supportive and inclusive workplace we're building together and are always working to make it even better.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - A&D
jobs.description:
About our Aerospace & Defense business

Our Aerospace & Defense business helps the world’s leading airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators keep complex fleets and platforms mission-ready — managing the full maintenance, asset and service lifecycle at scale. We are reimagining how that software is built and delivered around AI, and we are investing in engineering leaders who can put AI to work both inside our products and in how we build them.

About the role

As Director of Engineering for our Defense solutions, you lead the engineering teams that build software for the U.S. defense operators who keep their fleets and platforms mission-ready. You are an engineer first and a people manager second, and we mean both halves. This is a player-coach role: you carry the technical depth of a Principal Engineer or Architect, you guide architectural decisions and set the technical bar, and you take direct responsibility for hiring, developing and retaining the engineers on your teams.

Your teams are autonomous and own the full delivery lifecycle — design, development, testing, deployment and operations — with a you-build-it, you-run-it mindset. You make sure they have the clarity, context and conditions to deliver great work, in a domain where reliability, security and compliance are not optional. You stay close to the work: you join design reviews, weigh architectural trade-offs, unblock hard technical problems, and use the same engineering practices and AI tools your teams use every day.

AI fluency is central. You will drive AI adoption across your teams, from AI-assisted development workflows that accelerate delivery to AI-powered product capabilities that create customer value. This is not about hype. It is about making AI a practical, embedded part of how your teams work and what they ship, including in environments with strict data-handling and deployment constraints.

This is not a role for managers who have left the code behind.

What you’ll do

• Lead and grow engineers. Hire, onboard, coach and develop software engineers across the full career ladder, from associate through senior lead. You measure your success by the growth and output of your teams.
• Be the technical leader. Participate in architecture reviews, guide technology choices, and set the technical bar for the Defense solutions portfolio. You can read, review and reason about production code, and your engineers trust your judgment because you have earned it.
• Own delivery outcomes. Ensure your teams deliver high-quality software at a sustainable pace, balancing technical quality with business and mission value.
• Drive engineering excellence. Ensure teams follow modern practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure as code and secure-by-default design, including the supply chain, hardening and accreditation expectations of defense customers.
• Champion AI fluency. Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across your teams. Make sure your engineers can build and validate AI-powered product features, from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic architectures to evaluation harnesses, and foster a culture where AI is a practical tool with responsible guardrails.
• Remove obstacles. Resolve cross-team dependencies, shield teams from organizational noise, and keep engineers focused on what matters.
• Partner across the business. Work closely with Product Management, Design, Architecture and senior leadership to align technical execution with product strategy, and engage directly with defense customers in technical discussions, workshops and co-creation.
• Shape engineering culture. Foster continuous learning, healthy debate and ownership. Help engineers find and grow deep specialisms such as front-end, back-end, data engineering, applied AI, platform and SRE, and security.

What you’ll bring

Essential

• Technical depth: significant experience in software engineering, with a track record of operating at Principal Engineer or Architect level — system design, cross-team architectural thinking and technology strategy.
• People leadership: proven experience managing and developing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management and career development, with a coaching mindset.
• Modern engineering foundations: strong hands-on background in cloud-native architectures, microservices, API-first design, CI/CD, containerization and infrastructure as code, and proficiency in one or more modern languages (e.g., Go, Python, Java, C#, TypeScript).
• AI fluency: hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools, an understanding of AI/ML integration patterns (RAG, agents, prompt engineering, evaluation), and a track record of driving AI adoption within engineering teams.
• Full-lifecycle ownership: experience leading teams that own development, testing, deployment and production operations.
• Communication: the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to translate business and mission needs into engineering direction.
• Eligibility: based in the United States and able to meet the eligibility requirements for U.S. defense work for this requisition.

Nice to have

• Experience delivering software to defense, government or other regulated customers, including security accreditation, restricted or disconnected networks, and controlled-data handling.
• Experience in enterprise software or SaaS product development at scale.
• Experience building or leading teams that ship AI-powered product capabilities — MLOps pipelines, AI safety and governance practices, or AI evaluation frameworks.
• Experience working in or with Aerospace & Defense organizations, or on solutions for asset, maintenance, MRO or fleet-readiness management.
• Background across multiple engineering disciplines (e.g., front-end and back-end, or platform and application development).
• Experience with event-driven architectures, message brokers and streaming platforms.
• Track record of modernizing legacy systems or migrating to cloud-native architectures.
• Familiarity with security practices (OWASP, threat modeling, security tooling in CI/CD).
• Experience with organizational design — team structures, team topologies and scaling engineering organizations.

What we’re looking for in you

• You are technically deep, and your ambition is to multiply the impact of others, not just your own.
• You lead with context, not control. You set direction and trust your teams to execute.
• You are comfortable with healthy tension and constructive debate, and you optimize for better decisions rather than comfortable meetings.
• You are AI-native. You use AI tools in your own work and are energized by helping others do the same.
• You stay curious and expect the same from your teams.
• You have grit. You navigate ambiguity, remove blockers and keep teams moving forward.

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

What We’re Offering

• Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday
• Medical, dental, & vision insurance
• 401K with Company contribution
• Flexible spending accounts
• Life insurance and disability benefits
• Tuition assistance
• Community involvement and volunteering events

jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Mobile Wave Solutions is a professional services company specialising in software development as a service. We are committed to delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients. With a growing team of over 120 engineers and a mission to empower businesses globally, we provide expert teams to deliver robust solutions and drive innovation.

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer for an exciting opportunity with a client in the fintech industry, working on innovative solutions to enhance customer experiences and streamline financial services. This role offers the chance to contribute to cutting-edge technology projects in a fast-paced, impactful environment.

As a Senior Android Engineer, you will develop innovative Android applications and play a key role in mobile architecture and design, delivering outstanding user experiences. We expect engineers to demonstrate curiosity, passion, and a proactive mindset, with strong skills in algorithms, problem-solving, and building scalable, resilient, and crash-free Android applications. Effective communication is an attribute we care deeply about, as you and your team will collaborate in a fast-paced engineering environment to achieve outstanding results.




DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Architect, design, build, and deliver world-class Android applications.

 - Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code following Android development best practices.

 - Learn, grow, and mentor other engineers through code reviews and pair programming to accelerate their technical mastery.

 - Challenge existing team processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

 - Contribute to and promote engineering standards and best practices, making a positive impact across the team.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in software development.

 - 4+ years of professional experience in Android development.

 - Experience architecting, designing, building, and delivering high-quality Android applications.

 - Strong knowledge of the Android SDK and the Android application development ecosystem.

 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin and experience writing idiomatic, readable, and maintainable code.

 - Solid understanding of Android architecture patterns, design principles, and SOLID principles.

 - Experience customizing Android UI components, navigation, transitions, lists, and complex layouts.

 - Proven track record of designing and implementing high-quality, reliable, and crash-free Android applications.

 - Practical experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with asynchronous operations.

 - Experience with dependency injection, modularization, and building maintainable application architectures.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a good understanding of algorithms and data structures.

 - Experience working with agile methodologies and collaborative software development practices.

 - Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


ADVANTAGES

 - Experience designing and building highly reliable Android applications that serve millions of users.

 - Good understanding of Jetpack Compose and modern Android UI development.

 - Experience with Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, and reactive programming.

 - Experience with Android testing strategies, including unit, integration, and UI testing.

 - Experience with Gradle, build optimization, and CI/CD pipelines for Android applications.

 - Experience with Google Play Console and the application release process.

 - Experience with GraphQL.

 - Experience in the FinTech industry.

 - Experience in consumer lending or credit card issuing.




OUR BENEFITS

jobs.title: Temporary Housekeeping Manager

• Comply with all hotel and departmental standards, policies and procedures

• Must have “hands on” approach
• Must maintain composure at all times and work objectivity in stressful, high-pressure situations
• Ability to approach all encounters with guests and employees in a professional manner
• Ability to answer all general inquiries in the Hotel and F & B outlet
• Must be a good listener and be able to follow instructions

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Client Strategy Influencer
jobs.description:
About Collectively:

Collectively - part of the Brandtech Group (formerly You & Mr. Jones) -  is the global leader in influencer marketing; combining strategy, creative, and technology to deliver the most innovative influencer work. We partner with forward-thinking brands in technology, fashion, retail, gaming, entertainment, consumer goods, and more to build deeply integrated social activation strategies that drive relevance, awareness, and sales. Our work has been recognized by top publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Fast Company, Digiday, AdAge, and Business INSIDER, among others. We’ve also earned Effie, Webby, Glossy, IMA Fast Company, and OMMA awards for our programs.

Collectively is known across the industry as the partner who delivers the most creative, strategic, and effective programs, with the most sophisticated analysis and paid social offerings. But most importantly, we’re known to be genuinely committed partners to our clients, many of whom have worked with us for multiple years. We aspire to continue to provide an excellent workplace for our teams while delivering the industry’s most ambitious and thoughtful influencer collaborations. In 2020, we were named by Built In Bay Area as one of the Best Small Companies to work for.

About the Client Partnerships Team

The Client Partnership team leads the strategic and relationship side of our influencer marketing services agency throughout the lifecycle of an account at Collectively–ensuring our partnership with clients is successful, industry-leading, and directly in support of our clients’ creator marketing ambitions.

This team is focused on cultivating and growing successful relationships with account stakeholders in our client community through best-in-class work and services–delivering strategic influencer marketing proposals/RFPs, industry-leading thought partnership and ongoing strategic direction throughout the lifecycle of our agency/client partnership to support brands in becoming more effective, innovative, creator-centric marketers.

Responsibilities

This role leads the day-to-day account and strategy workflows for up to 5 brands on average, and plays a critical role in ensuring our creator marketing solutions and strategies are applied practically to our clients' businesses.

The Sr. Manager of Client Strategy will report directly to a Director or Sr. Director of Client Strategy & Account Leadership and be responsible for the following:

Program + Partnership Development (RFPs/Briefings)

Lead the approach to proposal development or response to briefs at Collectively, including:

• Brief Intake & Research:

• Digest and understand client RFPs/briefs

• Conduct and synthesize relevant research & insights to shape strategy recommendations

• Synthesize or draw on key trends and information from a variety of sources, including internal data, to inform conversations and RFP/brief responses

• Ensure historic account or agency-wide performance data and current trends/best practices are considered

• Strategy & Ideation

• Ideate RFP response with your account leader

• Develop and articulate influencer campaign and creator strategies (via outlines & slides) based on RFP/brief goals, incorporating best practices and agency benchmarks

• Curate a range of influencer campaign elements or services from Collectively

• Frame agency partnership/account management approaches

• Proposal Development

• Build and recommend budgets against plans/RFPs

• Work with Operations + Leadership to finalize scopes and staff plans

• Project manage specialized creative or analytical support for RFPs/briefs as needed

• Project Management & Delivery

• Project manage responses cross-functionally, start to finish

• Lead the timeline of the response and coordinate pitch strategy with key leadership stakeholders

• Coordinate and host briefings; prep materials and background for client meetings (agendas, cross-functional questions, follow-ups)

• Lead client comms directly or indirectly in support of your Account Leader

• Innovation:

• Experiment with and prepare and present POVs/best practices for existing & emerging platforms: (i.e., podcasts, TikTok, etc.)

Program Delivery (Campaigns, Servicing)

• Setting the Revenue Delivery teams up for success from IKO through Wrap to ensure the “strategic threads” are maintained during account moments, including internal kick-offs, client kick-offs/discovery, client presentations, and wraps

• Leads/Hosts client status meetings, creating a warm and friendly environment, and supporting the Revenue Delivery team in communicating program updates, challenges, and recommendations

• Supports the strategic vision and goals of accounts in partnership with the Director or Senior Director by providing guidance, contributions, and feedback on core deliverables:

• Assist the Revenue Delivery team in responding to program and strategy shifts, helping to ensure projects are aligned with client objectives and best practices, escalating challenges to leadership for input

• Identify opportunities to optimize/upsell or pivot based on performance, trends, or client needs, including development of new materials or workflows in partnership with leadership

• For Trend Marketing scopes, support or consult in the identification and alignment of trend spotting or social conversations on TikTok or Instagram that might be appropriate for clients to engage/brief creators on

Reporting & Analytics (Campaign Reports, Partnership Reports, QBRs)

• Partner with the Analytics team to develop hypotheses for content performance and ensure set-up and early measurement

• During internal wrap development, responsible for shaping the story & narrative of program performance, assessing learnings to cultivate strategic insights for optimizations and evolutions, trends, or learnings that drive more creator marketing programming through Collectively services

• Engage with your account leader on opportunities to translate learnings into longer-term relationships or revenue growth

• Develop an understanding and fluency with creator-paid media, brand lift studies and how those tactics help communicate the effectiveness of influencer marketing

• Leads/Hosts client reporting meetings, creating a warm and friendly environment, and supporting IRL meeting dynamics (hosting) as needed if applicable

Relationship Development & Client Service Modeling

• Conducts regular 1:1s or 2:1s (virtual or IRL) with clients either independently or with your leader to build trust, confidence, and partnership in agency relationship

• Bring a present and proactive eye to the working collaboration and dynamic between client and agency, spotting areas that feel off or clueing into client frustrations, experiences to surface to your account leader

• Help uncover what’s working, what’s not–and support plans of action internally to evolve and service effectively, supporting your Account Leader on service satisfaction and retention activities

• Synthesizes and communicates feedback between the client and the broader Collectively contributors and stakeholders

• Maintain up-to-date research on your brand accounts, including relevant trends, industries, competitors, and products, using a variety of research tools and social media consumption (platform content, social listening, press/journalism, community surveys, etc.)

• Leverage findings in conversations to connect broader opportunities for brand/agency revenue

Requirements

• Candidate must be located on the East Coast (New York Metro Area a plus)

• At least 5 years of direct experience in influencer marketing at an influencer agency, advertising agency or PR firm

• Both left and right-brain thinkers, equally comfortable with data and creative thinking

• Independent, critical thinker; comfortable putting ideas backed by rationale and V1s out there, then getting steers from colleagues and clients to refine the work

• Exceptional client servicing skills and instincts; loves to develop strong relationships with clients

• Strong organization skills with attention to detail and excellent follow-through

• Great communication skills—both internally and externally, written and verbal

• Ability to work efficiently across a variety of tasks and manage time appropriately for projects

• Thrives in the “undefined” and enjoys fast-changing, fast-paced working environments

• Collaborative working style with positive attitude and enthusiasm for making great work happen!

Key Performance Indicators

• Contributes exceptional and innovative work to assigned accounts by supporting our teams in delivering above & beyond client expectations

• Demonstrates curiosity with a desire to learn from program data, collaborator content, industry trends, and Collectively teammates

• Self-manages competing assignments and deadlines

• Goes above and beyond to deliver great work by thinking outside our process and pushing deliverables to be even stronger

• Exhibits a collaborative and solutions-focused approach

• Deftly navigates a variety of teams and personalities, creating a collaborative environment to foster great work

• Remains current on best practices and emerging trends (industry and cultural)

• Proactively seeks opportunities to improve client work

• Consistently supports and elevates strategy and thinking in key deliverables across client engagement phases to reflect best-in-class agency work

• Brings maturity and emotional regulation to more complex servicing environments, models Collectively Code behavior to junior staff on the team

• Is increasingly autonomous with more complex client scenarios and challenges

• Can support and contribute independently to departmental projects/task forces (e.g., supporting case studies, collaborating on a pilot or process evolution) with minimal impact to day-to-day role

Benefits & Team Member Experience

jobs.title: Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

THE ROLE

Care Coordinators are an important part of the operational engine of the Daymark Care Team. In this role, your primary responsibility is to ensure the right visits happen with our Nurse Practitioners and Registered Nurses at the right time, in the home or over video. You will also be a warm, reliable voice for patient communication and handle some of the administrative work that keeps care moving, such as medical records requests and faxing. This is a fast-paced, highly collaborative role for someone who takes pride in details and cares about the people behind every appointment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Schedule and manage in-home and virtual visits for the Nurse Practitioners and Registered Nurses you support, optimizing provider calendars and minimizing gaps. Handle on-the-fly scheduling adjustments due to cancellations or changes in patient or provider availability, ensuring continuity for the patients and proactive communication to the team.

• Coordinate with patients and caregivers to schedule, confirm, and reschedule visits, and to close the loop on missed appointments or overdue follow-ups. Support virtual visits by providing basic technical support to patients who may need assistance.

• Develop a working knowledge of your assigned patient panel, including clinical priorities, recent activity, and upcoming needs, and use it to prioritize visits, surface patient needs to providers, and conduct proactive outreach.

• Provide coverage for inbound patient calls resolving scheduling and logistical questions and warm-transferring other questions or concerns to the appropriate team member.

• Process medical records requests in line with HIPAA and Daymark policies, and send and receive faxes accurately and securely.

• Maintain a high standard of operational excellence, including clear documentation in our EHR and other systems, adherence to Daymark’s policies and procedures, and tracking and meeting any expected deadlines or productivity metrics.

• Work flexibly across the Care Team to support coverage and urgent needs as they arise.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience. 3+ years of experience in medical office administration, patient scheduling, care coordination, patient access, or a similar healthcare setting. Experience in oncology, home health, or a virtual care model is a plus.

• Calendar management savviness. You can juggle multiple calendars, competing priorities, and last-minute changes without losing track of the details all while remaining calm under the pressure. You think ahead about what each patient and provider will need.

• Communication Skills. You are warm, patient, and clear on the phone, including with patients and families who may be anxious or overwhelmed. You keep teammates in the loop, ask for help when you need it, and work well with clinical and non-clinical colleagues alike.

• Organized and detail-oriented. You are accurate with documentation, careful with protected health information, and comfortable with tasks like records requests and faxing that need to be done right.

• Bias to action. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You spot what needs attention, prioritize it, and make sure it gets done, and you know when to escalate.

• Comfort with technology. You are proficient with EHR systems and comfortable with Slack, Zoom, and the Google Suite. You pick up new tools quickly.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Compensation Range: $50,000 - $60,000 USD

Location: Fully onsite (5 days a week) in Providence, RI; 8:30am - 5:00pm.

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Rocket Travel by Agoda

Rocket Travel by Agoda is a travel technology company founded in 2012 under our flagship consumer facing product, rocketmiles.com. Since then, we have evolved to partner with some of the largest consumer travel brands in the world creating white-label solutions that allow customers to earn and redeem miles and points for booking hotels, rental cars, flights and activities. Our global partnerships range from world-class airlines to international banks to large-scale shopping platforms.  We help our partners develop successful go-to-market strategies through marketing expertise and data to support their overall growth.

We attract customers from every corner of the globe with a seamless user experience that's built in-house from ideation to finished product: our team includes front- and back-end developers, customer service, data analysts, designers, marketers, accountants, partnership sales, and managers.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career, and expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues. We encourage all applicants with a touch of wanderlust to apply to our team, as we work toward helping our travelers reach the vacation of their dreams.

As a Partner Manager at Rocket Travel, you will:

• Support the growth and performance of an Enterprise partnership in the Americas, combining strong relationship management with rigorous data analysis and commercial strategy.

• Analyze complex partner, customer, product, and financial data to identify trends, diagnose performance opportunities, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Turn data into a compelling story. Build partner-facing narratives that connect performance insights to specific actions, opportunities, and strategic priorities.

• Develop executive-level business reviews and partner presentations that simplify complex information, highlight the “so what,” and drive alignment around decisions and next steps.

• Identify the drivers behind partner performance, going beyond topline results to understand customer behavior, conversion, engagement, product performance, and commercial impact.

• Develop recommendations for campaigns, placements, and product improvements based on performance data, customer behavior, and experimentation.

• Proactively benchmark the competitive landscape to understand how partner products are positioned and identify new features, experiences, or opportunities for evaluation.

• Manage the partner marketing calendar and ensure customer service and other stakeholders are prepared for promotions and campaigns.

• Partner with Finance on billing reconciliation and use commercial and financial analysis to ensure the accuracy and health of partner economics.

• Be scrappy. We’re a small team and often wear many hats. Problems will not always arrive neatly defined. You will be expected to structure ambiguous questions, determine what the data is telling you, and turn those insights into action.

About you:

• You have a bachelor’s degree in business, data analytics, or a related quantitative or business field.

• You have 5+ years’ experience in advanced Excel, SQL and/or BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

• You are a strategic, analytical thinker who is comfortable working with large and complex datasets and turning them into simple, compelling business narratives.

• You understand how to summarize complex concepts and craft win-win strategies with partners.

• You are comfortable working with tools such as Excel and business intelligence/visualization platforms and can independently interrogate data rather than relying solely on pre-built reporting.

• You have impeccable attention to detail, taking end to end ownership and quality control in all projects.

• You are commercially minded and understand how customer behavior, product experience, marketing performance, and partner economics connect to overall business results.

• You are a strong communicator who can challenge, influence, and build credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations

• You balance analytical rigor with strong relationship management. You understand that the goal is not merely to report the data, but to use it to influence partner decisions and drive measurable growth

• You work well cross-functionally and are able to communicate effectively with others of varying backgrounds and areas of expertise.

Rocket Travel by Agoda is dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to reach new heights in their career. We encourage all applicants looking to expand their knowledge working alongside talented, dedicated colleagues to apply to our team.

Overview:

Job Title: Program Manager - DoD Enterprise IT Support Services

Security Clearance: Secret or Higher

Location: Quantico, Virginia - Primarily Onsite

Description:

C3EL seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead enterprise IT support services for the U.S. Marine Corps Education Command (EDCOM). This position will oversee network and systems operations, cybersecurity, help desk services, and audiovisual/video teleconferencing (AV/VTC) support across geographically dispersed Government locations.

The successful candidate will combine strong contract and personnel management with the technical judgment needed to maintain reliable services supporting military education and mission operations. We seek a leader who builds effective teams, resolves problems, and earns customer confidence through consistent performance.

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

• Serve as C3EL’s primary program interface with Government leadership, the contracting officer’s representative, and customer technical stakeholders.

• Lead an integrated team of network, systems, cybersecurity, help desk, and AV/VTC professionals.

• Manage staffing, recruiting, retention, personnel replacement, subcontractor performance, and coverage across multiple locations.

• Plan and execute task orders, aligning labor categories, hours, schedules, budgets, and deliverables with contract requirements.

• Monitor service availability, ticket performance, preventive maintenance, vulnerability remediation, and customer satisfaction.

• Direct coordination during outages, cybersecurity incidents, escalated support requests, and mission-critical events.

• Oversee transition activities, knowledge transfer, continuity planning, and maintenance of essential contractor services.

• Maintain program schedules, risk and issue registers, performance reports, and corrective action plans.

• Coordinate IT and AV/VTC support with instructional schedules, classroom requirements, and live events.

Minimum Qualifications:

• U.S. Citizenship.

• An active, in-scope US Government issued Secret clearance or higher.

• At least 12 years of progressively responsible IT experience, including five years managing DoD IT service delivery or a comparable technical support program.

• Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams across multiple locations.

• Experience managing contract performance, staffing, subcontractors, budgets, deliverables, and service-level commitments.

• Technical understanding sufficient to evaluate risks, guide technical leads, and communicate operational impacts across: Enterprise networks and structured cabling. Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, virtualization, storage, and backup/recovery. Hybrid cloud operations, preferably Microsoft Azure. Cybersecurity compliance, vulnerability remediation, and incident response. Help desk operations, ticket escalation, and service restoration. AV/VTC systems and their dependencies on enterprise IT infrastructure.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

• ITIL 4 Foundation or higher service management certification.

• Security+, CISSP, or another relevant cybersecurity certification.

• Experience leading programs with approximately 30–50 personnel, including geographically dispersed or overseas support.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Do you want to be the architect of a world-class employee journey, from the very first candidate interaction to the 90-day milestone?

...then you are our perfect match!

About the role:

As Manager, Deal Desk and Pricing at Everway, you'll be the senior commercial specialist responsible for how deals are structured, priced and governed across the business.

You'll own and evolve our pricing and discounting frameworks, deal approval processes and commercial benchmarks, helping Everway make consistent, commercially sound decisions that protect and grow annual recurring revenue (ARR).

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant functional accountability and influence across Sales, Renewals, Finance and Systems. You'll operate as a trusted commercial partner to revenue leadership, setting standards and guiding complex decisions without direct line-management responsibility.

You'll combine strategic ownership with practical involvement in complex deals, helping sellers navigate commercial decisions, improving pricing effectiveness and shaping the rules and benchmarks behind AI-assisted deal review and pricing guidance. You will also serve as the subject matter expert for pricing realization and associated ELT-level reporting.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

• Own Everway's commercial deal-governance framework, including pricing policies, discount thresholds, approval processes and escalation requirements.

• Set commercial pricing standards and benchmarks that support ARR growth, pricing consistency and long-term revenue performance.

• Guide complex deal structures, including multi-year agreements, ramps, renewals and non-standard commercial terms.

• Approve deals within agreed authority thresholds and provide recommendations to Finance and executive leadership on exceptions. ● Partner with Sales, Renewals, Finance and Product to shape pricing decisions, commercial policies and evolving pricing models.

• Act as a senior commercial expert, coaching sellers and sales managers on deal structuring, pricing decisions and negotiation approaches.

• Own pricing and discounting performance metrics, using commercial insights to identify trends and improve outcomes.

• Define the commercial rules, benchmarks and exception logic for AI-assisted deal review and pricing guidance, partnering with Systems on implementation.

• Improve deal approval processes, quoting accuracy and commercial consistency in partnership with Revenue Operations and Systems.

Essential Criteria:

• 5+ years of experience in deal desk, pricing, sales finance, revenue operations or SaaS commercial strategy, including advanced, high-impact commercial decision-making or pricing governance.

• Demonstrated expertise in recurring revenue pricing and complex commercial deal structures, including multi-year agreements, ramps, renewals, uplifts and indexation.

• Experience defining, maintaining or improving commercial pricing policies, discount frameworks and deal approval processes.

• Ability to evaluate complex commercial scenarios, make decisions within delegated authority and provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• Experience using pricing, discounting and commercial performance data to establish benchmarks, guide decisions and improve outcomes.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ or comparable quoting and approval systems, including the commercial rules and processes they support.

• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and coaching sales teams on commercial decisions without direct line-management authority. ● Ability to communicate complex commercial information clearly and work effectively across Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations and Legal.

Desirable Criteria

• Experience with per-unit or per-user pricing models, including introducing or evolving pricing structures.

• Familiarity with K–12 education or public sector procurement, including purchase orders and purchasing requirements.

• Experience with AI-assisted quoting, deal review or pricing guidance tools. Experience supporting commercial processes or systems changes across multiple sales teams.

jobs.title: Project Safety Advisor
jobs.description:
Job Description – Travelling Safety Advisor

Company: The PAC Group
Department: Global Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)
Programme: VAPR Projects – North America
Location: Field-Based / Multi-Site Travel
Reports To: Global EHS Leadership

This role requires extensive travel, with travel expected to account for more than 75% of the time.

Position Summary

The PAC Group is seeking a proactive, experienced and hands-on Travelling Safety Advisor to support the delivery of VAPR projects across North America.

The role will focus on contractor safety management, operational compliance, client requirements and effective stakeholder engagement, ensuring all activities are undertaken safely and in accordance with applicable OSHA regulations, client standards and PAC Group EHS expectations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing, monitoring and reinforcing established safety procedures rather than developing unnecessary new systems or processes. The emphasis is on practical field-level support, contractor accountability, early identification of risks and effective coordination with project and client leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Contractor Management and Site Safety

• Oversee contractor and subcontractor EHS compliance throughout project execution.

• Verify contractor onboarding, inductions, training, competencies and applicable safety documentation.

• Ensure daily pre-start meetings, toolbox talks and Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) are completed and effectively communicated.

• Conduct routine site inspections, safety observations and compliance assessments.

• Monitor contractor adherence to PPE requirements, safe working procedures and site behavioural standards.

• Identify unsafe conditions and behaviours, coordinate corrective actions and verify timely close-out.

• Exercise Stop Work Authority where activities present an unacceptable risk.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

• Act as the primary field-level EHS contact for PAC project teams, contractors and designated client representatives.

• Understand, communicate and implement applicable client EHS requirements and site-specific expectations.

• Maintain effective working relationships with client stakeholders, project managers and contractor leadership.

• Proactively communicate safety concerns, operational risks, emerging issues and corrective actions.

• Support client safety meetings, inspections, audits and project reviews.

• Escalate significant risks or compliance concerns to PAC Global EHS leadership in a timely manner.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management

• Ensure project activities comply with applicable OSHA regulations, state requirements and client safety standards.

• Review and verify the suitability of JHAs, risk assessments, method statements and relevant permits.

• Monitor high-risk activities, including electrical work, hazardous energy control (LOTO), lifting operations, working at height, mobile equipment and other project-specific hazards.

• Support incident and near-miss reporting, investigations and corrective action management.

• Verify that required safety documentation and compliance records are maintained accurately.

Project Delivery and Reporting

• Provide practical, solutions-focused EHS support to enable safe and efficient project delivery.

• Work closely with project leadership to integrate safety requirements into daily planning and execution.

• Produce concise safety updates, inspection findings and project EHS reports.

• Track outstanding actions and ensure timely resolution with responsible contractors and stakeholders.

• Identify opportunities to improve safety performance through existing PAC and client systems.

• Support mobilisation, demobilisation and transitions between project locations.

Qualifications and Experience

Required

• Minimum 3–5 years of relevant EHS experience in construction, industrial, manufacturing, installation or similar project environments.

• Demonstrable experience overseeing contractors and subcontractors.

• Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and practical workplace safety requirements.

• Experience conducting site inspections, reviewing JHAs and supporting incident investigations.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently across multiple project locations.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout North America.

• Valid driving licence and ability to meet applicable travel and site-access requirements.

Preferred

• OSHA 30-Hour Construction or General Industry training, as appropriate to project activities.

• Associate Safety Professional (ASP), Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or equivalent.

• Experience supporting multi-site projects, client-led programmes or contractor-intensive operations.

• Experience in vehicle modification, automotive, manufacturing or industrial installation environments.

Key Competencies

• Strong field presence and practical safety leadership.

• Contractor management and accountability.

• Effective client and stakeholder communication.

• Sound judgement and proactive risk identification.

• Ability to resolve issues without unnecessarily disrupting project delivery.

• Clear reporting, documentation and follow-through.

• Adaptability, professionalism and willingness to travel.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured through:

• Contractor compliance with PAC and client EHS requirements.

• Effective completion of daily pre-start briefings, JHAs and site inspections.

• Timely identification, escalation and closure of safety concerns.

• Quality of communication with client representatives and PAC leadership.

• Compliance with applicable regulatory and contractual obligations.

• Effective safety support contributing to successful project delivery.

Role Expectations

This is a practical, delivery-focused EHS position. The successful candidate is expected to utilise existing PAC Group and client safety frameworks, applying them consistently and effectively rather than reinventing established processes.

The priority is to maintain a visible site presence, manage contractor compliance, build strong client relationships, resolve issues proactively and ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with regulatory and contractual requirements.

The salary range for this position is dependent upon experience, education, and qualifications.

Pay Range

$45—$50 USD
