jobs.title: Interim Manager, Growth & Insights
jobs.description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too.

The Role:

As Manager, Growth & Insights, you will be responsible for turning consumer, category, and market intelligence into growth opportunities across Bobbie’s Infant Formula and New Ventures portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, innovation, commercialization, and go-to-market strategy, helping shape what we build, how we launch, and how we scale.

You’ll partner closely with Innovation, Marketing, Sales, Product Development, Finance, and external research partners to identify unmet consumer needs, validate innovation, size opportunities, develop commercialization strategies, and measure launch success.

This is an ideal role for someone who loves connecting data with storytelling, ramps up quickly, and enjoys making an immediate impact on in-flight work across the innovation lifecycle.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), temporary employee position for a 6-month term, providing coverage for a member of our team during a planned leave. The anticipated start date is mid-November. The end date may be adjusted based on business needs.

What you will accomplish:

Consumer, Category & Growth Insights

• Drive in-flight and planned consumer learning plans across infant formula and innovation platforms, from early discovery through post-launch optimization.

• Support qualitative and quantitative research, including concept testing, product testing, pricing, messaging, and usage studies.

• Monitor consumer, category, retailer, and competitive trends to identify growth opportunities and emerging whitespace.

• Build business cases, opportunity sizing, and market assessments to support innovation prioritization and commercialization decisions.

• Translate insights into actionable recommendations that shape product strategy, positioning, pricing, and go-to-market plans.

Commercialization & Go-to-Market

• Partner with Innovation, Marketing, Sales, and Product Development to develop commercialization strategies for new ventures.

• Support pricing architecture, pack strategy, assortment recommendations, and retailer launch strategies.

• Develop retailer-specific insights, selling stories, and commercialization materials.

• Establish launch success criteria and support go-to-market execution across cross-functional teams.

Growth Analytics & Brand Performance

• Maintain and execute the New Ventures measurement framework across consumer, commercial, and brand performance.

• Maintain and enhance KPIs and dashboards to track brand health, commercialization, retail performance, and innovation success.

• Analyze syndicated data (Circana, NIQ, SPINS), retailer performance, DTC metrics, and competitive trends.

• Partner with Marketing to evaluate campaign effectiveness and optimize messaging and brand performance.

• Measure launch performance, identify growth opportunities, and recommend course corrections.

• Deliver recurring business reviews and executive reporting with actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Serve as the insights lead across Innovation, Marketing, Sales, Product Development, and Finance.

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external research agencies and syndicated data partners.

• Influence strategic decisions through data-driven storytelling and executive presentations.

• Document progress, key decisions, and open items to ensure a seamless transition at the end of the assignment.

• Champion a consumer-first mindset across the New Ventures organization.

You’re inspired by our core values:

• Be Radical - We are change makers, rule breakers and stigma shakers. We are unapologetically bold and use our megaphone for good.

• Nurture the Tension - Parenthood is full of healthy tension, and so is building a company. We embrace the unknowns, practice humility and are a culture of learners.

• Deliver Ounce by Ounce - Our customers have entrusted us to feed their babies. We lose sleep over the details, so they don’t have to.

• Don’t Assume - We embrace our unique perspectives, withhold judgment, and find beauty in the paths that brought us all to Bobbie. Our strength is celebrating each other and our collective voice.

At Bobbie, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company. We seek to create a culture where everyone can belong because we believe that people do their best work when they can show up every day as their authentic selves. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Bobbie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.description:

Founded in 1846, today HP Hood is one of the largest and most trusted food and beverage manufacturers in the United States. Our portfolio of national and super-regional brands and licensed products includes Hood, Heluva Good, Lactaid, Blue Diamond Almond Breeze, Planet Oat and more.

Job Summary:

The Loading Dock Worker position has a variety of different assignments which are assigned based on the training level of the employee and business needs in support of achieving the goals of the Concord, NH Warehouse. This job description is meant to serve as an outline of the duties and responsibilities that a Loading Dock Worker may be required to perform during the course of their work-day.

Hours: 1:30pm to 10pm

Days off: Sunday and one rotating day off.

Essential Functions:

• Review load sheets for delivery routes and verify correct product(s) and amounts are loaded to assigned trailers.

• Rotate product in warehouse to ensure that the correct coded product is shipped to eliminate waste and minimize returns.

• Continuously check for and remove damaged goods to ensure that only quality product is being shipped to customers.

• Load each product according to assigned specification/diagram safely using a variety of motorized equipment such as pushers, squeeze trucks, fork trucks and pallet jacks. Ensure that the proper load bars are in place and the loads are evenly distributed.

• Send loads that are accurate while maintaining a pace that is efficient.

• Accurately identify, select/pick inventory for loading and staging based on customer load sheets. This process may involve “picking” corrugated and un-corrugated product (up to 45 lbs) from shelves, pushing/pulling of 7’ high cases of products (up to 200 lbs) and other packaged and un-packaged product. Process also includes placing products on wheeled racks 5 ½ feet high and moving throughout warehouse.

• Unload trucks/trailers using a hook or pallet jack. Physical labor involved in this activity varies, but can involve pushing/pulling 7 high milk cases (up to 200 lbs) and metal racks (800 lbs).

• Pull empty and full milk cases stacked 7 high (up to 200 lbs) with repetition.

• Manually remove product from conveyor system, then package and/or stage in an efficient manner to maintain production flow requirements.

• Dispose of returned product by manually dumping into disposal system using repetitive motion.

• Wash trailers/trucks after unloading empty cases.

• Work in a cooperative manner with managers, supervisors and peers.

General:

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures. Able to demonstrate knowledge of safety areas reviewed in the safety orientation program.

• Execute assigned duties with minimal supervision.

• Available for required overtime to support business needs and/or critical situations.

• Perform assigned duties satisfactorily and in a timely manner.

• Perform assigned duties following "Good Manufacturing Practices.”

• Actively participate in special teams representing the warehouse department.

• Maintain a clean & safe work environment.

• Perform all other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

• Basic math skills.

• Ability to work well as part of a team.

• Good communication skills.

• Multi-tasked Individual.

jobs.title: Remote Maintenance Quality Control Specialist (HVAC/Plumbing Background)
jobs.description:
About Offshore Launch

Offshore Launch is a staffing agency that specializes in helping small business owners scale their operations with the top 1% of global remote talent. We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every person and business in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

• Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.

• Work in a people-first, remote environment that values growth and ongoing development.

• Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, professional development, and an overall emphasis on teamwork and collaboration.

• Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Your Role

As an employee of Offshore Launch, you are being hired for a unique role within a target Client’s company. We value long-term partnerships, and seek to recruit talent that will serve an individual Client’s business for multiple years.

You will work full-time with the Client company. However, the Agency provides ongoing support to ensure your continued success. As such, we create space for ongoing check-ins, feedback and development through:

• Membership in the Offshore Launch Slack workspace

• Bi-weekly All Team meetings

• Monthly reviews

Your job is to help the Client succeed.

Our job is to help you succeed.

About the Client

As a remote General Maintenance Project Manager, you’ll handle a high volume of fencing, roofing, and drywall work orders every day and oversee licensed contractors in the field. You’ll review their diagnoses, check scopes, and confirm quality before any work moves forward.

You’re the technical gatekeeper. You flag issues, clarify scope, and push back on anything that doesn’t meet our client’s standards. This is a contractor-to-contractor role. You won’t schedule, dispatch, or talk to residents. Your job is to challenge bids, clarify repairs, and keep jobs moving.

This role suits HVAC or plumbing professionals who want to move from fieldwork to full-time remote work and put their hands-on experience to use at scale.

Responsibilities

• Manage 15–20+ general maintenance work orders a day, with steady year-round volume that keeps growing

• Review contractor reports, photos, and videos to verify diagnoses and catch issues early

• Scope jobs accurately, catching misdiagnoses, inflated bids, wrong quantities, and missing materials

• Give field contractors clear, confident direction and push back when needed

• Answer contractor calls promptly and keep your work order queue current at all times

• Own communication across each job, from the field to internal ops through wrap-up

• Act as the final quality gatekeeper before approval and billing

• Track job progress and completion in the client’s custom internal platform

• Cross-train on HVAC and plumbing work orders and help cover those queues as needed

Requirements

• 3–5+ years of hands-on HVAC or plumbing experience (residential preferred)

• Strong mechanical diagnostic and troubleshooting ability

• Experience reading system tags, data plates, and job-site photos to assess work

• Fencing, roofing, or drywall exposure is a plus but not required (training provided)

• Exceptional verbal communication: you can speak clearly and confidently with US-based contractors and push back with precision, not aggression

• Highly responsive and organized, and comfortable managing dozens of open work orders at once

• Fast learner on new software

• Willingness to trade fieldwork for full-time remote work

• Fluent English, verbal and written

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch)

• Up to $1450, depending on experience

• 13th month pay

• Performance-based bonuses

• Comprehensive HMO policy, including dependents.

• Annual continuing education budget to support professional development

Note

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

• Passionate about helping children with autism

Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

As an HFC Engineer on the Telecommunications team you will be responsible for designing and optimizing Hybrid Fiber-Coaxial (HFC) networks to deliver high-speed broadband services.

This role involves:

• Creating network architectures, ensuring the efficient integration of fiber and coaxial components to meet performance and reliability standards.

• Sizing of serving boundaries using GIS address data; analyze, interpret, and organize large datasets

• Determine feeder routes, distribution routes, and drops to premises by utilizing, parcel, ROW, and easement documentation

• Determine fiber and coax component allocations

• Reviewing field staking sheets, as-Builts and field collected data to determine the optimal running line and construction method.

• Analyze aerial Imagery and general maps to identify existing utilities or potential obstructions; and produce and review high quality constructible plan sets using GIS based software.

The HFC Engineer will work closely with engineering teams, project managers, and field engineers to support the deployment and enhancement of HFC networks.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Ability to read, interpret, create maps and plan sets.

• Ability to edit and create PDF documents (Bluebeam or Adobe skills)

• Associate’s/bachelor’s degree in engineering/design or equivalent work experience preferred

• General knowledge in OSP construction methods and best practices.

• 3-6 years of Coax/HFC design experience.

• General knowledge of HFC, DOCSIS, and FTTx networks is required.

• Knowledge of LODE Data is preferred

• Knowledge of ESRI ArcGIS Software products is preferred.

• Knowledge of AutoCAD is a plus

#LI-DNP

Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, education, and internal equity.

$28—$35 USD

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

If you're someone who takes pride in doing things the right way and thrives in a fast-moving environment, this position is built for you.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Operations Regulatory & Audit Management
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

Operations Regulatory & Audit Management (ORAM) provides a coordinated, consistent and defensible operational response when regulatory examinations, inquiries, investigations, consent orders, audits or regulatory requirements require Operations involvement.

The team partners with Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, Operations leaders and third-party administrators to coordinate responses, conduct analysis, manage documentation and evidence, oversee remediation and strengthen readiness for future regulatory and audit activity.

ORAM also works to improve how the organization prepares for and responds to these matters by strengthening governance, documentation, issue management and repeatable response practices.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Analyst, Operations Regulatory & Audit Management is an experienced individual contributor responsible for independently managing regulatory and audit work and supporting complex examinations, inquiries, audits and remediation efforts.

The role owns defined matters and workstreams from intake through completion, including stakeholder coordination, research and analysis, evidence gathering, response preparation, tracking and reporting. The Senior Analyst is expected to exercise sound judgment, identify potential issues before they become escalations and operate with minimal day-to-day guidance.

The role also supports ORAM readiness and process maturity by maintaining playbooks, documentation standards, reporting practices and governance routines and by identifying opportunities to make recurring work more efficient, consistent and repeatable.

Successful candidates will be organized, analytical and comfortable working directly with Operations, Compliance, Legal, auditors, regulators and third-party administrators while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO

• Independently manage regulatory requests, audit activities and defined workstreams within larger examinations, inquiries or remediation programs.

• Manage external and internal audit requests by coordinating research, analysis, data and supporting documentation across Operations and third-party administrators.

• Support Market Conduct Exams, Department of Insurance inquiries and other regulatory matters, including request tracking, evidence coordination, response development and follow-up.

• Conduct thorough research and analysis and communicate findings, risks and recommendations to ORAM leadership and business partners.

• Organize and coordinate data gathering and evidence packages and review materials for completeness, accuracy and consistency before submission.

• Maintain clear ownership, milestones, status and documentation for assigned regulatory and audit matters.

• Identify potential response gaps, inconsistencies, missed requirements or emerging concerns and escalate them with recommended next steps.

• Support implementation and ongoing oversight of regulatory requirements, examination findings and audit remediation activities.

• Track remediation commitments, supporting evidence and closure activities and follow up with accountable business partners to maintain progress.

• Compile and analyze examination, audit and regulatory data to identify trends, repeat issues and opportunities to strengthen readiness.

• Maintain ORAM readiness materials, including playbooks, templates, stakeholder maps, checklists, evidence standards and lessons learned.

• Support intake, tracking, reporting and governance routines across ORAM to ensure matters are appropriately documented, routed and escalated.

• Develop management-ready status updates, reporting and presentation materials on regulatory, audit and remediation activity.

• Lead small-to-medium regulatory or audit-related projects and independently coordinate stakeholders, timelines and deliverables.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, Operations leaders, third-party administrators and other partners.

• Identify opportunities to improve ORAM processes, documentation and tools and support implementation of approved enhancements.

• Serve as a subject-matter resource to Analysts and other team members on assigned regulatory and audit processes.

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• Ability to independently manage varied and complex assignments with minimal guidance.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and recommend practical solutions.

• Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities.

• Sound judgment and willingness to escalate concerns proactively rather than waiting for direction.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate clearly with management and cross-functional partners.

• Attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, complete and defensible work.

• Ability to understand the purpose behind regulatory and audit requests rather than treating work as a documentation exercise.

• Comfort working directly with internal leaders, auditors, Compliance, Legal and third-party administrators.

• Continuous-improvement mindset with an interest in making recurring work more consistent and efficient.

• High degree of personal integrity, accountability, adaptability and professionalism.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 3-5+ years of relevant experience in insurance operations, regulatory response, audit management, compliance, controls or a related discipline.

• Experience independently managing regulatory, audit, compliance or other complex cross-functional work preferred.

• Life, annuity and/or preneed insurance experience preferred; TPA or third-party administration experience valued.

• Experience supporting regulatory examinations, market conduct activity, regulatory inquiries, external/internal audits or remediation programs preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct research and analysis, coordinate stakeholders and prepare clear documentation or management reporting.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.

• Occasional travel required.

SALARY RANGE
It is expected that the base annual salary range for this position will be $90,000 to $100,000. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

KKR is an equal opportunity employer.  Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.

KKR will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email Benefits@kkr.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.kkr.com/careers because of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to Benefits@kkr.com. Only emails left for this purpose will be returned.

Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. This notice applies only to applicants and employees who work or will work in Massachusetts, in accordance with applicable state law.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing consumer AI company with a mobile app at the center of its business. They’re looking for a strategic, results-driven Head of Marketing to own user growth end to end: app installs, registrations, activation, engagement, and retention.

You’ll build and lead an integrated consumer marketing strategy spanning paid media, performance creative, organic social, website content, and lifecycle marketing. A central part of the role is serving as the primary strategic lead and point of accountability for the company’s external media, creative, and performance marketing agency of record. You’ll set objectives, guide creative and media strategy, manage investment decisions, and make sure the agency delivers measurable outcomes.

This is a role for someone who pairs strong consumer marketing and creative instincts with deep expertise in performance marketing, mobile app growth, and analytics.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - The integrated consumer marketing strategy, aligning awareness, acquisition, activation, and retention with company growth goals

 - Performance against ambitious targets for app installs, registrations, efficient CAC, and downstream engagement and retention

 - The go-to-market calendar across product launches, feature releases, seasonal campaigns, and growth initiatives

 - The agency of record relationship: translating business goals into clear briefs, priorities, creative requirements, and KPIs, and holding the agency accountable to results

 - Paid acquisition strategy across Meta, Google, Apple Ads, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms, including budget allocation, channel diversification, audience strategy, and testing priorities

 - Performance creative strategy that continuously tests messaging, value propositions, use cases, audiences, and formats

 - Weekly performance reviews, strategic planning sessions, and periodic business reviews with the agency

 - Organic social strategy and brand voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, and LinkedIn, making advanced AI feel accessible and relevant to everyday consumers

 - Creator, influencer, community, and partnership programs that drive authentic product advocacy

 - Lifecycle marketing from onboarding through activation, engagement, retention, and win-back, across email, push, and in-app messaging

 - Behavioral segmentation and activation milestones, in partnership with Product, tied to stronger retention

 - Website and app store content strategy, landing pages, and conversion optimization (visitor-to-registration, web-to-app)

 - Organic discoverability across SEO, ASO, and GEO, including AI-powered search and answer experiences

 - Brand positioning and messaging that translate complex AI capabilities into clear, emotionally resonant, accurately substantiated benefits

 - Integrated launches aligning creative, paid, organic, web, and lifecycle

 - The measurement framework connecting spend to installs, registrations, activation, retention, and LTV, including attribution, incrementality testing, and executive reporting

 - Marketing budgets, vendors, tooling, workflows, and a prioritized roadmap, plus recommendations on future team structure and hiring


MUST HAVE

 - 10+ years of progressive experience in consumer, growth, or digital marketing, with significant ownership of strategy and business results

 - Experience leading marketing for a consumer mobile app, subscription product, or high-growth consumer tech business

 - A proven track record driving measurable growth in app installs, registrations, acquisition, and activation

 - Deep knowledge of performance marketing across paid social, search, video, and mobile app advertising

 - Significant experience directing external media, creative, or performance agencies, with direct ownership of budget, strategy, and results

 - Strong creative judgment and the ability to give actionable creative direction that connects storytelling to performance

 - Hands-on experience with lifecycle and retention marketing (onboarding, CRM, segmentation, re-engagement)

 - Experience owning website content, landing pages, SEO, and CRO

 - Strong analytical fluency across attribution, funnel performance, cohort retention, and marketing ROI

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn complex products into compelling consumer narratives


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience marketing AI, productivity, or other emerging consumer tech products

 - Hands-on experience with incrementality testing or MMM

 - Familiarity with mobile measurement and lifecycle tools (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust, Braze, Iterable)

 - Experience with ASO and optimizing for AI-driven search (GEO)

 - A background building organic social or creator programs centered on short-form video


CULTURE FIT

 - You own the number, even when execution sits with a partner

 - You’re comfortable moving between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment

 - You hold a high creative bar and back decisions with data

 - You build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, Creative, and leadership

 - You default to experimentation and learn quickly from results

Not the bar: if your experience is mainly in B2B or ecommerce without mobile app growth, or you’ve managed agencies only from a distance without owning budget and outcomes yourself, this likely isn’t the right fit.




WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT DARKROOM

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape. Just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

 - Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

 - Embedded with the client: This role is based in the San José Area and works from the client's office four to five days a week, as part of a 150-person independent agency.

 - Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

 - Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

 - Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Sports & Entertainment
jobs.description:
Job Description

Flowcode

Flowcode builds the infrastructure that turns every seat, broadcast, and game-day touchpoint into measurable, actionable first-party fan IDs, enabling leagues, teams, and live event properties to personalize the fan experience and grow ticketing, merchandise, and sponsorship revenue. As the leading offline-to-online conversion and measurement platform, Flowcode is committed to building direct connections between properties and their fans. Our products unify fan experiences and data across the venue, the broadcast, and the digital world.

Role

As an Account Executive, Sports & Entertainment, you will sell Flowcode to professional teams, college athletics departments, venues, and live event properties, and grow our league-wide partnerships club by club. Sports is Flowcode's strongest pod. We power league and club-wide Flowcode 2 structures with the NHL (the league office and all 32 clubs) and with the NBA and WNBA, and we work with NASCAR, TKO, Texas A&M, and dozens of other teams and schools. Properties use Flowcode to capture fan data at every touchpoint, personalize the game-day experience, sell tickets and merchandise, and create sponsor inventory they can sell to their partners: seat tags, in-venue and broadcast codes, fan hubs, and sponsored experiences like the Coors Light fan vote on ESPN College GameDay. This is a quota-carrying individual contributor role and the pod's volume seat: you carry a number and a named list of teams, schools, and properties, convert league relationships into signed clubs, and win new properties on a fast cycle timed to the season and the sponsorship calendar. The ideal candidate knows how a property makes money from tickets, sponsorship, media, and fan data, sells with a built product in hand, and closes like a seller.

Responsibilities

• Own a named list of professional teams, college athletics programs, venues, and live event properties, a mix of new logos and existing customers, carrying full accountability for new revenue and expansion against an annual number

• Turn league partnerships into club revenue: work alongside the Pod Lead and Account Managers to move NBA, WNBA, and NHL clubs from trial to paid, and repeat the league-wide model with other leagues and conferences

• Win college athletics at scale across the major conferences and with multimedia rights and technology partners such as Learfield/Sidearm, turning one school into a conference footprint

• Sell fan programs, not software: bring each property a pre-built Flowcode experience for a real moment on its calendar (a home opener, rivalry game, playoff run, or tentpole event) with an ROI case, and ask for the order in the meeting

• Build relationships with CMOs, heads of fan engagement and CRM, ticketing and revenue leaders, partnership and sponsorship sales teams, and digital and data leaders

• Lead the core sports use cases: fan data capture with FlowID, seat tags and in-venue experiences, broadcast and video board codes, ticketing and merchandise conversion, app downloads, and sponsored fan experiences

• Help properties package and sell Flowcode-powered inventory to their sponsors, and work with sponsor brands (QSR, beverage, sports betting, financial services, auto) and the Agency Pod so each partnership activates through Flowcode

• Work with Flowcode's Studio, Integration Engineering, and Client Success teams to launch on the season's timeline and connect fan data to the property's CRM, ticketing, and CDP systems

• Drive a deliberate land-and-expand motion, turning one use case, venue, or sport into a season-long, multi-team, or athletic-department-wide program

• Represent Flowcode where sports business leaders gather, including Sports Business Journal conferences, the MIT Sloan Sports Analytics Conference, NACDA, and Cannes Lions

• Maintain accurate CRM data, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline reporting for executive review

• Raise the bar for the broader Go-To-Market team by sharing sports insight, deal strategy, and winning activations with peers

Qualifications

• 4+ years of quota-carrying sales to or within sports properties. We're open to a range of backgrounds, including team or league partnership and ticket sales, sports technology (ticketing, fan engagement, CRM, data), college athletics multimedia rights, and sports marketing agency client leadership

• Relationships at the club, school, or league level across marketing, ticketing, partnerships, and digital

• Fluency in how properties monetize: ticketing, sponsorship inventory and renewal cycles, media rights, merchandise, and the value of first-party fan data

• Proven record of exceeding quota at high velocity, closing many five- and six-figure deals a year without losing credibility or discounting to get there

• Experience expanding a league or conference relationship club by club or school by school is a strong plus

• A creative, idea-first selling style: comfortable walking into a first meeting with a pre-built Flowcode experience, demoing it live, and editing it in the room when a buyer asks "can it do this?"

• AI-native working style: prepares accounts with research agents rather than waiting on a dossier, builds their own analysis and pipeline views, and can point to a process they replaced with AI tooling and the result it produced

• Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to command a room of senior executives and translate technology into business outcomes

• Strong strategic, analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a solution-oriented approach to client challenges

• Experience in fast-paced, dynamic start-up environment with changing priorities

• Proven ability to work effectively within a team, sharing insights and supporting peers to achieve collective goals

• Proficiency with CRM software and familiarity with sales engagement tools

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

This is an in-office role at our beautiful office in Soho, NYC.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

The current range for this role is up to $180k - $250k OTE plus equity.

• You’re energized by building, nurturing and maintaining relationships with customers throughout every step of the rental process

Education and Experience:

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. jobs.title: Lead Operator
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Operates and maintains water/wastewater treatment, processing, disposal and testing equipment in

water/wastewater treatment facility to purify water to meet permit and operational requirements. Is fully qualified

to perform the most complex functions and may lead the work of others. Serves as Primary Operator with

responsibility for State reporting and compliance.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Tends automatic and semi-automatic machines and related equipment including pumps, engines, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors, blowers, chemical feed and odor control and vacuum filters used to decontaminate waste water by settling, aeration and sludge digestion.
• Monitors control panels and adjusts valves and gates manually or by remote control to regulate flow.
• Monitors flow meters, gauges, flow ratios, pressures and related controls through instrument panels, computer terminals and programmable logic control units in assigned area.
• Monitors and records operating conditions observations and data in area shift log.
• Ensures conformance to process specifications. Troubleshoots and diagnoses operational problems and takes corrective action per procedure. Verifies and reports suspected malfunctions and variances to supervisor. Performs routine and preventative maintenance and maintenance related items as assigned.
• Performs field tests (chemical, physical and biological) in order to pace chemical dosages for process and odor control units or alter unit processes.
• Samples wastewater, sludge and gases (odor control, digester, etc.) according to schedule.
• Prepares chemical solutions and services automatic samplers.
• Monitors process chemical supplies and recommends reorder.
• Performs lab tests applicable to permit testing and related reports per procedure.
• Performs instrument calibration for portable meters including, but not limited to, dissolved oxygen, pH, H2S, percent oxygen, lower explosive limit.
• Performs manual labor including filling and emptying of machine bins and cleaning equipment, facilities and grounds as required.
• Performs minor maintenance including, but not limited to, routine preventive maintenance, lubrication and minor adjustments.
• Operates vehicles for plant operational purposes.
• Practices good housekeeping in assigned area and properly disposes of waste according to safety and environmental policies.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT ASSEMBLED

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled https://www.assembled.com/customers. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.




THE ROLE 

We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help build the foundation of Assembled’s platform. Our Platform org is responsible for the core systems that power Assembled’s products end-to-end: the infrastructure our applications run on, the integrations that ingest data into the Assembled ecosystem, and the data platforms that transform, model, and serve that data across the company.

Assembled’s products sit at the center of some of the most operationally complex support environments in the world. Our workforce management product helps support teams plan and operate at scale, while our AI agents help automate work across chat, email, and voice. As both products grow, we need systems that are reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient, and capable of supporting both real-time operational workflows and large-scale analytical workloads.

By joining the Platform org, you’ll work on foundational problems across infrastructure, data platforms, and integrations. Depending on your background and interests, you may go deeper in one area, but all of our platform engineers help build and evolve the systems that power both our workforce management product and our AI agents.




SOME PROJECTS OWNED BY THE PLATFORM ORG

 - Scalable application infrastructure: We’re continuing to evolve the systems that run our products reliably and efficiently at enterprise scale, from container orchestration and observability to security and cost efficiency.

 - Integrations platform: We’re building the platform and connectors that ingest data from the systems our customers rely on most, including CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, communication platforms, and AI model providers.

 - Modern data foundations: We’re building the systems that transform raw product and integration data into reliable, queryable, derived datasets that power metrics, reporting, analytics, and other product experiences.

 - Real-time and analytical systems: Many of our products depend on both low-latency operational paths and heavier analytical workflows. We’re investing in systems that can support both without duplicating logic or creating inconsistent definitions.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years of engineering experience involving backend, platform, or infrastructure systems

 - Are excited by the idea of working on foundational problems that cut across infrastructure, data platforms, and integrations

 - Thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy figuring out the right abstractions, system boundaries, and tradeoffs

 - Care deeply about reliability, maintainability, performance, and building systems that empower other engineers

 - Enjoy collaborating cross-functionally and understand how platform work can unlock product and business impact

 - Have familiarity with one or more parts of our stack:
   
   - Cloud provider: AWS
   
   - Container orchestration: Kubernetes + Karpenter
   
   - Datastores: Postgres + PgBouncer, Snowflake, Redis
   
   - Languages: Go and Python



We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong and has the opportunity to do their best work. We look forward to hearing from you!



For United States Applicants:
Assembled participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

For United Kingdom Applicants:
Assembled is required to verify your right to work in the UK and will conduct a Right to Work check prior to employment in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Training Solution Consultant
jobs.description:
Founded in early 2021, Ibility is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and a Woman-Owned Small Business, headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.  Ibility is a small but mighty company that is positioned for rapid growth.  Simply put, we help government leaders to achieve their mission by designing creative products and programs that delight their customers and make their employees more efficient - building trust and improving overall satisfaction. We use human-centered design principles in every engagement because we believe the end-user is critical to the long-term success of any solution. Our team is fun, passionate, bold, and creative.  We live our mission every day – to inspire people, create cool stuff, and make a lasting impact on the world!


Position Overview
The Training Solution Consultant will serve as an embedded training and user-support resource for an assigned Tier 1 Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The consultant will help ensure end users receive timely, site-specific support; identify and coordinate refresher-training needs; provide input on training-content updates; and strengthen adoption of processes, systems, and tools supported by the Tier. 
The consultant is expected to become an integrated member of the assigned Tier team and act as a connector among end users, SMEs, training stakeholders, local sites, and the Access and Training program offices.

This is a contractor / 1099 role supporting Tier 1 and Solution Teams / Some travel may be required for on-site working sessions.
Key Responsibilities 
Liaison: 
- Embed within the assigned Tier 1 SME team and develop a working understanding of its workflows, processes, systems, user populations, and training materials. 
- Advise SMEs and training owners on needed changes to training content, including updates prompted by workflow changes, system enhancements, policy changes, or recurring user issues. 
- Help maintain training materials, FAQs, job aids, communications, and other user-facing resources in partnership with content owners and SMEs. 
- Participate in established communities of practice, Tier meetings, office hours, working sessions, and other stakeholder forums. 
Deliver: 
- Serve as a primary coordinator for site-specific user-support and refresher-training requests. 
- Coordinate with local site contacts and other support functions to ensure training and support are delivered consistently and aligned with business needs. 
- Facilitate instructor-led classes, virtual sessions, office hours, and drop-in support sessions when required. 
- Assess reported training gaps, recurring questions, user feedback, and adoption issues to recommend appropriate support interventions.  
- Track support themes, training activity, recurring issues, and user feedback; provide regular updates and recommendations to the Tier team. 
- Identify the appropriate modality, coaching, job aid, microlearning, or refresher, based on the urgency and complexity of the gap. 
- Deliver or coordinate refresher training, targeted coaching, demonstrations, facilitation, job aids, and other learning-support resources as needed. 
- Validate proficiency following interventions to confirm gaps have been addressed sufficiently. 
- Support change-management and communications activities associated with new or revised workflows, tools, system functionality, or training materials. 

Required Qualifications 
- Experience delivering training, facilitating workshops, or providing end-user support in a business, operational, technical, or healthcare environment. 
- Experience with the Oracle Health Electronic Health Record (EHR), including end-user support, workflow training, adoption, optimization, system implementation, onboarding, Oracle Health maintenance training, or system-related process changes. 
- Ability to translate complex clinical, operational, or system processes into clear, practical learning content and user guidance. 
- Strong facilitation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
- Experience identifying learning needs and recommending appropriate training or performance-support solutions. 
- Ability to work independently while collaborating closely as an embedded member of a cross-functional team. 
- Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple requests, priorities, and follow-up activities. 
- Proficiency with common virtual collaboration, presentation, and documentation tools. 
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with the Federal Electronic Health Record (FEHR), including its clinical, operational, training, implementation, or end-user-support environment. 
- Experience supporting enterprise EHR implementations, process transformation, or large-scale change initiatives. 
- Experience developing or maintaining training materials, job aids, knowledge articles, FAQs, and facilitator guides. 
- Familiarity with learning-management systems, virtual-learning platforms, or knowledge-management tools. 
- Experience supporting geographically distributed sites, facilities, or diverse user groups. 
- Prior experience in a consulting or contractor role supporting client teams. 
Expected Deliverables 
- A documented understanding of the assigned Tier’s training, adoption, and end-user-support needs. 
- Coordination and delivery of site-specific refresher training, coaching, office hours, and other user-support activities. 
- Active participation in Tier meetings, classes, working sessions, and communities of practice. 
- Recommendations for training-content revisions, new job aids, FAQs, and other user-support resources. 
- Periodic reporting on training activity, user feedback, recurring issues, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities. 
- Ongoing collaboration with Tier SMEs to improve end-user readiness, confidence, and adoption of Oracle Health EHR workflows and related tools.

jobs.title: Staff Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Staff Demo Engineer on the Demo Engineering team, you’ll shape the technical tooling and platform behind 1Password’s go-to-market demo experience. You’ll build scalable demo environments, interactive product experiences, and shared infrastructure that help teams communicate 1Password’s value across the customer journey. Your work will help make secure access simpler and support 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Bring substantial experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, technical marketing, DevOps, solutions architecture, or demo engineering.

 - Apply experience in cybersecurity, identity, Privileged Access Management (PAM), developer tools, or a related technical domain.

 - Build full-stack and automation solutions using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, or Python, with experience designing systems that other engineers can build on.

 - Design and operate infrastructure using infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), containers, and cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

 - Understand identity and access management concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), device trust, passwordless authentication, and passkeys.

 - Balance speed, reliability, cost, and security while explaining technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

 - Create interactive software-as-a-service (SaaS) demos and guided product experiences using platforms such as Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or Arcade; experience with mobile device management (MDM) tools such as Jamf, live event demos, utilization analysis, artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tooling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers is also valuable.



What you can expect:

 - Set the technical vision, roadmap, and long-term architecture for 1Password’s demo platform.

 - Lead the design of shared demo infrastructure, including templates, automated provisioning and resets, data generation, and observability.

 - Build sample applications and integrations across 1Password products to support demos and enablement programs.

 - Support complex, high-visibility demos for flagship launches, keynotes, conferences, and strategic customer opportunities.

 - Drive AI-assisted tooling that automates demo preparation, validation, and maintenance.

 - Partner with Engineering Security on demo environments and lead architecture and code reviews.

 - Mentor Demo Engineers and Senior Demo Engineers while representing Demo Engineering in cross-functional technical decisions and product roadmap discussions.

 - Travel quarterly, including cross-border travel, for conferences and company offsites.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $135,000 USD and $196,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $129,000 CAD and $187,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

jobs.title: Marketing Representative
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Marketing Representative

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Marketing Representative at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

The Marketing Representative drives growth for EquipmentShare's Vehicle Solutions division through multi-channel marketing campaigns, organic and paid social media management, creative content development, and digital advertising initiatives.
This position is responsible for independently managing social media campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, including content creation, audience targeting, paid advertising, and performance optimization. The role requires hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, proficiency in creative software such as Canva and Adobe Creative Cloud, and the ability to develop original marketing concepts and engaging visual content.

The Marketing Representative also supports marketing operations, including CRM management, customer attribution, lead generation, and acquisition funnels, while cultivating strategic
partnerships and supporting business development initiatives. The position utilizes AI-powered tools to enhance content creation, graphic design, video production, marketing automation, and overall workflow efficiency.
Ideal candidates possess at least three years of relevant experience, a degree in marketing or equivalent experience, and a strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, social media algorithms, creative production, and data-driven campaign optimization.

Primary Responsibilities

• Marketing Strategy & Campaign Management: Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns, manage budgets, perform A/B testing, and track performance KPIs to optimize ROI. Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events and quarterly team activities

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Strong understanding of social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube). Proficiency in marketing and creative tools (e.g., design software, Meta Business Suite, CRM platforms). Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively across departments and implement data-driven marketing strategies. A strong collaborator with a cross functional marketing team on future growth initiatives. Education and Experience: High school diploma or equivalent, required Bchelors degree in marketing or relavant experience, required At least 3 years of experience in marketing, sales, or digital media. Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

jobs.title: Corporate Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB FUNCTION: This position is responsible for completing and supporting PPAP submissions, product inspections, quality documentation, root cause analysis and corrective actions while ensuring products meet customer, engineering and applicable quality requirements.

JOB DUTIES

• Prepare, coordinate and complete Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions, including dimensional results, control plans, capability data and required supporting documentation.

• Perform dimensional inspections and product evaluations using precision measurement and inspection equipment to verify conformance to engineering drawings, specifications and customer requirements.

• Review and interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, technical specifications and customer-specific quality requirements to establish appropriate inspection criteria.

• Investigate internal, supplier and customer quality concerns and lead root cause analysis, corrective actions and 8D activities through resolution and effectiveness verification.

• Support new product development, product changes and customer requirements by developing inspection plans, control plans and other required quality documentation.

• Analyze inspection results, nonconformance data and quality trends and work cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain and other teams to drive continuous improvement.

• Support the calibration, control and maintenance of measurement and inspection equipment within the Corporate Quality Lab and maintain accurate quality records.

• Support compliance with ISO 9001 and the company’s Quality Management System, including participation in internal and external audits, corrective actions and maintenance of required quality documentation.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

• Strong knowledge of PPAP requirements and quality documentation

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications and GD&T

• Knowledge of root cause analysis, corrective action and structured problem-solving methods

• Knowledge of calibration and measurement system requirements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document inspection and quality results

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate quality issues across technical and non-technical teams.

• Ability to manage multiple PPAPs, customer requirements and quality projects simultaneously.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with ERP, quality management and document control systems.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical Engineering Technology or a related technical field preferred. Equivalent technical education and relevant quality experience will also be considered.

• 3+ years of experience in quality engineering, quality assurance, inspection or a related technical quality role preferred.

• Experience preparing and completing PPAP documentation strongly preferred.

• Experience working within an ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System preferred.

• Experience in an industrial, machining, hydraulic, automotive or similar technical product environment is preferred.

jobs.title: Spanish Speaking Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range:$18-24

• Passionate about helping children with autism

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team

jobs.title: Material Handler I
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Responsible for performing a variety of routine hazardous and non-hazardous waste tasks in the movement of

solids and liquids. Under direct supervision, tasks could include all types of manual labor in cleaning and

decontamination operations, vacuum projects and handling, packing, re-packing, unloading and loading containers for processing at site or transportation to appropriate facilities.

• Load and unload various size containers (totes, drums, tankers, trailers. etc.)
• Construct boxes and/or fiber containers and stacks, labels, and loads containers.
• Use a variety of tools such as impact wrenches, shovels, jackhammers, etc.
• Transport hazardous waste materials from storage facilities within the facility as directed.
• Decontaminate and dispose of empty drums and/or containers according to RCRA and disposal guidelines.
• Assist in completing all necessary paperwork for processing materials to include transportation of materials to and from various locations.
• Perform general housekeeping duties.
• Maintain a clean, organized and safe work area.
• Inspection material handling equipment as directed.
• Assist in the loading/unloading of hazardous and non-hazardous waste materials at designated sites utilizing appropriate equipment for which you are appropriately trained.
• Other duties as assigned.

• High School diploma or General Educational Development (GED) preferred
• Prior work experience of 3 to 6 months in the hazardous waste or chemical industry in a related position with proficiency in handling forklifts and a variety of tools preferred

• Ability to communicate through reading and writing
• Trained in the use of material handling equipment
