jobs.title: Quality Supervisor - Filling (weekend PM)
jobs.description:
Simtra BioPharma Solutions (Simtra) is a world-class Contract Development Manufacturing Organization, partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their sterile injectable products to market. With facilities in Bloomington, Indiana, US and Halle/Westfalen, Germany, we offer a wide range of delivery systems including pre-filled syringes, liquid/lyophilized vials, diluents for reconstitution, powder-filled vials and sterile crystallization.

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide.  As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra.  We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging.  Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Why join Team Simtra? Because we:

Make it HAPPEN – We bring a growth mindset to every opportunity, developing new skillsets and exceeding our expectations and those of our customers.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

Make it RIGHT – We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence, fulfilling our commitments to the customer, their patients, and our team members.

Make it COUNT – We take pride in our day-to-day work, knowing the impact we make – taking on challenges big and small to improve patient health.

The role:

The Quality Supervisor is a member of the Quality Assurance Leadership Team reporting directly to the Quality Manager. They provide direct support to Quality Operations (QALO) and Manufacturing to ensure that finished products meet the required specifications by supervising QALO personnel, who provide quality oversight in the manufacturing areas. The QALO Associate III provides decision-making and oversight to ensure compliance to all regulatory agency regulations and guidelines and to Simtra Standard Operating Procedures. This position fully supports and drives quality operations on the production floor and communicates effectively with production team members, management, and other cross-functional departments. The QALO Associate III creates an environment where teamwork, productivity, safety, identity, strength, purity and quality (SISPQ) are reflected in the finished product.

The responsibilities:

• Able to successfully perform all the primary responsibilities of QALO personnel.

• Effectively grows, manages, develops and empowers QALO personnel including hiring and evaluation of performance.

• Provides rapid, quality-first decision-making in collaboration with manufacturing and other cross-functional teams.

• Ensures training and compliance of QALO associates and Quality Technicians.

• Authors and approves investigation/deviation reports.

• Leads ongoing daily QALO activities and assist other cross-functional areas to ensure successful execution/implementation.

• Ensures tasks are completed assigned to self and QALO personnel to ensure Quality and site metrics are met.

• Author, revise, and review, written standard operating procedures (SOPs), batch records, and other documentation as needed to meet Corporate, Plant, Regulatory Requirements, etc. while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local and company-specific regulations related to quality of product and employee safety.

• Participate and lead multiple process/product improvement projects or other focus groups, design of experiments, validations, development of new methodologies or improving existing methodologies, data generation, report development, and presentation.

• Lead audit ready status efforts for assigned areas and assist other areas within the facility in understanding regulatory and Simtra quality requirements. Maintain a high level of expertise in current regulatory requirements.

Required qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree (preferred science discipline) and 2 years of Pharmaceutical Quality/Manufacturing or other GXP regulated industry experience, or Associate’s degree with at least 3 years of Pharmaceutical Quality/Manufacturing or other GXP regulated industry experience, or no degree with at least 5 years Pharmaceutical Quality/Manufacturing or other GXP regulated industry experience.

• Minimum of 2 years of leadership experience.

• Working knowledge of FDA CFR 210,211 and other applicable regulations, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) required.

• Knowledge of aseptic manufacturing processes are required.

• Good interpersonal/communication/influencing/negation skills.

• Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook and the ability to use enterprise software (examples include: D365, Blue Mountain, Veeva, etc.)

• Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Physical / Safety Requirements:

• Must wear appropriate PPE as required for various manufacturing areas

• Must be able to gown qualify for Grade C/D areas.

• Duties may require overtime work, including off-shift hours and Holidays as required.

• Use of hands and fingers to manipulate office equipment is required.

In return, you’ll be eligible for[1]:

jobs.title: Head Of National Security Policy
jobs.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

Veeam is seeking a Head of National Security Policy to serve as the senior-most technical authority for Veeam's full portfolio of government-facing products. This leader will define the technical strategy for how Veeam's data resilience and data security platforms — including Securiti AI's federal offering — are architected, deployed, and certified within U.S. government environments. The role carries a heavy near-term focus on Securiti AI Federal, where this person will work with engineering to drive the technical roadmap, integration architecture, and compliance posture required for the platform to operate inside classified and controlled federal networks.

This is a hybrid role: equal parts deep technical credibility with government network architectures and AI system deployment, and direct engagement with the engineering teams building for this market. The Head of National Security Policy reports directly to Veeam's corporate CTO and works in daily collaboration with Veeam's government strategy, sales, and solutions engineering leadership to align product direction with mission needs.

What You Will Do

Government Network & Compliance Strategy

• Serve as Veeam's principal technical authority on U.S. government network architectures, including DoD, IC, and civilian agency environments, air-gapped and classified networks, and cross-domain solutions.

• Work with engineering on the technical strategy and execution for FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, and IL6 authorization across Veeam's public sector product lines, partnering with compliance, security, and ATO stakeholders to reach and sustain accreditation.

• Translate evolving federal compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, DoD SRG, NIST 800-53, CMMC, StateRAMP) into concrete architecture and engineering requirements.

• Represent Veeam in agency technical reviews, security assessments, and authorizing official (AO) engagements as the senior technical sponsor.

AI Deployment & Integration, with a Focus on Securiti AI Federal

• Drive the technical strategy for deploying AI and data-security capabilities — including Securiti AI's federal product line — inside government network boundaries, covering model hosting, data classification, data residency, and secure integration patterns.

• Help define the architecture for how Securiti AI Federal integrates with Veeam's broader data resilience portfolio and with agency-owned infrastructure, identity systems, and data platforms.

• Guide decisions on where and how AI workloads can run within federal boundaries (on-prem, air-gapped, GovCloud, IL5/IL6 environments) and the security controls required at each layer.

• Stay ahead of federal AI governance requirements (e.g., agency AI use policies, model risk management, data provenance) and ensure Veeam's roadmap anticipates them rather than reacts to them.

Engineering & Team Leadership

• Support efforts to build, lead, and grow a dedicated public sector development organization, guiding technical direction, engineering standards, and delivery cadence.

• Recruit and mentor engineering managers and senior engineers with backgrounds in federal/government systems, secure software development, and AI infrastructure.

• Establish secure SDLC practices appropriate for FedRAMP and DoD authorization boundaries, including change management, continuous monitoring, and POA&M remediation workflows.

• Partner with Veeam's corporate engineering and product organizations to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in the core product roadmap rather than maintained as permanent forks.

Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration

• Act as the primary technical counterpart to Veeam's government strategy and go-to-market leadership, translating agency and partner requirements into product and engineering commitments.

• Collaborate closely with Veeam's corporate CTO organization to align public sector architecture with overall platform strategy, security posture, and roadmap.

• Support sales, solutions engineering, and channel/OEM partners in technical discussions with agency customers, integrators, and FedRAMP third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs).

• Present technical strategy and program status to Veeam executive leadership and, as needed, to agency and partner stakeholders.

What You Bring

Government Experience (Core Requirement)

• 15+ years in technical or engineering leadership roles, with the substantial majority of that career spent inside the U.S. government technology ecosystem — not adjacent to it.

• Direct, hands-on experience within the Intelligence Community: architecting, deploying, or operating systems within IC networks and security boundaries, and working fluency in IC-specific accreditation, data handling, and cross-domain requirements.

• Direct experience within the Department of War (formerly the Department of Defense) or its components: combatant commands, services, or defense agencies, including familiarity with DoW network architectures, RMF/ATO processes, and mission-owner requirements at the tactical and enterprise level.

• Meaningful experience on the federal civilian side (e.g., DHS, DOJ, DOS, HHS, Treasury, VA, or similar), understanding how technical strategy, procurement, and authorization differ from defense and IC environments.

• A career that spans at least two of these three worlds (IC, DoW, federal civilian) is strongly preferred — this role requires someone who can speak credibly and specifically to each community's distinct network architectures, compliance regimes, and unwritten norms, not a generalist who has only sold or supported them from the outside.

• Direct experience achieving or operating within FedRAMP Moderate/High and IL4/IL5/IL6 authorization boundaries — you understand the ATO process from the inside, having carried a system through it, not just read about it.

• Active or recently held U.S. government security clearance strongly preferred (TS/SCI a plus); at minimum, must be eligible to obtain one.

Data Security, AI, and Governance Expertise

• Deep, practical understanding of data security posture management (DSPM) — how these platforms discover, classify, and monitor sensitive data across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments, and how that maps to federal data protection mandates.

• Strong command of data governance platforms and frameworks: data classification and lineage, access governance, retention and disposition policy, and how these enforce compliance in regulated government environments.

• Hands-on experience architecting or deploying AI/ML systems within regulated or classified environments, including model hosting, data provenance, and secure integration with existing government infrastructure.

• Ability to translate DSPM and data governance capabilities into terms that map directly to FedRAMP, DoW SRG, and IC accreditation requirements.

Leadership & Technical Range

• Proven track record building and leading high-performing teams, including hiring, mentoring, and setting technical direction at an organizational level.

• Strong grasp of data resilience, backup, and data security domains (Veeam's core market) or comparable enterprise infrastructure/security software.

• Excellent ability to operate as a technical bridge between engineering, compliance, and go-to-market teams — comfortable in both classified architecture reviews and executive/customer-facing settings.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Experience

• Prior experience with Securiti AI or a comparable DSPM/data governance platform, ideally in a federal or defense deployment.

• Uniformed military, IC civilian, or DoW civilian service, particularly in a technical, cyber, or systems engineering capacity.

• Background at a company that has taken a product through initial FedRAMP or IL5/IL6 authorization, not only maintained an existing one.

• Experience integrating third-party or acquired products into a broader corporate platform and go-to-market motion.

Why Veeam

Veeam is the global leader in data resilience, trusted by organizations worldwide — including a growing footprint across U.S. federal, state, and local government. This role offers the opportunity to shape how one of the industry's most trusted data platforms, alongside Securiti AI's federal capabilities, is built and certified for the most demanding government environments, with direct visibility to Veeam's CTO and public sector executive leadership.

What you'll get

• Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares

• Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

• Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program

• 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions

• Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time

• AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost

• Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options

• Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting

• Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

Compensation Range (OTE)

$309,000—$641,800 USD

Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.

By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.

jobs.title: Full Time Lead Toddler Teacher (Montessori Training Provided)
jobs.description:
Montessori Training Provided | $40,000–$50,000

Are you an experienced early childhood educator ready to take the next step in your teaching career? We'd love to meet you!

At Guidepost Montessori, we believe great teachers come from many different educational backgrounds. You do not need Montessori experience or certification to apply! If you have early childhood education experience, meet Illinois Lead Teacher qualifications and are passionate about helping young children grow, we can provide the Montessori training you need to succeed.

We offer the opportunity to earn a fully sponsored Montessori diploma through our Prepared Montessorian Institute (PMI) while gaining hands-on experience in a supportive classroom environment.

Help toddlers discover who they are and what they can do.

At Guidepost Montessori, our Lead Toddler Guides create calm, purposeful environments where curiosity, independence and confidence grow every day.

If you're passionate about early childhood development and ready to lead a classroom designed for exploration and independence, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Your Role

As a Lead Toddler Teacher (Lead Guide), you'll lead a classroom of children ages 2–3 in a Montessori environment thoughtfully designed to support children during one of the most formative stages of development.

Montessori guides prepare beautiful, orderly environments that invite exploration and support independence. Through careful observation, individualized lessons and respectful guidance, you'll help each child develop language, coordination, self-regulation and confidence.

Your leadership will empower toddlers to explore freely, make choices and take pride in what they can accomplish, laying the foundation for lifelong learning.

New to Montessori? That's okay! We welcome experienced early childhood educators who are excited to learn the Montessori approach. Through our sponsored training program, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills and grow as a Montessori educator.

What You'll Do

• Observe each child closely to understand and support their physical, emotional and cognitive development

• Prepare and maintain a beautiful, orderly classroom that fosters focus, independence and exploration

• Support independence by encouraging toddlers to "do it themselves"

• Provide lessons in practical life skills, language development and grace and courtesy

• Build warm, trusting relationships with children and families

• Communicate and collaborate with parents to support each child's growth

• Lead classroom routines and collaborate with team members to create a respectful, joyful community

The Montessori Prepared Environment

Every Guidepost toddler classroom is fully equipped with high-quality Montessori materials and designed according to the principles of beauty, order and independence.

Our toddler environments feature:

• Open spaces that encourage movement and exploration

• Child-sized furniture and tools to support independence

• Curriculum that builds skills in dressing, feeding and toilet learning

• Scientifically designed materials for fine and gross motor development

• Natural elements including cozy rugs, real plants and abundant light

• Beautiful, breakable materials made from wood, metal and glass

• Opportunities to climb, crawl and explore without restrictive devices

What We're Looking For

Montessori experience is not required! We're looking for a passionate early childhood educator who is ready to lead a toddler classroom and grow professionally.

Required Qualifications:

• Meet Illinois DCFS Teacher Qualified (TQ) requirements with the necessary Early Childhood Education or Child Development college credits

• Experience working with young children, preferably ages 0–3, in a childcare, preschool or early learning setting

• A passion for early childhood education and supporting children's independence

• Strong classroom management, communication and organizational skills

• Ability to build positive relationships with children, families and fellow educators

• Willingness to learn and implement the Montessori approach

Preferred but Not Required:

• Previous experience as a Lead Teacher or Assistant Teacher in an early childhood classroom

• Montessori training or certification

jobs.title: Account Manager -  NYC
jobs.description:
About F. Schumacher & Co

Schumacher & Co. is a fast-growing and innovative interior design company. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. We are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. It challenges convention. It brings a unique point of view into the world. It sets trends. And it leaves a mark. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company of many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of our floorcovering brand, Patterson Flynn.

Patterson Flynn, the rug and carpet atelier, is the ultimate destination for tantalizing products with irrefutable style, premium decorator staples that are the best of their kind, and unparalleled service that is accountable and unconditional.

Our floorcovering brand Patterson Flynn is seeking a highly motivated, professional, design savvy Account Manager for our NYC trade - only showroom. The Account Manager represents Patterson Flynn across a geographic territory, bringing our floor covering to the designers and architects shaping the most interesting projects in the market. This is a road-based role. Most of your week is spent where the work happens, in designers' offices, at job sites, and in client presentations, building the relationships that bring new projects our way. This role will be based in NYC, NJ, Connecticut and the Philadelphia metro area.

Responsibilities

Territory and travel

• Own a defined geographic territory and build a weekly plan that keeps you close to your clients.

• Visit designers, architects and project teams at their offices; attend job sites and installations where the project calls for it.

• Analyze the territory to identify growth opportunities among existing accounts and prospects, and prioritize where your time goes.

• Introduce Patterson Flynn to firms who have not yet worked with us, and reconnect with those we have not seen in a while.

Selling and specification

• Maximize sales across all Patterson Flynn categories, including broadloom, custom rugs, and the labor and installation that goes with them.

• Present collections and line shows in a way that is tailored to each client's work and style. Prepare comprehensive proposals and quotes specific to the project, and see them through to close.

• Maintain current knowledge of product, pricing, lead times, competitors and trends, so clients can rely on what you promise them.

• Work with the showroom and workroom teams on samples, custom specifications and installation scheduling.

Pipeline and reporting

• Keep every quote and order current in our sales system, so pipeline and forecast are accurate at any time.

• Stay in regular contact on open quotes.

• Consistent follow-up is what carries a promising project across the line.

• Report on territory performance, forecast expected closings and invoicing, and bring roadblocks to your manager early.

• Provide the highest standard of service throughout, consistent with our position in the luxury market.

Requirements

Essentials

• Enthusiasm for being out in the territory most days

• Dependable transportation and a clean driving record.

• The independence to shape your own week, and the discipline to make the most of it.

• Confidence introducing yourself to firms who do not yet know us, and genuine enjoyment in building a network.

Sales experience

• A track record of setting ambitious sales goals and reaching them, and of guiding a sale through to close.

• Experience managing multiple accounts and building trusting, mutually successful client relationships.

• Ability to establish and execute a multi-brand account strategy in the interior design market.

• Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, including high-potential customers and new accounts.

• Creative thinking to build account-level sales and develop new business in a rapidly changing environment.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to build something of your own within an established brand.

General

• Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with real ownership of your territory and its results.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficiency in MS Windows and Office suite; comfort learning our sales and reporting systems.

• Basic knowledge and proficiency with Instagram and social media.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt to change.

Preferred

• Experience selling to the design trade, ideally in floor covering, textiles or another specified product.

• An existing network of designers and architects in the territory.

Your well-being is our top priority. Our benefits and total compensation are designed for the whole person, caring for both you and your family.

jobs.title: Global Tax and Treasury Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the Role

Neo4j is seeking a Senior Manager, Global Tax and Treasury to manage the tax and treasury function for a global, high-growth enterprise software company. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for global tax compliance and planning, cash and liquidity management, banking and the processes and controls needed to support Neo4j's continued international growth.

The role will partner closely with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, and external advisors across Neo4j's global operations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment with an operator's mindset: comfortable setting strategy, working through complex cross-border matters, and executing the underlying work in a lean environment.

What You'll Do

Tax

• Own Neo4j's global tax compliance calendar, including U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise taxes; international corporate income taxes; sales and use taxes; and VAT/GST across the jurisdictions in which Neo4j operates

• Manage global tax advisors and coordinate the preparation and review of income tax returns, estimated payments, extensions, tax audits, and other tax authority inquiries

• Lead the income tax provision process under ASC 740, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, tax account reconciliations, and support for the annual financial statement audit

• Own transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, and contemporaneous documentation for cross-border services, software and intellectual property arrangements, and intercompany funding

• Manage indirect tax compliance and strategy for Neo4j's software subscriptions, cloud offerings, professional services, marketplace transactions, and channel sales, including nexus analyses, registrations, exemption documentation, and product taxability

• Evaluate the tax implications of new products and commercial models, international expansion, legal entity changes, acquisitions, and post-acquisition integration

• Monitor international tax developments relevant to Neo4j, including OECD requirements as applicable, withholding and permanent establishment exposure, and evolving SaaS taxability rules

• Establish scalable, audit-ready tax processes, documentation, and internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reduce reliance on manual processes

• Oversee the global tax compliance requirements associated with employee equity compensation, including stock options and RSUs, and coordinate local tax withholding, payroll, reporting, and employer compliance requirements

• Oversee tax attributes and incentives, including R&D tax credits and net operating losses, and coordinate ownership-change analyses under Section 382 with external advisors

Treasury

• Own global cash management, including daily cash visibility and cash concentration across legal entities, bank accounts, and currencies

• Manage banking relationships and the bank account lifecycle, including account openings and closures, signatories, administrative access, and appropriate segregation of duties

jobs.description:
The International Research Olympiad (IRO) is a premier global STEM competition that tests science research ability for students aged 13–18. Students from more than 89 countries have taken part, making IRO the largest global community of young students interested in research.

Unlike traditional science olympiads that focus on specific subjects, IRO builds skills useful in any research discipline. Participants deepen their understanding of the scientific process and develop creativity, critical thinking and analysis skills, forming a foundation for later success. IRO is supported by a Board of Advisors and a growing network of partner organizations, including Indigo Research, Punjab Group and Google for Nonprofits, and runs student programs such as IRO Clubs and the IRO Ambassador program.

The IRO Program Manager will be the dedicated full-time owner of IRO’s growth and day-to-day running. You will be accountable for growing registrations and paid participation, building the partnerships, clubs and community that bring students in, and running the competition smoothly as it scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. IRO already has a large global audience and an engaged student community; your job is to turn them, together with school and organizational partnerships, into a repeatable growth engine. You will work closely with IRO’s leadership, Board of Advisors, partner organizations, ambassadors and schools, and you are accountable not simply for running the competition, but for growing it.

Growth & Partnerships

• Identify current and future mentor shortages in specific disciplines.
• Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts, including drafting job descriptions, posting roles, proactive sourcing, conducting interviews and sending offers and contracts.
• Provide training and onboarding for mentors to ensure a seamless transition into the program.
• Organize regular quality review meetings with mentors to discuss performance, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement.

Competition Operations & In-Person Finals

• Coordinate the full competition cycle, including registration, online rounds, the in-person Finals, results, awards and certificates
• Keep practice exams, curriculum resources and rules up to date for students and teachers
• Provide clear, timely support to students, parents, teachers and partners throughout the cycle
• Own end-to-end logistics for the in-person IRO Finals, from venue selection and contracting through to event day
• Manage the Finals budget, vendors, catering, AV, signage, printed materials and awards
• Coordinate finalist communications, including invitations, registration, travel and accommodation guidance, visa letters and on-site schedules
• Plan the Finals program, including the exam, presentations, judging, ceremonies and networking, with advisors, judges, partners and volunteers
• Ensure student safety and wellbeing on site, including chaperone requirements, consent forms and emergency procedures
• Build processes and run post-event reviews so IRO and its Finals run smoothly at much higher volume without compromising quality

Board of Advisors & Reporting

• Serve as the main point of contact for IRO’s Board of Advisors, managing communication, onboarding and day-to-day relationships
• Plan and run Board meetings, including scheduling, agendas, briefing materials, minutes and follow-up on action items
• Coordinate Board involvement in the competition, including exam and question review, judging, awards and the Finals
• Recruit and onboard new advisors as IRO grows, keeping Board profiles and public listings up to date
• Keep the Board informed with regular updates on registrations, results, partnerships and key decisions
• Create dashboards and regular reporting on registrations, revenue and partner performance for IRO leadership and the Board
• Track participant data accurately so outcomes, alumni and partner impact can be measured over time

Required Skills:

• 1–3 years of experience in partnerships, program operations, events or growth
• Experience doing outreach to schools, educators or organizations and following through to signed partnerships
• Experience planning and running in-person events, ideally for students or international attendees
• Experience supporting a board, advisory group or senior stakeholders, including meetings and communications
• Experience coordinating multi-stakeholder projects with fixed deadlines
• Background in education, research, STEM, competitions or youth programming is a plus
• Experience in research competitions or olympiads, as a participant or organizer, is a plus

jobs.title: Power Support Manager
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Power Support Manager

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Power Support Manager at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. This position is fully remote.

The Power Support Manager is responsible for leading nationwide service operations for the Power Solutions fleet, with a primary focus on maximizing equipment availability, minimizing downtime, and ensuring timely, cost-effective maintenance and repairs.
This role oversees commissioning technicians, service writers, and maintenance technicians while coordinating with field operations, product specialists, and branch leadership to support fleet reliability and customer commitments.

Primary Responsibilities

• Maximize available OEC by reducing equipment downtime, accelerating repairs, and returning assets to rental-ready condition.

• Manage nationwide service personnel, including commissioning technicians, service writers, and maintenance technicians.

• Ensure accurate work-order documentation, repair tracking, technician assignments, and timely completion of service activities.

• Coordinate troubleshooting, commissioning, equipment startups, and complex repairs with internal technical teams and OEMs.

• Coordinate parts availability, warranty claims, outside repairs, and OEM support to minimize repair delays and control costs.

• Prioritize technician deployment and service activities based on equipment availability, customer needs, and operational demands.

• Establish and monitor service KPIs, including equipment downtime, repair turnaround time, and technician productivity.

• Develop standardized service procedures, maintenance practices, and reporting across the national fleet.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Strong understanding of diesel and natural gas generators, electrical power systems, and associated support equipment. Demonstrated ability to manage geographically dispersed service teams. Experience with maintenance planning, work-order systems, fleet management, and OEM relationships. Strong operational leadership, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to travel nationally as required. Education and Experience: High School Diploma or Equivalent Education At least 10+ years of experience managing service operations for industrial power generation, rental equipment, or similar heavy equipment. Physical Requirements: Ability to travel up to 25% of the time as business needs require Must be able to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

jobs.title: Middle School ELA Teacher
jobs.description:
Uncommon Middle School English Language Arts (ELA) teachers are passionate about literature and building an engaging classroom culture. Our teachers develop subject mastery and have a keen sense of the socio-emotional changes middle schoolers experience. At the heart of all ELA classes is an emphasis on writing and discourse designed to give students the tools to be confident in the power of their own voice. Teachers are trained in a variety of research-based instructional strategies to prioritize discussion, ignite a passion for literature, build reading comprehension, and promote agency. By the conclusion of eighth grade, students are prepared for the academic autonomy and college preparatory focus of our high schools.

Responsibilities

1.     Instruction

• You'll empower students to be their fullest selves by teaching an inclusive, culturally responsive curriculum that seeks equitable outcomes for all students.
• You'll guide students to analyze literary and non-narrative texts, assess an author's purpose, write in a variety of genres, and grapple with meaningful questions in student-led discourse.
• You'll create an inclusive and safe environment, allying with students to speak and write in their authentic voice.
• You’ll guide students to choose books of interest independently, as they develop their own passions and interests as readers.

2.     Data Analysis

• You'll meet weekly with your principal and/or instructional coach to analyze and respond to trends in student work samples and assessments.
• You'll learn and implement strategies to differentiate instruction for all learners in your classroom.

3.     School Culture

• You’ll build positive relationships with students to ensure they feel seen, loved, and heard.
• You’ll partner with students’ families to ensure appropriate resources are available to support their child's learning needs.
• You'll engage in practice-based professional development, mentorship, and coaching sessions.
• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to cultivate community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• A demonstrated commitment to supporting students’ social emotional and academic development
• An enthusiasm for collaborating with internal and external partners in the best interest of students
• A self-directed learner who solicits and implements feedback to improve outcomes and achieve objectives
• Required Experience:A demonstrated interest in impacting K-12 students in urban schools and communities (1-2 years experience preferred).Academic expertise in Humanities, English, Social Sciences, or other related fields of study.Prior to the start of employment, you must have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and have earned a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or higher by the time employment begins. You do not need to be certified to be hired; however, if hired you will need to pass state teacher certification tests to meet the MA state requirements.All Commonwealth charter teachers must either have an appropriate MA educator’s license or pass required the MTEL(s) including the Communications and Literacy MTEL , Subject Specific MTEL, and the MTEL SEI (Sheltered English Immersion) Endorsement within first year of employment. All core academic teachers* assigned to teach English learners are required to earn the SEI endorsement. Any teacher without a SEI endorsement has one year from date of assignment to teach ELs, to earn the MTEL SEI endorsement.

Our people are what make us Uncommon.  We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

Our Approach to AI and Your Application

At Uncommon Schools, we value thoughtful use of technology. Your responses should begin with your own thinking and reflect your authentic voice, experiences, and commitment to our mission. Generative AI can be used to refine or organize writing, but not to generate initial responses or replace your ideas. Every application is reviewed by a member of our Recruitment Team, and we are committed to understanding the person behind the application.

Compensation

Compensation for this role is between $71,000 to $116,000.

Starting pay is determined using various factors including but not limited to relevant full-time teaching experience, education certifications, and tenure with Uncommon Schools. Candidates without full-time Teaching experience will likely have a starting salary of $71,000.

Benefits:

• Extensive, best-in-class training and development
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans + pre-tax flexible spending (FSA), dependent care (DCFSA), and health saving accounts (HSA)
• Financial PlanningPension through Mass. Teachers Retirement System 403(b) retirement savings program
• Transit Commuter Benefit with employer subsidy toward eligible transit expenses

jobs.title: Speech and Language Pathologist Assistant
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is seeking a Speech and Language Pathologist Assistant (SLP-A) to support the communication and educational development of children with speech, language, and social communication needs. In this role, you will help implement individualized educational programming and provide direct and indirect speech and language services to support students with articulation, voice, fluency, language, and pragmatic language impairments. You will collaborate with teachers and other school personnel to promote communication development and help students generalize their skills across school environments.

Schedule: 7:00 AM–3:00 PM, two days per week. Any combination of Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, or Friday is available.

Location: Naugatuck, CT

Qualifications:

• Current Certification as a Speech Language Pathologist Assistant

• Ability to communicate effectively with parents, school districts, and all levels of staff across the organization.

• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.

• Must have satisfactory background checks

• Valid driver’s license and safe driving record

Key Responsibilities:

Consultation

• Provides in-service education and/or serves as a consultant to teachers and other school employees on topics related to speech and language skills (e.g., Augmentative or Alternative Communication, curriculum modification) to ensure generalization of language skills across school environments.

Intervention

• Provides direct and indirect speech/language therapy services based on student need, in alignment with each student’s IEP service hours. Collects data to support service provided and progress toward IEP goals and objectives.

Relationships, Communication, Professional Development

• Demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills and outstanding interpersonal skills.

• Cultivates a positive and productive workplace atmosphere to enhance team morale and productivity.

• Participates in and complete training sessions as delegated by management to enhance skills and knowledge relevant to the role.

• Conducts training as required and assigned.

• Performs any additional job responsibilities assigned by supervisors or team leaders to support the organization's smooth operation.

• Accepts reassignment as required.

Working Conditions:

As a Speech and Language Therapist Assistant dedicated to supporting children in the school setting, you'll find yourself immersed in a dynamic and impactful environment. Here's what you can expect regarding working conditions:

• Primary work is done within the classroom however it is expected that staff will monitor/work with students during indoor/outdoor physical activities (playground/gym); support students during academic, related service (Speech, OT, PT), and behavioral programming; and assist in toileting if applicable.

• This role may encounter challenging behaviors and situations, requiring patience, empathy, and effective behavior management strategies and the ability to perform Physical Management Techniques (PMT) as needed.

• Ability to handle physical aspects of job, including bending, stooping, lifting, pushing, pulling, reaching, and walking for periods of time.

• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times.

• May be required to travel.

• Reasonable accommodation can be made to enable qualified people with disabilities to perform the described essential functions of this position.

• Working conditions may vary depending on the specific classroom, and the assigned children’s needs.

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance - Choose from multiple medical plans, with vision coverage included at no extra cost.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Saving Account (HSA) options - Use pre-tax dollars for medical and dependent care expenses.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts with JOON - Monthly funds for wellness, fitness, commuting, childcare, pet care, and more.

• 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Match - A 100% match on contributions up to 2% of your salary.

• Generous Paid Time Off - Paid sick, personal, and vacation days, plus holidays.

The Executive Director of New Product Planning is responsible for new product opportunity assessments and the commercial strategy for lifecycle indications of IMVT-1402.  Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, this position leads commercial strategy and market development efforts for new products and follow-on indications from ideation through handoff to the launch team for build-out approximately 24 months pre-launch.  Leading their team and partnering with commercial, the Executive Director will work to identify and prioritize potential new indications and manage commercial strategy for indications in development.

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - Managed EDR
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Product Marketing

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $180,000 to $210,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager for Huntress Managed EDR. We are looking for a product marketer to take our Managed EDR product positioning and messaging to the next level and help Huntress win even more customers.

This position is responsible for the primary aspects of product marketing for Managed EDR, including positioning and messaging, content creation, sales enablement, and the overall go-to-market strategy. The ideal candidate should be passionate about cybersecurity and have a proven history of success in product marketing. You will need the ability to collaborate with product, marketing, sales, and security.

Responsibilities:

• Positioning and Messaging: Develop and evolve a compelling narrative and value proposition for Huntress Managed EDR.

• Content and Campaigns: Build content and help design campaigns that highlight the offering’s differentiators and benefits to stand out from the competition.

• Product Alignment: Partner with Product Management to drive the strategy around product positioning for existing capabilities and new launches. You will help plan and launch new offerings, capabilities, and releases to the market.

• Sales Enablement: Be the subject matter expert and product evangelist. Work with the sales team to develop programs that help drive the pipeline, convert opportunities, and expand into existing accounts.

• Demand Generation: Work with the Growth Marketing and Brand teams to hone the strategy and marketing programs that drive demand. Be proactive in recognizing where the business may need marketing support and the effective levers to pull.

What You Bring To The Team:

• 8+ years of product marketing experience in cybersecurity.

• Experience with, and a technical understanding of, endpoint security technologies like EDR and EPP is required for the role.

• A proven track record of creating messaging, positioning, assets, and supporting campaign concepts that stand out in the marketplace and resonate with prospects. We want someone who isn’t afraid to push the envelope and try new things to help Huntress win new business.

• Strong emotional intelligence and a natural collaborator. We need a high-performance self-starter who is always up for a challenge and takes ownership of their work. We’re looking for someone who can work across teams and handle the ups and downs of a rapid-growth company as we scale up.

• Strong spoken and written communication skills with an ability to break down complex concepts into understandable messaging. Expertise in collaborating with design and content marketing teams to create a range of different types of content (one-pagers, website content, whitepapers, demo videos, etc.).

• Comfortable creating and delivering presentations in a range of environments, with a talent for persuasive communication.

• Creativity, energy, enthusiasm, and a strong desire to put your stamp on the product and make a big difference for Huntress and the customers we serve. We want someone who believes in the Huntress mission as much as we do.

What We Offer:

jobs.title: Sr Data Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Jersey City, NJ | Contract | Onsite | Payrate: $75/hr

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Data Architect to join our cross-functional Agile team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performing cloud data platforms using Snowflake.

You will define how data is stored, integrated, secured, and used across the organisation, ensuring that data architecture aligns with business objectives and supports analytics, reporting, and strategic decision-making.

Working closely with data engineers, backend and frontend developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, you will develop enterprise data models and architecture solutions that support application development and business intelligence.

This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, establish architectural best practices, and contribute to enterprise-wide data transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Enterprise Data Architecture: Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise data architecture using Snowflake and AWS cloud technologies.

• Data Modelling and Design: Define and maintain enterprise data models, schemas, and architectural standards, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Vault 2.0 methodologies.

• Data Integration and Transformation: Architect data ingestion, integration, and transformation strategies using ETL/ELT frameworks and technologies such as dbt, Airflow, Kafka, and related tools.

• Performance and Cost Optimisation: Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of Snowflake data platforms through effective architecture and optimisation techniques.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish data security, governance, and compliance standards, including access controls, role-based permissions, data masking, and data protection policies.

• Technology Selection and Integration: Evaluate, select, and integrate appropriate data engineering, orchestration, and analytics tools to support enterprise requirements.

• Technical Guidance: Provide architectural guidance to data engineering teams, review technical designs, and promote consistent engineering standards.

• Architecture Standards and Documentation: Establish and maintain architectural best practices, technical documentation, and data design standards.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with engineering, analytics, product, and business teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Cloud Architecture: Design and support cloud-based data architecture across AWS, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology strategies.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

Data Architecture & Modelling

• Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise-level data platforms and data warehouse architectures.

• In-depth knowledge of Snowflake architecture, including data modelling, performance optimisation, and cost management.

• Experience with dimensional modelling techniques, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Vault 2.0.

• Advanced SQL skills, including query optimisation, data transformation, and complex data modelling.

• Understanding of enterprise data warehousing, analytics architecture, and data integration patterns.

Data Engineering & Cloud Technologies

• Hands-on experience with dbt for data transformation, modelling, and maintaining production data pipelines.

• Experience with workflow orchestration and data integration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, Kafka, or similar technologies.

• Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion frameworks.

• Knowledge of AWS cloud services and cloud-based data platform architecture.

• Experience integrating Snowflake with data engineering, orchestration, and business intelligence tools such as Sigma and Qlik.

Data Governance, Security & Performance

• Understanding of enterprise data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Experience implementing data security controls, access management, and data protection policies.

• Knowledge of performance tuning, workload optimisation, and cost management within cloud data platforms.

• Ability to develop and maintain architectural documentation, design standards, and technical best practices.

Collaboration & Delivery

• Ability to approach complex technical challenges with a strategic, enterprise-wide perspective.

• Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring engineers, and reviewing architecture designs.

• Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across engineering, analytics, and business teams.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and managing delivery activities using Jira.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Typically 7–10+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics.

• Demonstrated experience in a data architecture or technical leadership role.

• Experience building, deploying, and maintaining scalable dbt projects in production environments using Snowflake and Airflow.

• Experience maintaining high standards of technical documentation, data quality, governance, and platform performance.

• Snowflake and relevant cloud certifications are advantageous.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities:

As a General Manager (GM), your primary responsibilities include:

• Leading by example and being a role model for the standards and behaviors consistent with the core values and culture of Bozzuto

• Inspiring the team to effectively execute sales, marketing and operational activities that achieve budgeted occupancy and customer retention goals

• Managing the financial performance of the property in accordance with the established budget

• Effectively coaching all team members to understand how they contribute to the big picture

• Creating and delivering timely and accurate financial and operational performance reports to clients and ownership groups that clearly explain operational effectiveness, trends and variances

• Cultivating and maintaining strong, loyal relationships with all constituents—owners, residents, employees and vendors

• Being an expert on the competitive marketplace and effectively coaching the team to proficiency in differentiating the community and Bozzuto from competition

• Partnering with consumer marketing to implement marketing strategies that position the community as a destination for people seeking engaged and enriched living experiences

• Creating an operating environment that assures consistent guest satisfaction and yields outstanding customer satisfaction ratings and community reviews

• Working weekends when prospective residents are out looking for their new home—one weekend per month with two days off during the week

• Inspiring the professional growth and development of all team members by encouraging knowledge sharing and collaboration

• Supporting participation in training and educational opportunities

You Create Value by:

• Building a motivating environment that encourages your team to give their very best

• Coaching in the moment and providing team members with opportunities to develop their skills while simultaneously developing your own

• Proactively managing the performance of all team members through performance reviews, regular constructive feedback and development/growth plans

• Connecting with people by engaging in meaningful conversations that demonstrate your concern and genuine desire to make them feel at home

• Taking responsibility for customers’ problems, making sure they’re solved and treating them like you would your best friend

• You play an active role in making certain the community is impeccable

• You roll up your sleeves and assist team members—no job is “below your pay grade”

What You Bring to Us:

• 4 year college degree or equivalent relevant experience

• 5+ years of experience in the property management, hospitality or retail industries

• A track record of success building, developing and retaining high-performing teams

• A track record of building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, investors, ownership groups and vendors

• Experience managing a budget and/or P&L

• Proficiency with industry software (YARDI), apps and computer programs

• Strong financial skills with a basic knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)

• Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal

• A sharp professional appearance

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

Salary Range

$90,000—$93,000 USD

When you join Bozzuto, you're not just accepting a job; you are becoming part of a community that cares about your overall well-being and professional growth. We recognize that our team members are the core of our business, and we are committed to taking care of them so they can deliver outstanding experiences to our residents. In addition to an award-winning culture, our benefits take into consideration everything from career development, retirement, family matters and health and wellness.

Working on our team and in this position, you can expect:

• Health & wellness benefits. We offer coverage for medical, dental, and vision, including access to the best doctors at an affordable price.

• Paid leave. We provide 20 days of paid time off plus holidays.

• Retirement planning. We offer a 401k program with a company match.

• Tuition reimbursement. Plus, many other programs to support career development and growth.

• A place you belong. We proudly offer a diverse range of employee resource groups, providing opportunities for our employees to connect over shared experiences, backgrounds, and cultures.

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. jobs.description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Purpose:

We are looking for an experienced Advanced Provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide primary care to homebound and palliative care patients in the Charles County, MD region on a part time basis (2-3 days/week). You will apply medical techniques and principles under the supervision of a physician and you will care for a diverse set of patients with chronic diseases.

What You'll Do:

• Provide high quality care to primary and palliative patients in and around Charles County, MD

• Assess patient's health by performing physical examinations; obtaining, updating, and studying medical histories and creating the best plan for care.

• Develop impressions, diagnosis, and treatment plans

• Foster trust and consult with patients, families, and caregivers during visits

What You'll Need:

• Board Certified, with a valid NP or PA certification in the state of Maryland

• Strong clinical skills with the ability to accurately and confidently treat, assess, and diagnose

• Positive demeanor and strong people skills

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Review Specialist (AI/LLM Governance)
jobs.description:
Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.
What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About the Client

A global technology leader specializing in search technology, digital advertising, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence. Delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure and software solutions, the organization builds scalable consumer and enterprise AI experiences. Today, the company leverages foundational AI models and advanced machine learning to power digital ecosystems for billions of global users.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct formal, end-to-end written privacy reviews for products, features, research publications, data pipelines, and experimental prototypes

• Evaluate privacy risks and recommend practical safeguards aligned with internal standards and applicable global regulations

• Manage reviews from initial discovery and risk identification through remediation and final approval

• Provide strategic guidance and support the escalation of complex or high-risk privacy matters

• Maintain accurate, detailed, and audit-ready assessment documentation

• Assess the privacy implications of AI, machine learning, generative AI, and Large Language Model systems

• Evaluate data ingestion, prompt inputs, context windows, model outputs, training workflows, inference processes, and human-in-the-loop oversight

• Identify potential risks involving personal data, data leakage, memorization, secondary use, data retention, and inappropriate model outputs

• Recommend appropriate privacy controls for experimental and production AI systems

• Support the responsible development and launch of emerging AI capabilities

• Review technical design documents, Product Requirements Documents, Business Requirements Documents, system architecture diagrams, data-lineage documentation, and academic publications

• Identify privacy touchpoints, data dependencies, and potential gaps across product and data-processing lifecycles

• Translate privacy, legal, and compliance requirements into practical and actionable guidance for product and engineering teams

• Evaluate complex product scenarios in which requirements, risks, or ownership may not yet be clearly defined

• Partner with product managers, software engineers, data scientists, legal teams, and privacy stakeholders to incorporate privacy controls throughout the product lifecycle

• Evaluate controls relating to notice and consent, transparency, user choice, data portability, data minimization, access, and retention

• Review data-collection practices, consent flows, access controls, privacy policies, and user-facing privacy notices

• Help teams make informed product decisions that balance innovation, regulatory obligations, and user trust

• Identify gaps in existing privacy-review processes and recommend operational improvements

• Develop and refine privacy frameworks, standard operating procedures, guidelines, templates, and review criteria

• Support operational reporting and program-management activities across the privacy lifecycle

• Use custom tools and AI technologies to automate workflows, improve review efficiency, and optimize governance operations

• Help establish consistent and scalable privacy-review practices across research and innovation teams

What You Bring

• Extensive hands-on experience conducting formal written privacy reviews, assessments, or impact analyses

• Product-focused privacy experience within technology, digital platforms, cloud services, AI, or similarly complex environments

• An active IAPP certification in at least one of the following: Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States, Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe, Certified Information Privacy Manager

• Practical knowledge of AI and machine learning data-processing workflows, generative AI applications, and Large Language Models

• Understanding of privacy risks associated with model-training data, user inputs, inference processes, and model outputs

• Deep knowledge of privacy principles, including notice and consent, transparency, user choice, data portability, data minimization, and retention

• Knowledge of relevant privacy and AI regulatory frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, and the EU AI Act

• Ability to interpret complex software-design documents, system architectures, data flows, and product requirements

• Experience managing multiple reviews and competing priorities under tight deadlines

• Strong judgment and the ability to make well-supported recommendations in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to translate legal and compliance requirements into clear, actionable technical guidance

• Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across product, engineering, legal, and governance teams

Nice to have

• Familiarity with enterprise privacy-review, governance, and product-launch tools

• Experience supporting privacy governance for research, experimental products, or emerging technologies

• Experience working with cross-functional legal, ethics, privacy, product, and engineering governance bodies

• Experience automating privacy-review or governance workflows using AI or custom tooling

• A degree in Law, Computer Science, Data Governance, Information Security, or a related discipline

• Additional privacy, security, risk, or AI-governance certifications

English level

Advanced

Work Type

Remote

Working Hours:

Alignment with west coast US time zone

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location within the United States, and business needs.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us.

Exadel Culture
