jobs.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - SMB (FULL-SERVICE RESTAURANTS)

Location: Ottawa, ON or Toronto, ON | Hybrid (4 days/week)
Department: SMB Sales | Full-service Restaurant
Department Leader: Shawna Rioux, VP, SMB Sales https://www.linkedin.com/in/shawnarioux/
Type: Permanent | Full-Time | Existing Vacancy




ABOUT SOLINK

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!




THE ROLE

We’re looking for curious and energetic sales talent to join our fast-growing team that works with some of the biggest brands in quick service restaurants, retailers, hospitality and financial organizations. The ideal candidate should have experience with sales prospecting and business development and has worked as an Account Executive selling SaaS.

Are you a self starter and not afraid to take initiative? Do you enjoy building and nurturing relationships? Do you enjoy presenting and conducting product demos? Do you thrive in collaborating and working in an ENERGETIC Team environment?... Then this opportunity is for YOU!




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Prospect with Purpose: Identify and reach out to brands you admire and customers who would benefit from Solink—using a smart, targeted, and proactive approach.

 - Own the Full Sales Cycle: From discovery and demos to pricing, negotiation, and close—you’ll lead every step with confidence and precision.

 - Deliver High-Impact Demos: Present Solink’s platform in a compelling way that speaks to each customer’s unique challenges and goals.

 - Hit (and Exceed) Your Targets: Consistently meet or exceed quota, while staying focused on quality conversations, qualified pipeline, and long-term customer value.

 - Have Fun Doing It: Celebrate wins, bring energy, and enjoy the journey—because culture matters just as much as closing.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Team Player with Individual Hustle: You love celebrating wins with a supportive team—but you also hold yourself to a high standard and consistently push to exceed your own goals.

 - Value-Driven Communicator: You can clearly connect the dots between a customer’s pain points and Solink’s value. You’re equally fluent in big-picture impact and detailed product differentiation.

 - Relationship Builder: Whether it’s with teammates or prospects, you build trust naturally and quickly. You understand people, meet them where they are, and connect with empathy.

 - Growth-Oriented: You’re a sponge for feedback and personal development. You invest in your own growth and actively share learnings with your team.

 - Goal Crusher: Quotas aren’t ceilings—they’re starting points. You set the bar high and love surpassing it.

 - Customer-Centric Listener: You’re naturally curious and know that listening—not pitching—is the foundation of great discovery and great deals.

 - Creative Problem Solver: Challenges energize you. You think on your feet and approach obstacles with creativity and a solution-first mindset.




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

 - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

 - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.
   

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.




WHY SOLINK?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

 - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

 - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

 - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

 - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

 - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

 - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

 5. Reference Checks

 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉


PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.




SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

jobs.description:
Operations Lead

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is looking for an Operations Lead for our Arizona team. The ideal candidate enjoys being hands-on, possesses a unique ability to motivate others, and is a natural problem-solver who feeds off variety and is calm under pressure.

The Operations Lead is responsible for coordinating and supporting the daily operations of our Onsite support and lab services. This role involves scheduling, logistics management, administrative support, compliance, and safety to ensure efficient and effective service delivery. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compliance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.

This position reports to the Operations Manager.

Responsibilities:

Scheduling and Coordination:

• Create and maintain schedules for transportation, onsite environmental services, ensuring optimal resource allocation.

• Coordinate with field teams, clients, and vendors to schedule services and deliveries.

• Monitor and adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes in project scope or client needs.

• Collaborate with the team of managers in the region to develop staffing strategies, maintain trainings, and update processes

• Communicate scheduling updates and changes to all relevant stakeholders.

Personnel Management:

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

• Application Review

• Interview with Recruiters

• Tech Screening with Engineering Team (Coding Interview)

• Technicals Interviews (Architecture live cases)

• Offer

About the Team

The IAM team is at the core of QuintoAndar's platform security. We build and maintain the systems that guarantee the right people and the right services have access to the right resources at the right time. We handle millions of authentication requests daily, and our services are the foundation of trust for the entire QuintoAndar ecosystem.

Responsibilities

These are the Senior Software Engineer responsibilities in the IAM team:

• Build Core Security Systems: Design, develop, and scale QuintoAndar's centralized Authentication (AuthN) and Authorization (AuthZ) platforms.

• Solve Complex Engineering Challenges: Succeed in a wide range of complex situations across multiple axes, focusing heavily on scale, resilience, fault tolerance, and low latency (auth checks happen on every request!).

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with other engineering teams, product managers, and the broader Security organization to define paved roads for secure service-to-service and user-to-service communication.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Be responsible for the entire software development lifecycle of IAM products: definition, development, testing, production deployment, and maintenance.

• Quality & Mentorship: Be a guardian of your team's delivery quality by reinforcing the adoption of good software development practices. Participate in design and code reviews, and mentor other software engineers.

• Operational Excellence: Handle incidents, troubleshoot, and debug software issues with a learning mindset. Create post-mortems and take actions to avoid similar incidents in the future. Actively monitor the health and performance of auth services.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

• Software Engineering Expertise: Proficient in one or more programming languages commonly used in our stack (such as Java, Kotlin, or Go/Python).

• Architecture & API Design: Experience designing and evolving scalable software architecture from the ground up, and highly skilled in creating secure RESTful APIs.

• Agile & Fundamentals: Proven experience with Agile development practices. Solid software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, deployment automation, and design documentation.

• Database & Observability: Strong understanding of database design and evolution. Experience with tools and practices for software monitoring, observability, and performance tracking.

• Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail; people that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software.

• Languages: Fluency in Portuguese and advanced English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials, and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries.

You´ll stand out if you:

• Have experience designing, implementing, or migrating centralized Identity Providers (IdP) or fine-grained authorization systems (e.g., Zanzibar-based models, OPA).

• Have IAM Fundamentals: Proven knowledge and practical experience with Authentication and Authorization concepts, protocols, and standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, JWT, RBAC/ABAC)

• Have experience with cloud service platforms (AWS, GCP) and their native IAM/Security services.

• Understand the challenges of Service-to-Service authentication (Workload Identity, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE).

• Have experience mentoring a team of software engineers.

• Know how to test and tune the scalability of highly concurrent, latency-sensitive distributed systems.

• Have some knowledge on containers and container-orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

• Understand how modern CI/CD works and how to integrate security checks into pipelines.

Important

Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants. All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

Benefits

• Competitive salary

• Profit sharing

• Meal allowance

• Health insurance

• Dental plan

• Life insurance

• Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy

• Wellhub

• Home office allowance

• Employee assistance program (mental health, social, legal, and financial support)

• Extended parental leave

• Day off on birthday, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day

• Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)

• Discounts at educational institutions

• Reading kit for children – PlayKids

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

Previous experience in a customer service role

jobs.title: Project Manager - Environmental Remediation
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an Environmental Project Manager for investigation and remediation projects with a focus on firm-fixed-price (FFP) and cost-plus fixed fee (CPFF) contracting primarily for US Federal clients. The Project Manager will lead projects across multiple AECOM operations and engage various subject matter experts and disciplines.  This is a full-time position and will be based out of the Germantown, Maryland office. The position is a hybrid of telecommute and in-office attendance.

The AECOM Environmental Project Manager is responsible for managing projects and major tasks to achieve specified objectives and involves the overall planning; coordination with staff, clients, and subcontractors; and control of projects/ tasks from inception to completion. Responsibility includes managing projects and major tasks that will be completed on time, within authorized scope and budget, and meet all required quality and safety parameters. This position requires excellent skills in written and spoken communication (including polished presentations to clients, regulators, and the public), organization, time management, and an individual who thrives in a team-oriented environment.

Responsibilities of this position, which may vary slightly, include the following:

• Obtain AECOM Project Management Certification within one year of onboarding.
• Collaborate with project teams and management in the development of strategies and plans.
• Serve as primary client point of contact on a variety of projects.
• Provide overall management and administration to projects and assisting in establishing project-specific objectives and policies.
• Support federal proposals including technical approach and costing.
• Provide technical direction and guidance to subordinate managers, enforce company and project policies, maintain close client interface, and ensure all facets of the project are conducted in accordance with design, budget, and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors.
• Work mostly independently but receives basic guidance on specific assignments, objectives, complex features, contract management, and financial performance.
• Receive technical guidance on unusual or complex problems and supervisory approval on proposed plans for projects. Engage subject matter experts when needed.
• May supervise junior/ mid-level engineers and scientists (all disciplines applicable), as well as project administration, project controls, scheduling, cost control, estimating, and procurement representatives.

Minimum Requirements:

• BA/BS +4 years of relevant Project Manager experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Must pass a State and Federal criminal history/security background check; many projects/clients are security sensitive.
• Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.
• A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG), and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) with 5 years of environmental project experience, including experience with firm-fixed-price investigation projects.

• Demonstrated experience in FFP & CPFF remediation as well as CERCLA projects.

• Demonstrated experience with PFAS site investigation, remedial investigations, feasibility studies, remedial design, or remedial actions.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate with others.

• Ability to travel nationwide – up to approximately 20% of the time

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

Team & Development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)

• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work

• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $15.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

jobs.title: Scientist, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description:
Company Summary:

Serif Biomedicines is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company developing a novel approach to gene therapy that can address currently untreatable diseases.

Serif Biomedicines was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovation enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS), Seres Therapeutics (NASDAQ:MCRB), Generate Biomedicines, Tessera Tx, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), and Indigo Agriculture.

Position Summary:

We are looking for an experienced scientist to join the in vivo pharmacology group at Serif. This position will report to the head of pharmacology and will focus on executing preclinical studies in rodent models, including humanized mouse models, to support exploratory and therapeutic programs, both internally and in collaboration with CROs. This is a hands-on role that involves close collaboration with  multi-disciplinary teams in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Execute and oversee in vivo efficacy, biodistribution, PK/PD in rodent models including humanized mice, xenograft, syngeneic, and transgenic mouse models relevant to platform and therapeutic programs.

• Contribute to study designs, study planning, and resource allocation of in vivo studies by working in close collaboration with head of Pharmacology

• Perform animal procedures including blood collection, necropsy, tissue harvest, and homogenization, cell isolation, and test article administration through multiple routes, including I.M, S.C, I.V, I.P.

Author protocols for rodent studies and contribute to NHP protocols as needed and oversee/conduct in vivo rodent studies at contract vivariums and/or CROs.

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with vivarium and external CRO to ensure high quality and timely execution of studies.

• Perform dose calculations and prepare dosing formulations for rodent and NHP studies. Coordinate shipment of test articles to CROs and the receipt of samples, ensuring timely communication with stakeholders.

• Ensure study compliance with IACUC protocols, and company policies.

• Maintain accurate experimental records, study protocols and reports.

• Demonstrate scientific and technical expertise to advance in vivo studies through familiarity with scientific literature.

• Proactively recognize and develop creative solutions for emerging technical and scientific issues.

• Analyze relevant tolerability endpoints and effectively communicate results to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

• M.S with 10+ or B.S with 12+ years industry experience, respectively. Level will be based on experience and demonstrated scope.

• Proficient hands-on experience in mouse models of immunology, oncology and transgenic reporter models. Experience with IVIS acquisition and analysis preferred.

• Experience in writing IACUC protocols required. Familiarity with NHP protocols preferred.

• Experience performing in-vivo procedures in rodents, including dose preparation and administration of therapeutics and sample collection (blood, tissues etc.) and processing required

• Strong organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, and rapidly growing biotech environment with changing priorities.

• Work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

At Flagship, we recognize there is no perfect candidate. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Privacy Notice for Applicants: When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering or one of its portfolio companies, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including to know, delete, and opt out of the sharing of their personal information. If you are located in the EU or UK, we process your data under GDPR and you have rights to access, rectify, and erase your data. To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $143,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. jobs.title: Consultant vanzari 20 ore
jobs.description:
CE VEI FACE​

În calitate de Consultant Vânzări, vei juca un rol cheie în crearea unei experiențe remarcabile pentru clienți. Vei întâmpina clienții, îi vei ghida prin magazin și îi vei sprijini să găsească ceea ce au nevoie în timp ce prezinți produsele noastre. Acționând în conformitate cu valorile noastre, vei contribui atât la succesul tău, cât și al companiei.

Va trebui să:

• Împărtășești cunoștințele despre modă și produse pentru a ajuta clienții să ia decizii.
• Colaborezi cu echipa ta pentru a oferi servicii excepționale la fiecare pas al călătoriei clientului, inclusiv în promovarea activă a programului de loialitate (Hello Member).
• Te asiguri că suprafața de vânzări și zonele din spatele casei de marcat sunt bine aprovizionate, organizate și plăcute.
• Oferi suport la deschiderea și închiderea magazinului.
• Te reprezinți pe tine și brandul nostru în mod pozitiv în toate interacțiunile cu clienții.

​CU CINE VEI LUCRA​

Magazinele sunt inima companiei noastre, locul unde clienții experimentează direct brandul nostru. Ca parte a echipei dinamice a magazinului, fiecare rol - de la consilieri de vânzări, manageri de departament, de magazin și visual merchandiseri și până la cash office responsible - contribuie la crearea unui mediu inspirațional și primitor. De asemenea, vei păstra legătura și cu echipa mai mare a Ariei, colaborând între magazine pentru a împărtăși informații și a contribui la succes împreună. Alături de echipa ta, vei juca un rol vital în a-i ajuta pe clienți să se simtă încrezători și să-și exprime individualitatea cu cele mai recente tendințe și stiluri atemporale. Prin construirea de conexiuni semnificative cu clienții din magazinele noastre, facem moda accesibilă și durabilă pentru toți.

​CINE EȘTI​

jobs.title: Construction Scheduler
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company’s long-term success.

Job Summary

The Project Scheduler plays a vital role in a construction project, helping to manage both time and resources to ensure work is completed on time. Their primary responsibility is to keep existing project schedules accurate and up to date, assist the team in mitigating any schedule impacts, and provide all the schedule-based reports to the construction teams on a timely basis.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Produce project schedule related reports for the project teams (schedule progress reports, Critical path, Overall Schedule, Near-Term, etc.).

• Perform weekly schedule progress updates with construction teams.

• Monitor schedule deviations and variances and assist project teams in developing recovery plans.

• Maintain record of scope changes, trends and variances that potentially affect schedule performance.

• Analyze critical and near-critical paths and communicate any deviations from baseline milestones and paths to the team.

• Make recommendations to manage float and (re)sequence activities (if required) to achieve project milestone dates and interim target completion dates.

• Verify schedule integrity and evaluate logic, constructability, and float paths.

• Apply standardized work breakdown structures and milestones to develop project schedules collaboratively with the project team, enhancing overall project performance.

• At the completion of the project, develop and record the project’s historical schedule information and lessons learned‚ for future use.

• Support the Request for Proposal process by developing or reviewing project schedules for team presentation

• Produce weekly and monthly Department reports summarizing the status of all current active projects

• Assist with producing data analysis of all schedules including average slip based on standard milestones, lead times, and common delays.

Qualifications and Skills

• A Bachelor’s degree in Scheduling, Engineering, Construction Management or a related field is a plus

• At least 2 years of scheduling experience

• Demonstrated understanding of the use of modern planning and scheduling principals, methodologies, techniques and tools

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Attention to detail and ability to work with large data volumes

• Strong problem-solving skills and flexibility

• Strong can-do attitude and flexibility to pivot in a fast-paced environment

Computer Systems

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

• Knowledge of scheduling software including Microsoft Project and/or Primavera P6

jobs.title: Lead Strategy Consultant
jobs.location: Philadelphia, Tampa, Chicago or Dallas/Austin - United States
jobs.description:
Why Join Exadel

We're an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From strategic advisory and AI solutions to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to solve complex business challenges, unlock opportunities, and build what's next.

What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, curious, and constantly evolving.

About the Role

You will be joining the growing UK arm (London-based) of our US-based Advisory business, where you will help shape the direction of the practice and execute our ambitious plans to scale our strategy consulting capabilities.

As a Lead Strategy Consultant, you will act as a trusted advisor and front door to Exadel, where you'll work directly with senior client leaders, often at the C-suite level, helping them clarify their business goals, uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and define the outcomes that matter most. We believe great consulting doesn't begin with a predefined problem or solution. It begins with curiosity, asking the right questions, understanding what keeps clients up at night, and looking beyond their initial requests to determine what they are ultimately trying to achieve.

You'll help clients set strategies that evaluate the right combination of people, processes, operating models, experiences, data, and technology to achieve their goals. This may involve improving business performance, developing new capabilities, addressing operational challenges, or enabling broader transformation.

And once the strategy is defined, you won't simply hand it off. You'll work alongside our broader delivery teams to help turn strategic direction into tangible outcomes, ensuring solutions work for the people and organizations they are intended to serve.

What You'll Do

Lead client engagements, shaping opportunities, Problems & Solutions

• Own consulting workstreams and engagements end-to-end, accountable for quality, timelines, budgets, and client outcomes.

• Lead workshops, asking thoughtful, sometimes challenging questions to uncover what clients are truly trying to achieve, rather than simply accepting their initial problem statement or proposed solution.

• Identify underlying challenges, root causes, and opportunities that may not be immediately apparent, helping clients focus on the outcomes that will create the greatest value.

• Help clients define what success looks like and translate their goals into strategic priorities, actionable recommendations, and practical roadmaps.

Develop Executable Strategies

• Develop client strategies and own strategic roadmaps grounded in business realities and focused on measurable outcomes, including revenue growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business performance.

• Evaluate strategic options across people, processes, operating models, experiences, data, and technology, including AI where it can deliver meaningful value.

• Lead business case development, quantify opportunities, and confidently present investment recommendations to client leadership and finance teams.

• Work with Exadel's broader advisory, design, data, AI, and engineering teams to ensure strategies can be translated into tangible solutions.

Build Client Relationships & Grow the Business

• Build trusted relationships with senior client decision-makers, developing a deep understanding of their business, priorities, and evolving needs.

• Recognize emerging challenges and opportunities where Exadel can deliver additional value, helping shape new engagements and long-term partnerships.

• Support proposals, pitches, business cases, and solution development for new opportunities.

• Contribute to thought leadership that helps organizations navigate evolving business challenges, strategic opportunities, and the role of emerging technologies.

Help Shape Our Consulting Practice

• Contribute to the development and evolution of consulting frameworks, methodologies, and reusable approaches that strengthen our ability to deliver client value.

• Help build and scale our strategy consulting capabilities, influencing how we engage clients, shape opportunities, and deliver outcomes.

• Mentor and coach other consultants, strengthening their strategic thinking, problem-solving, and client leadership skills.

What You Bring

• Strong consulting experience: Extensive experience in strategy, management, business, or technology consulting, with a proven track record of leading client engagements and influencing senior stakeholders.

• Strategic leadership and opportunity shaping: The ability to enter client conversations without a predefined problem or solution, uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and guide clients toward the right strategic direction and business outcomes.

• Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking: A natural instinct to ask questions, dig beneath the surface, investigate root causes, and understand what truly matters to clients. You're comfortable respectfully challenging their thinking when it leads to better outcomes.

• Executive presence and stakeholder leadership: Confidence engaging directly with senior executives, including C-suite leaders, building trust, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and influencing strategic decisions.

• Commercial and business acumen: The ability to connect business goals to financial and operational outcomes, quantify opportunities, build credible business cases, and confidently discuss revenue, margin, cost, risk, and return on investment.

• Human-centered thinking: Strong empathy, creativity, judgment, and an understanding of how people, organizations, and technology interact. You recognize that successful strategies must work for the people they affect.

• AI and technology fluency: Curiosity about emerging technologies and hands-on experience using AI to enhance your own work. You understand where AI can create value, recognize its limitations, and are comfortable collaborating with technical teams without needing to be an engineer yourself.

• Strategy through execution: Experience translating strategic direction into practical roadmaps, actionable recommendations, and measurable outcomes. You understand how to connect business strategy with delivery.

• Builder mindset: Comfortable moving beyond presentations to test ideas, validate assumptions, and develop tangible proof. You thrive in ambiguity, work at pace, and balance hands-on contribution with leading from the front.

• Business and operating model understanding: Experience assessing organizational capabilities, business processes, governance, and operating models, with the ability to recommend changes where they support client goals.

• People leadership: Experience managing, mentoring, or coaching consultants, with a genuine interest in helping others develop.

• Exceptional communication: The ability to distill complex business challenges into clear, compelling narratives and communicate recommendations persuasively, both in writing and in the room.

• High standards and accountability: A commitment to intellectual rigor, accuracy, quality, and delivering thoughtful recommendations that create meaningful client value.

English Level

Professional fluency

Location

Philadelphia, Tampa, Chicago or Dallas/Austin - United States

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location within the United States, and business needs.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

• Accessibility and Accommodation: We are committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable federal, state, and local accessibility laws. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us.

jobs.title: FSQA Program Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
The FSQA Program Compliance Specialist supports Home Chef’s Food Safety & Quality Management Systems by ensuring compliance programs, audit readiness activities, and food safety documentation are consistently executed across all facilities. This role focuses on maintaining SQF program compliance, supporting corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, managing compliance reporting, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across the FSQA network.

The FSQA Program Compliance Specialist partners closely with Site FSQA teams, Operations, Customer Service, and cross-functional stakeholders to monitor compliance performance, support audit preparedness, analyze customer complaint trends, and maintain food safety and quality documentation systems. This role also supports annual calibration programs, Tempo project rollouts, and network-wide FSQA compliance initiatives.

Detailed Responsibilities

Program Compliance & Audit Readiness:

• Support implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Home Chef Food Safety & Quality Management System across all facilities.

• Support annual third-party audits and maintain SQF program documentation, including food safety fundamentals and food safety plans.

• Partner with Site FSQA Managers, Operations, and key stakeholders to ensure compliance with Home Chef FSQA programs and regulatory requirements.

• Support execution of internal audit programs and ensure timely completion of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Track, monitor, and report on network compliance metrics, audit findings, and corrective action effectiveness.

• Support audit readiness activities, compliance documentation management, and continuous improvement initiatives across the network.

CAPA Management & Continuous Improvement:

• Participate in root cause analysis investigations and support implementation of corrective and preventive actions related to food safety and quality issues.

• Monitor compliance performance trends and identify opportunities for process improvement through data analysis and evaluation of recurring issues.

• Support site error rate discussions and provide recommendations to improve FSQA program effectiveness.

• Collaborate with Site FSQA teams and Operations partners to support FSQA management reviews and verification activities.

Customer Complaints & Trend Analysis:

• Analyze FSQA data and trends including customer complaints, illness trends, hold management, environmental monitoring, Tempo reporting, and receiving data.

• Support customer complaint management processes and reporting through Tempo, Core FM, and related systems.

• Provide reporting visibility and recommendations to management when unacceptable FSQA trends or risks are identified.

Document Control & Program Support:

• Support document control processes to ensure compliance records, SOPs, forms, and FSQA documentation are maintained and audit ready.

• Coordinate annual equipment calibration tracking and follow-up activities across facilities.

• Support rollout and implementation of Tempo projects, FSQA program updates, and compliance initiatives.

• Maintain compliance trackers, reporting tools, and supporting documentation related to FSQA programs.

Training & Cross-Functional Support:

• Support development and maintenance of FSQA onboarding and training materials for FSQA and QC team members.

• Maintain site FSQA training trackers and support compliance-related training initiatives.

• Collaborate with Customer Service, Site FSQA teams, and Operations to support network FSQA objectives and continuous improvement efforts.

• Assist with special projects, labeling needs, and cross-functional FSQA initiatives as needed.

General Responsibilities:

• Follow facility GMPs and help enforce policies throughout the facility.

• Support the efforts of the company to maintain our food safety system (SQF) and quality programs.

• Maintain compliance documentation and support audit readiness across all facilities.

This position requires 25% travel

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, or related field preferred or 1-3 years experience in quality assurance, food safety, food manufacturing, or food distribution (A Master’s degree will be considered in lieu of experience)

• Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), root cause analysis (RCA), change management, and supporting/maintaining food safety management systems (exposure to ISO, GFSI, SQF, or FDA/USDA audits)

• Strong technical aptitude for digital organization, utilizing advanced spreadsheet formulas. Google Apps Script, and creating AI-driven applications to streamline workflows

• Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills with a proven ability to build rapport and collaborate across cross-functional teams

• High adaptable, detail- and data-oriented, and proactive problem solver who anticipates downstream consequences of work in a fast-paced, autonomous environment

• Willingness to travel 25% of the time and be on-call a minimum of one weekend a month; potential for nights/weekends and some holidays depending on business needs

More About Us

Perks and benefits

• Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer - enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order!

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available

• Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time

• 401k program

• Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses

How We Work Together

We are humble team players.
We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves - and respectfully listen to and accept input.

We are pragmatic next-level thinkers.
We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking.

We take ownership.
We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals.

Be at Home at Home Chef

We all show up authentically at Home Chef. Our team includes individuals with a variety of identities, backgrounds, and perspectives. You can trust that you’ll be able to bring your whole self to an inclusive and enjoyable workplace.

We welcome people of all races, colors, religions, national origin or ancestry, sex (including sexual identity), age, physical or mental disabilities, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged/sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

Home Chef is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Home Chef will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our People team at hr@homechef.com.

Home Chef offers the base salary range as posted below, with the exact offer depending on factors such as geographic location, experience, skills, and internal equity. While compensation is within the provided range, it is not typical for offers to be made at the upper end. In addition to base salary, Home Chef provides a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare coverage, 401k match, and paid time off.

At Veo, our mission is to end car dependency by making clean transportation accessible to all. A leading shared micromobility provider in North America, Veo provides millions of bike and scooter rides annually in over 60 cities and universities from Los Angeles to New York City.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: New York, NY

The Opportunity

At Flowcode, we are building the "Offline-to-Online" (O2O) infrastructure for the world's largest brands. With Flowcode's market-leading technology, brands can deliver powerful, personalized consumer experiences in the real world and connect those interactions to first-party customer data through Flow ID, our identity layer.

As a Solutions Engineer (SE), you are the technical backbone of our enterprise business. You will partner with our largest clients (think Fortune 500 retailers, global media networks, and sports leagues) and with our Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to turn high-level business goals into working technical implementations. You'll be in the room before the deal closes, scoping and demoing what's possible, and you'll be there after it closes, activating them for success.

You’ll join a high-trust SE team where the work is varied, the scope is wide, and you'll take on real ownership early.

What You’ll Do

Pre-Sales and Strategic Scoping

• Serve as the technical lead on pre-sales deals: join discovery and customer calls, answer technical and product questions, build custom demos with realistic data, and scope integrations and strategic opportunities with Product and Strategy before close.

• Complete vendor security and privacy questionnaires, SSO questionnaires, and RFPs; coordinate with Engineering and Security on supporting artifacts.

Post-Sales Implementation and Onboarding

• Lead technical onboarding for enterprise clients, integrating Flowcode into their marketing and data stacks (CRMs, CDPs, ESPs, Snowflake, and analytics tools), and set up and support enterprise SAML SSO, gathering requirements, partnering with Data Engineering, and answering ongoing questions as customers activate.

• Act as the trusted advisor on technical API and MCP server implementations, supporting clients on high-volume and bulk API use cases and writing solutions scripts and code (Python, JavaScript, JSON, SQL, or similar) to adjust configurations, update events, and solve one-off customer problems.

• Support marketing pixel and event-tracking implementations: run intake, install and configure pixels (including Shopify, tag managers, and server-to-server setups), validate conversion events, and debug.

• Execute migrations from our self-service product and our clients to our latest Enterprise platform; building and enhancing reusable tooling.

Templates, Partnerships, and Enablement

• Build modular, custom templates, and apps (such as digital business cards, wallet passes, and landing-page experiences) for client launches, scale them across the product, and deliver custom experiences with technical partners.

• Triage and answer internal and client-facing technical questions. Create the playbooks and technical documentation that let us and our clients scale together.

The Technical Bridge Between Customers and Our Product

• Act as the technical connective tissue between clients, Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering: translate customer requirements into clear technical asks, and translate engineering constraints back into plain language for customers and account teams.

• Bring the voice of the customer into the roadmap by spotting patterns across implementations (recurring integration requests, API gaps, documentation holes, workarounds you keep rebuilding), documenting them with real examples, and partnering with Product and Engineering to turn them into product improvements.

Who You Are

• You have 3–5 years in a technical client-facing role (Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or Implementation Engineering), ideally in SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech, and you're comfortable running live demos and handling technical questions in real time.

• You have strong experience building with AI, APIs, and MCP servers and can advise on implementations. You build reusable prompts, skills, artifacts, workflows, and automations, and use AI in your daily work. You hold it to a standard: you verify its output, measure where it saves time or improves quality, and share what you learn so the whole team gets better, faster, and more consistent.

• You can explain a complex integration to a non-technical marketing manager, then hop on a call with a lead engineer to debug an API or integration issue.

• You build repeatable solutions with code to get things done: Python, SQL, and JavaScript/TypeScript are the core (experience with Go, Java, or C# is a plus).

• You have hands-on experience with REST APIs, gRPC, agentic AI tools, webhooks, and marketing pixels. You understand how data moves between CRM, CDP, and marketing automation systems (e.g., HubSpot, Braze) and how to leverage AI in the loop.

• You understand data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and essential security concepts (e.g. encryption, multi-tenant environments) and have worked with security questionnaires or compliance reviews.

• You have experience with SAML/SSO and identity resolution concepts (persistent IDs, Snowflake data sharing, and data-activation platforms).

• You don't just identify problems; you build the bridge to the solution. You thrive in the gray area of a fast-growing startup, with a high-autonomy, high-ownership mentality and a ruthless focus on customer outcomes.

Why Flowcode?

• Category creation: Help define a new category at the intersection of offline and online identity.

• Impact at scale: Shape experiences that touch millions of consumers across global brands.

• Elite team: Work alongside high-caliber operators from the world’s best companies.

How to Apply

Send us your LinkedIn and a brief note on the most complex technical implementation you’ve ever led. Bonus points if you include a link to a Flowcode you created.

Compensation Range:

$135 - $155K OTE

jobs.title: Product Manager, Hardware
jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

Hardware Product Managers at Formlabs are responsible for defining new products, working side by side with Engineering to develop them, and announcing new products to the market. They are the subject matter experts on our customers, applications, and business. We seek individuals who are passionate about learning and taking on new challenges, care about shipping impactful products, and are interested in building strong collaborative relationships across the company.

We're looking for a Product Manager to define and drive new hardware products to completion, ensuring customer satisfaction and business success. This role involves defining the requirements for new products in the Formlabs portfolio, determining key features and user experience, and overseeing the product through development all the way to shipping.

Hear from SLS Leader Matt Ewertowski on what it’s like to build products at Formlabs in this video!

What You’ll Do:

• Identify immediate and/or upcoming user needs, then work with the team to develop product requirements and a product roadmap that addresses them.

• Prioritize features and tasks for the product using internal tools, tracking and reviewing the product direction and current work frequently.

• Write clear, crisp, detailed product specifications.

• Manage collaboration and communication with other teams, both internal and external, to ensure teams have what they need and can work efficiently.

• Help guide the go to market and maintenance plans through product launch and beyond.

• Monitor feedback, support, and analytics. Plan changes to make improvements.

• Develop a deep understanding of our customers, business, competitors, and technology.

• Work with the product and engineering leadership teams to create a coherent product strategy and vision for your product lines and connect that to our wider business strategy.

• Identify new areas of opportunity for Formlabs that are adjacent to what we are doing today. Propose products that capture these new opportunities.

• This person will serve as the voice of the customer, working to develop and launch products that will delight our members and support business goals.

About You:

• Hardware engineering or physics background

• Experience shipping software-enabled hardware product to customers (or convince us why this doesn’t matter)

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges

Fashion & Trend Awareness

Team & Development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

Who You Are

jobs.title: Director, Legal Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


 


THE ROLE

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, enterprise change, commercial judgment and client leadership.

As Director, Legal Engineering, your mission is to make Legal Engineering the commercial and delivery engine for the West Coast, anchored in our San Francisco office. Reporting to the Head of Legal Engineering, North America, you will set the craft bar, build the team and its Team Lead layer, partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement, lead selectively on the highest-stakes clients, and turn local learning into playbooks that scale across North America.

This is a Director-level leadership role. Your primary output will be the quality and performance of the team and system you build. You will stay close enough to the product and the work to coach credibly, while moving your own time toward hiring, leadership development, senior relationships, market strategy and cross-functional execution.

You will have the autonomy to shape how Legal Engineering runs in a strategically important market, together with the responsibility to keep that model connected to Legora's North American and global standards.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the Legal Engineering function for the West Coast from the San Francisco office, including its operating rhythm, quality bar, capacity model and local partnership with Go-to-Market and Engagement.

 - Hire exceptional Legal Engineers and future leaders. Own the quality bar from sourcing and interview calibration through closing, onboarding and ramp.

 - Build a manager layer of Team Leads who each own and develop a group of Legal Engineers. Delegate real decision rights and create clear succession paths so the function becomes stronger and less dependent on you over time.

 - Give direct, evidence-based feedback. Coach hard, set clear expectations and act decisively when the performance or values bar is not met.

 - Partner with West Coast commercial leadership on priority accounts, pilots, rollouts and escalations. Connect Legal Engineering activity to conversion, adoption, usage, expansion and revenue.

 - Act as the lead legal architect on selected enterprise engagements. Translate a real legal problem into a concrete Legora workflow, then turn successful delivery into a reusable playbook others can run.

 - Oversee complex, multi-stakeholder programs with clear governance, owners, outcomes, leading indicators and risk management.

 - Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, General Counsels, Heads of Innovation, Legal Operations leaders and other senior stakeholders.

 - Represent the market's voice inside Legora. Translate recurring client patterns and product gaps into clear, actionable input for Product.

 - Shape Legora's point of view on AI and legal work in the Bay Area and across the West Coast. Contribute through executive client forums, events, writing and practical market insight grounded in first-hand work.

 - Create clean handoffs across Go-to-Market, Legal Engineering and Engagement so that commercial momentum, delivery quality and long-term adoption reinforce one another.


HOW YOU LEAD

Strong leadership in this role looks like this:

 - Hiring judgment and partnership. You treat hiring as company-building work. You own open seats end to end, partner closely with Talent and keep the bar high when growth pressure rises.

 - Talent development and accountability. Your team knows where they stand. Feedback is early, written and specific. You create stretch, develop future leaders and distinguish coachable gaps from persistent underperformance.

 - Ownership, delegation and operating rhythm. You own the market outcome while giving others real authority. Priorities, decision rights, leading indicators and dependencies are clear. The team runs well without you in every room.

 - Team-first leadership and culture. You give the team credit, absorb accountability for misses and create enough trust that bad news travels early. People grow faster because they worked for you.

 - Performance bar and decisive judgment. You protect the standard with speed, fairness and evidence. Strong performers trust you to address mediocrity, and difficult decisions remain humane and unambiguous.


WHAT YOU BRING

You may come from a leading law firm, an in-house legal function, legal operations, legal innovation, professional services, legal technology, or a combination of those worlds. The common thread is that you have moved beyond advising on change and have built the people, systems and client outcomes that make change real.

You will thrive in this role if you:

 - Are a qualified lawyer (JD and admission to at least one US bar) with substantial legal, legal-operations or legal-technology experience, and a strong understanding of how sophisticated law firms and in-house legal teams make decisions.

 - Have built a team, function, market or new operating model from a low base, with clear evidence of what you personally decided and what continued to work without you.

 - Have managed and developed strong people, ideally including managers or Team Leads, and can point to people whose careers accelerated under your leadership.

 - Are deeply curious about generative AI and product. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be able to learn the platform, challenge use-case design and coach credible client work.

 - Can hold your own with a Managing Partner, General Counsel or executive team while remaining practical with the people doing the work.

 - Understand the commercial realities of legal services and enterprise software. You can connect Legal Engineering to pipeline, client value, adoption, usage and revenue.

 - Bring structure to ambiguity without creating process for its own sake. You build operating systems that improve speed and quality.

 - Have strong hiring and performance judgment. You can attract high-calibre people, develop them directly and protect the standard when a seat is not working.

 - Are based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to work from our San Francisco office five days per week, with travel for strategic clients, market development and team leadership.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients domestic and internationally.

 - Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

 - Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

 - In-person environment: San Francisco office designed for ambitious builders.

 - Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package:
   Medical, Dental & Vision
   
   - Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente
   
   - HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection)
   
   - Dental plans via MetLife
   
   - Vision plans via Vision Care
   
   Family Support
   
   - Generous parental leave
   
   - Free access to Maven Clinic
   
   - Dependent Care FSA
   
   - Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents
   
   Additional Perks
   
   - Pre-tax commuter benefits
   
   - Life Insurance + STD/LTD
   
   - 401(K) with generous company match
   
   - Unlimited PTO
   
   - Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more





Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
