jobs.title: Sr Construction Project Engineer - Aerospace
jobs.description:
BRPH is a technically focused, creative architecture, engineering, and construction company with over six decades of expertise in helping mission-driven clients in the aerospace, defense, manufacturing, commercial, education, entertainment, hospitality, and federal markets identify gaps in their program delivery and develop innovative solutions to their most challenging problems across the U.S. and around the world. Consistently ranked among the nation’s top firms, we take pride in solving complex challenges with forward-thinking solutions.

About Melbourne:

Our headquarters is located in Melbourne, Florida, a vibrant city on the Space Coast where high-tech innovation meets coastal living. Here, you’ll work on dynamic, impactful projects while enjoying front-row views of rocket launches from our rooftop and quick access to some of Florida’s most beautiful beaches. Just an hour from world-class attractions like Disney World and Universal Studios, Melbourne offers the perfect balance of career growth, family life, and fun, all in a warm subtropical climate with a relaxed, suburban feel.

SUMMARY:
The Senior Construction Project Engineer reports directly to the Aerospace Market Vice President and serves as the Vice President’s deputy for construction execution across the Aerospace portfolio. The position works directly with each Project Manager to oversee project performance, coordinate organizational support, proactively manage risk, and ensure execution issues are resolved promptly. The portfolio includes complex aerospace facilities such as launch infrastructure, manufacturing, processing, and supporting facilities, as applicable.
The role provides operational and technical leadership across financial performance, schedules, subcontracts, design changes, quality, safety, commissioning, and closeout. Assignments are based on business needs, project complexity, and risk.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Portfolio execution oversight. Work directly with each Project Manager to review execution performance from project startup through closeout. Identify emerging issues, establish corrective actions with responsible leaders, and track actions through resolution. Maintain visibility across all assigned projects and intervene on critical issues as needed.
•    Project reviews and reporting. Lead regular execution reviews and provide concise portfolio reporting to the Market Vice President on financial trends, schedule exceptions, procurement constraints, risks, overdue actions, and decisions requiring leadership involvement.
•    Financial performance. Review and challenge project budgets, cost-to-complete forecasts, projected margins, contingency usage, cash flow, and change exposure with Project Managers. Identify unfavorable trends, validate underlying assumptions, and coordinate timely corrective recommendations and actions.
•    Accounting coordination. Coordinate with Accounting and Project Managers on monthly financial reporting, billing, receivables, commitments, accruals, and reconciliation of project forecasts with accounting records. Follow through on discrepancies and collection issues with the responsible parties.
•    Risk management. Maintain a consolidated view of contractual, technical, financial, procurement, schedule, safety, and quality risks. Ensure risks have assigned owners, mitigation actions, and due dates; promptly escalate material exposure and unresolved issues to the Market Vice President.
•    Schedule and procurement performance. Review schedule baselines, updates, critical paths, milestone commitments, long-lead procurement, and recovery plans with Project Managers and field leaders. Coordinate resolution of constraints and track corrective actions to protect contractual commitments.
•    Preconstruction and design changes. Coordinate with Preconstruction, Project Managers, and design leadership on project turnover, scope clarification, constructability, and design changes. Evaluate cost, schedule, procurement, and contractual impacts before implementation; track required approvals, notices, and owner commitments.
•    Subcontracts and commercial administration. Review scope completeness, exclusions, buyout status, subcontractor performance, changes, notices, and unresolved commercial issues. Support negotiations, claims avoidance, and contemporaneous documentation within delegated authority.
•    Organizational support and resources. Identify resource gaps and coordinate timely support from Preconstruction, Accounting, project controls, design, quality, safety, and other functions. Recommend staffing priorities and assignments to the Market Vice President and track resolution of support needs.
•    Technical leadership. Provide advanced guidance on construction methods, sequencing, building systems, constructability, field conditions, design coordination, and complex construction challenges. Lead resolution of critical technical issues with owners, designers, field leaders, trade partners, and suppliers.
•    Project controls and documentation. Oversee effective submittal, request-for-information, change-management, document-control, and as-built processes. Monitor critical and overdue items, coordinate required owner, Architect or Engineer of Record, and authority approvals, and intervene where issues threaten execution.
•    Safety quality and turnover. Work with Project Managers, Superintendents, and designated safety and quality leaders to address deficiencies and verify corrective-action follow-through. Oversee readiness for permits, inspections, testing, commissioning, turnover, owner acceptance, closeout, and completion of required Quality Data Packages.
•    People and process development. Mentor Construction Project Engineers I, II, and III; delegate and review assigned work based on capability. Support onboarding, training, recruiting input, and career development. Standardize execution reviews, controls, and practices and apply lessons learned across the portfolio.
•    Assignments and representation. Represent the Market Vice President in designated execution meetings and matters within delegated authority. Travel, accept temporary duty assignments, or relocate when required by business needs, and perform other related duties as assigned.

AUTHORITY AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS:
Exercise execution oversight authority delegated by the Market Vice President, including convening project reviews, requiring timely reporting and corrective-action plans, coordinating functional support, and tracking assigned actions through resolution. The position’s workload and project assignments must allow sufficient capacity for oversight across the assigned portfolio.
Project Managers remain accountable for delivery of their assigned projects, and Superintendents retain responsibility for field operations within their assigned authority. Functional execution oversight does not establish a personnel reporting relationship; direct supervisory responsibilities apply only when separately assigned.
Contract execution, expenditure approvals, personnel decisions, and final design approvals remain subject to established company authority and the responsibilities of the authorized design professionals. Escalate matters exceeding delegated authority, including material financial exposure, contractual commitments, significant schedule changes, unresolved client issues, and safety or quality matters requiring authorized intervention.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
•    Required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field plus eight years of progressively responsible construction experience, including substantial project-engineering and execution responsibilities; alternatively, thirteen years of relevant construction experience may substitute for the degree and experience combination.
•    Required: Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple concurrent construction projects and working directly with Project Managers on execution performance, financial reviews, risk management, schedules, subcontracts, and corrective actions.
•    Required: Demonstrated ability to evaluate budgets, cost-to-complete forecasts, projected margins, cash flow, and commercial exposure, and to coordinate corrective actions with Accounting and project leadership.
•    Required: Experience with construction management, contracts, design-build delivery, project controls, estimating, constructability, commissioning, quality, safety, and closeout, including coordination of design changes and transition from Preconstruction into construction.
•    Required: Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, negotiation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills; ability to resolve issues across functions and present concise recommendations to executive leadership, clients, designers, field teams, and trade partners.
•    Required: Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Procore or a comparable construction management platform, and the ability to interpret project financial and schedule reporting.
•    Required: Willingness to travel, accept temporary duty assignments, or relocate when required by project and portfolio needs.
•    Preferred: Experience delivering large or complex commercial, industrial, aviation, federal, mission-critical, or comparable projects and experience with TAKT or comparable production-planning methods.
•    Preferred: OSHA 30-hour Construction Outreach course completion card, or verified equivalent, held by the start date. Maintain proof and complete employer, project, or jurisdictional refresher training as required.
•    Preferred: Current U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Construction Quality Management for Contractors certificate, or BRPH-approved equivalent, held by the start date and maintained through required renewals.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
•    Ability to navigate and move around the construction site, which may involve walking, climbing ladders and scaffolding, and standing for extended periods on uneven surfaces.
•    Ability to lift to 50 pounds.
•    Ability to handle tools, equipment, and perform tasks that require coordination and manual skills.
•    Manual dexterity, hearing, mental acuity, typing, reaching, repetitive motion, speaking, talking, and visual acuity.
•    Ability to operate a motor vehicle.
•    Ability to stand and sit for periods longer than 30 minutes but not to exceed two hours consecutively.
•    Ability to print and draw letters, numbers, words, characters, and symbols that are legible and understood by others.
•    Ability to learn complex tasks and remember how to complete tasks without assistance once trained.
•    Ability to control behavior when encountering stressful situations or short deadlines and to maintain a high level of concentration.
•    Quick thinking and decision-making ability to address issues and challenges that may arise during construction.
•    Ability to work in various weather conditions and handle the physical demands of supervising a construction project.
•    Strict adherence to safety protocols and the ability to enforce safety standards on the construction site.
•    Adherence to personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements when on the construction site, such as hard hats, safety vests, and steel-toed boots.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: CMMS - Maintenance Planner
jobs.description:
Broad Function and Purpose of Position:

The Maintenance Planner is responsible for planning, scheduling, and coordinating all maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability and operational efficiency. This role manages work orders, preventive maintenance (PM) programs, spare parts inventory, and procurement, while serving as the key liaison between maintenance, production, and contractors. The planner also drives continuous improvement, supports technical development, and ensures maintenance work is executed safely and effectively. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Maintenance Supervisor.

Specific Responsibilities:

• Actively participate in the plant’s Sika SAFE Program.
• Understand, comply, and regularly inspect the work area to ensure all safety policies and practices are followed and a high degree of industrial housekeeping is maintained at all times.
• Develop detailed work plans for preventive and corrective maintenance, prioritizing tasks based on urgency, safety, and operational impact.
• Coordinate and schedule maintenance activities with production to minimize downtime and disruption.
• Review, prioritize, and distribute work orders daily; serve as the primary contact for all work order submissions.
• Ensure timely completion of work orders and preventive maintenance tasks.
• Estimate labor hours, materials, and resources required for each maintenance job.
• Plan and support large-scale maintenance events, including plant shutdowns and major equipment overhauls.
• Maintain and update all maintenance data within the FIIX CMMS, including work orders, asset history, and documentation.
• Track, analyze, and report on maintenance performance metrics and effectiveness.
• Prepare reports related to maintenance activities, costs, and system improvements.
• Manage and optimize spare parts inventory to ensure availability for both planned and emergency maintenance.
• Lead procurement activities including specifying, quoting, and ordering parts, materials, tools, and equipment.
• Maintain detailed purchasing records and support budget tracking.
• Drive continuous improvement of inventory control and stocking strategies.
• Act as the central liaison between maintenance, production, contractors, and vendors.
• Gather daily equipment and process updates from production and communicate maintenance priorities accordingly.
• Assist in coordinating contractor repairs and external service activities.
• Ensure clear communication and alignment across all departments regarding maintenance work.
• Support operators and maintenance technicians in developing technical skills and equipment knowledge.
• Review equipment manuals and establish standard maintenance procedures and best practices.
• Develop, document, and maintain standardized maintenance work instructions and procedures.
• Contribute to the development and implementation of maintenance strategies to improve reliability and efficiency.
• Provide supervisory support to the maintenance team in the absence of the Maintenance Supervisor or Manager.
• Assist in training maintenance personnel on new procedures, systems, and best practices.
• Perform other work and special projects as required by Supervisor.

Qualifications/Experience:

• Education: High School diploma or equivalent required. Associate's degree or maintenance professional certificates preferred.

• Years Experience: Minimum of 2 years experience in general repairs in a manufacturing environment, including experience in at least two of the following trades: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, carpentry, welding or machining; OR any combination of training that provides the required knowledge and abilities to do the job.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Broad Function and Purpose of Position:

The primary function of a Controls Engineer is to help implement and provide continued support to the automated processes within our Marion Operations. The role heavily focuses on maintaining controls and robotic solutions paired with our production equipment. The equipment has a large dependency on programmable logic controls (PLC) and often integrates with other types of equipment that can also involve non-robotic automation. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Maintenance & Engineering Manager.

Specific Responsibilities:

• Actively participate in the Sika SAFE Program.
• Maintain safe and clean work environment in accordance with the Sika Housekeeping policy.
• Manage vendors and contractors to ensure compliance with Sika’s health, safety and behavior standards and to monitor progress toward project completion within agreed upon timeframe budget.
• Design, develop, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC-based control systems, HMI applications, robotics, industrial networks, instrumentation, and machine vision systems.
• Develop, modify, and support PLC programs using Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or equivalent platforms.
• Configure and troubleshoot VFDs, servo systems, safety PLCs, distributed I/O, and industrial communication networks.
• Interpret and review electrical drawings, P&IDs, process flow diagrams, and equipment specifications.
• Tune PID loops and optimize process control strategies for manufacturing equipment and processes.
• Manage some projects from start to finish including Capital Appropriation Requests (CARs) with project budgets, savings, timelines, runoff criteria, status reporting, system implementation, and all other project details.
• Implement changes in existing production processes, equipment and facilities; engineer new processes, to increase output capacity and reduce/eliminate bottlenecks.
• Review new and existing layouts of machines and equipment to obtain optimal performance, recommend and implement changes.
• Identify and conceptualize primarily mixing and packaging systems, at times other forms of automated solutions to drive improvements in safety, ergonomics, quality, productivity, and cost reductions throughout the operations.
• Gather lessons learned and best practices to streamline future projects.
• Program, troubleshoot, and provide support to automated systems, including PLC based controllers, networking solutions and camera vision systems.
• Creates procedures, documentation, routings, and other necessary documentation for the processes.
• Collaborates and communicates cross functionally with all levels of the organization including but not limited to operators, R&D, QA, supply management, and executive management.
• Serve as the technical expert in controls equipment and automation while mentoring and train others in the technical aspects of automation systems.
• Assumes additional responsibilities as needed or directed in support of the Company’s automation strategy.
• Perform other work and projects as required by the Maintenance & Engineering Manager.

Qualifications/Experience:

• Education: Associate’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical preferred).
• Years Experience: 3-5 years experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or distribution center environment. Direct experience with implementing, maintaining, and operating automation, PLCs, and packaging equipment.

Special Requirements/Competencies:

• Must be able to read, write, speak and comprehend English.
• Must have good math skills, including the ability to work with fractions, decimals and percentages.
• Must have the ability to develop process expertise in order to facilitate troubleshooting.
• Must be able to maintain an excellent attendance record.
• Must have expert experience in automation, PLCs, and robotics.
• Must have strong interpersonal skills, effective oral and written communication skills, and proficiency in computer applications.
• Must have knowledge of OSHA regulations and guidelines and ability to prepare and maintain required documentation.
• Independent worker, with strong organizational skills, who requires minimal supervision.
• Must be flexible to work any shift and overtime as business requires.
• Must be self-motivated and able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary

Please note: This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role with no people management responsibilities. You will own the full enterprise sales cycle—from prospecting through to close—building your own pipeline and driving net-new enterprise revenue.

The Senior Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for identifying, qualifying and closing net-new enterprise opportunities within our highest-potential target accounts. As the digital marketing landscape continues to evolve, you'll help enterprise brands navigate increasingly complex partnership and performance marketing strategies to deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

You'll become a trusted advisor to senior marketing leaders, building consultative relationships, uncovering strategic business challenges and demonstrating how Partnerize's technology creates long-term value. We're looking for a proactive hunter and accomplished enterprise seller who thrives on generating pipeline, managing complex sales cycles and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

Responsibilities

• Build & Own Your Pipeline: Proactively generate new enterprise opportunities using AI-powered sales tools, intent data, outbound prospecting and strategic account planning.

• Lead Consultative Discovery: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with senior marketing stakeholders to uncover business challenges and position Partnerize's solutions against measurable commercial outcomes.

• Develop Commercial Business Cases: Build compelling value propositions and ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate revenue growth, operational efficiency and long-term business value.

• Manage Complex Enterprise Sales Cycles: Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes across marketing, procurement, legal, security and finance to progress opportunities from discovery through to close.

• Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain accurate CRM data, manage pipeline health and deliver reliable sales forecasting through disciplined opportunity management.

• Deliver Executive-Level Presentations: Tailor presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate Partnerize's value proposition and differentiate our platform within the partnership ecosystem.

• Achieve Revenue Targets: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets while maintaining a high level of customer engagement and pipeline activity.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

• Enterprise Sales Experience: Up to five years of quota-carrying experience selling enterprise SaaS, MarTech, digital media or technology solutions into mid-market and enterprise organisations.

• Individual Contributor Mindset: A highly motivated self-starter who enjoys building pipeline from scratch and thrives in a high-autonomy, high-performance sales environment.

• Consultative Selling Expertise: Experience applying value-based sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger or similar frameworks to manage complex enterprise sales cycles.

• Executive Presence: Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to influence and challenge senior decision-makers through consultative conversations.

• AI & Sales Technology: Comfortable leveraging AI-powered sales tools, CRM platforms, sales engagement technologies and intent data to improve prospecting, research and pipeline management.

• Ecommerce & Digital Marketing Knowledge: An understanding of ecommerce, affiliate marketing, partnerships or the wider digital marketing landscape. Direct affiliate marketing experience is advantageous but not essential.

• Modern Marketing Fluency: Strong understanding of today's performance marketing ecosystem, including affiliate marketing, creator partnerships and ecommerce.

• Highly Autonomous & Driven: Exceptionally organised, resilient and self-motivated, with the discipline to manage a high-volume outbound sales cadence while working remotely.

Desired Qualifications & Competencies

• Experience selling MarTech, affiliate marketing or partnership technology solutions.

• Experience working within a high-growth enterprise SaaS organisation.

• Proven success selling into retail, ecommerce or D2C brands.

• Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

• Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and modern sales engagement tools.

US Benefits & Perks

• Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need.

• Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parents and 8 weeks for non-birth parents at full pay after one year of employment.

• Robust company-sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits.

• 401(k) Plan with a 4% company match.

• Enhanced Wellness Programme, including access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), Wellness Coaching and Wellness Fridays.

• Regular company events and activities.

Compensation Range

USD $125,000–$160,000 base salary + commission package

Our salary range is intended to cover roles across the United States. An individual's base salary will be determined based on factors including geographic location, relevant experience, skills, knowledge and overall qualifications.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary



Hatch engineering culture is driven by speed, ownership, and impact. We're a small, ambitious team building AI that  transforms how service businesses grow, and we move fast. Engineers own problems end to end, ship to production early, and work across a modern stack (Elixir, Python, Go, React + TypeScript) on problems that directly shape the customer experience. At the end of the day, we're here to build something that matters, grow as engineers, and do it together.



The Forward Deployed Engineer is a first-class builder who ships production code into Hatch's core codebase, internal tooling, and the integration layer that connects Hatch's products to client systems. The primary focus is Hatch's Voice AI product: real-time voice agents that answer calls, qualify leads, and book appointments directly against clients' CRM and field-service systems.



"Forward deployed" describes where you work, not the caliber of what you build. You sit close to our most strategic clients, watch their real call traffic, and debug their failures yourself, working through agent traces, LLM tool-call payloads, service logs, and the client's own API until you can name the actual defect. Then you fix it where it belongs: in the client's configuration, in the integration layer, or in Hatch's core voice pipeline so every customer gets the fix.



Most of your week looks like engineering: reading traces, writing repros, instrumenting what nobody measured, shipping PRs, and validating them on production traffic. The rest is being the person both our clients and our Product team trust on the technical detail. You'll be deep in the build, held to production-grade standards, and given a genuine seat at the R&D table.



This opportunity requires you to be located in the United States.



We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Hatch, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.



What you'll do



 - Root-cause voice AI failures and ship fixes into the core product. Start from one bad call and work backward through agent spans, tool-call arguments, application logs, and warehouse queries until you can explain exactly what happened. Then push PRs into Hatch's voice pipeline and integration layer, gate risky changes behind feature flags, and confirm on live traffic that the fix actually fires.

 - Build and extend the integration layer. Direct API integrations, webhook endpoints, event-driven triggers, and connectors for CRMs and scheduling systems that have no Hatch integration yet. Reconcile what a client's business needs against what their API actually returns, including the cases where those two disagree.

 - Build the tooling and instrumentation that makes this repeatable. Local simulators, harnesses that replay production calls end-to-end, behavioral test suites that catch regressions before a rollout, plus the spans, metrics, and dashboards that separate good calls from bad ones. Know when something you built breaks before the customer does. Build it to first-class standards even when no client ever sees it.

 - Work in the model layer. Prompt structure and guardrails, A/B comparisons between models on real traffic, tradeoffs across latency, cost, and quality, and the practical limits (context budgets, rate limits, tool-calling reliability) that decide whether a design survives production.

 - Own technically complex onboardings end-to-end and serve as the primary technical consultant for clients. Multi-system orchestrations, custom business logic, and CRMs with no connector, while always looking for the reusable pattern underneath. Includes potential onsite visits to present architectural solutions and see deployments through.

 - Turn implementation learnings into product. Surface the recurring patterns that justify dedicated R&D investment, and where something belongs natively, build the first-class version yourself and hand it off to an R&D team to own.
   
   

What it takes to succeed

 - 1-4 years of software engineering experience. You take systems apart to see how they actually work, you'd rather read the source or the raw API response than guess, and debugging is one of your core skills. You're comfortable being handed one broken production interaction with no stack trace and expected to come back with the cause.

 - Proven ability to navigate a broad technology ecosystem and comprehensive developer documentation. You can tell the difference between a problem that warrants a change to Hatch's core code and one that should live in middleware or automation tooling.

 - You verify in production and hold yourself to a high bar. Anyone can find a plausible explanation; you confirm it against real data before calling it fixed. Because you ship quickly and with real autonomy, correctness is on you. Implementations should be right, not just working: complete and consistent, not merely functional.

 - Great communication with business and technical audiences. When requirements are ambiguous, you resolve them before building, not after. You give clear, proactive status updates on your active builds: where you are, what's blocking you, and what the customer needs to know technically. You own the technical work and the client relationship, not project management.

 - You get real leverage out of AI coding tools. You use them to move faster on investigation, tooling, and implementation, and you still own the correctness of everything you ship.

 - Experience with voice AI is not required. Having shipped LLMs into a real application is a bonus: prompt design, tool calling and orchestration, evals, and the failure modes that only show up under real traffic. Familiarity with the voice stack is a further plus, but it's learnable on the job and we expect to teach it.
   
   

What you'll get

 - Based on the anticipated level of experience we are seeking, we expect the compensation range for this role to be between $144,000 and $200,000

 - Full responsibility for projects from day one, a collaborative team, and a dynamic work environment.

 - This opportunity has the option to be fully remote in all locations across the US

 - Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental

 - Mental health support and services via Modern Health

 - 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday

 - Up to 14 weeks of parental leave

 - Monthly wellness stipend

 - 401(k) retirement savings plan

 - Employee stock purchase plan

 - Professional development reimbursement

 - Work from home reimbursement



Why Hatch

 - Shape the future of AI-driven customer service

 - Build alongside founders and leaders who value speed, ownership,and ambition

 - Solve challenging problems and see the impact on real businesses and customers

 - Join a team of builders who care about great engineering, fast execution, and each other



Closing

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability.

Actual salary offered may vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, an individual's location and experience.

We will consider for employment qualified candidates with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law (including, for example, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in San Francisco, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County, and the California Fair Chance Act for roles based in California).

Where required by law, a criminal background check will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment is made, and any evaluation of a candidate's criminal background check will be subject to an individualized assessment that takes into account the candidate's specific criminal records and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations-recruiting@yelp.com or 415-969-8488.

Note: Hatch does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee. Hatch is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Class A CDL Driver

(Overnights required)

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a Class A CDL Driver for our Jeannette, PA team. You will safely transport hazardous and non-hazardous materials to various locations, ensuring compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations.

This highly motivated & safety-first individual will be responsible for operating Class A commercial vehicles, conducting vehicle inspections, maintaining accurate digital logs, and adhering to safety policies and procedures.

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compliance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.

This position reports to the Freight Sales & Logistics Manager. This role is and is based in Jeannette, PA.

We invite you to watch this video CLICK HERE  to discover more about the exciting job responsibilities of a CDL Driver at Triumvirate Environmental.

Responsibilities:

• Safely operate and drive commercial vehicles, including but not limited to tractor trailers and box trucks, in compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations

• Transport hazardous and non-hazardous waste materials to disposal or recycling facilities

• Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections of vehicles, ensuring they are in safe operating condition

• Maintain accurate digital logs of working hours, vehicle service, and repair status, following all applicable DOT regulations

• Complete all required manifest paperwork and documentation accurately

• Communicate effectively with dispatch, supervisors, and clients to ensure timely and accurate delivery of services

• Assist with loading and unloading of materials as needed

• Properly secure load to ensure safe & compliant transportation of materials

• Participate in ongoing training and development programs to maintain industry knowledge and skills

Basic Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License

• Strong commitment to safety and environmental compliance

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Must have a reliable form of transportation

• Must be willing to work flexible hours during the week, including long-distance travel and approx. one to two overnight stays per week

• Ability to work overtime on a regular basis

• Must be able to lift 60 pounds on a regular basis

• Must be willing to consent to Motor Vehicle Record screening, criminal background check, pre-employment physical, and drug screen (inclusive of THC)

• Upon employment, you will be required to participate in a random drug screening program (inclusive of THC) as part of our company’s commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment

• The Driver position frequently handles hazardous chemicals and biological waste. This role is considered safety-sensitive

• Must be eligible to work in the United States without future sponsorship

Preferred Requirements:

• Active Hazmat & Tanker endorsement

• Proficiency in driving manual transmission vehicles

• Previous experience in environmental services or related field

jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry Europe is looking for a Marketing Assistant to join our content marketing team, reporting to the Director of Content Marketing. Our team creates and localises content across seven websites in 17 languages, helping engineers, product designers and procurement teams discover Xometry and helping our business grow in every region we serve. You’ll be at the heart of that work: localising content with AI, supporting Sales, reporting on what performs and keeping marketing operations running smoothly. You’ll take initiative, find ways to automate repetitive work, and have a real opportunity to grow into a Junior Content Marketing Specialist role.

How You’ll Contribute:

Website & Content Localisation

• Translate and localise content with AI tools (Claude, Gemini) for our marketing and knowledge-hub websites, PDFs and one-pagers, using WordPress, Figma and Adobe

• Work across seven domains and 17 languages, making sure content reads naturally in each market

• Help us automate as much of the localisation workflow as possible, and suggest improvements along the way

• Publish videos on YouTube at the request of regional marketers

Performance & Analysis

• Create performance reports for newly released content

• Prepare a monthly funnel breakdown for all regions, showing where users drop off and where we need to improve, in a consistent format agreed with the Regional Growth Team

Sales Enablement Materials

• Design presentations for Sales colleagues on request (Google Slides)

• Conduct lead research in Cognism for Sales colleagues

Marketing Operations & Administration

• Support day-to-day marketing operations (e.g. email banners, merchandise sourcing and production, expense submissions)

• Support the coordination and execution of parts-ordering projects

Other Cross-Functional Marketing Tasks

What You’ll Bring to Xometry:

• At least 1–2 years of experience in marketing, content, communications or a similar role, ideally in B2B

• Professional-level English, written and spoken

• Fluency with AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow. This is a baseline expectation for the entire marketing team

• Hands-on experience with WordPress, Google Workspace, and design tools such as Figma or Adobe

• Strong organisation skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle several requests at once

• A proactive mindset: you spot problems, propose solutions and follow through

• Comfort working remotely in an international team spread across Europe

• Interest in turning data into decisions (funnels, reporting)

Preferred

• Fluency in one or more additional European languages (we work in 17)

• Interest in manufacturing, engineering or industrial technology

• Experience in a high-growth environment where processes are built as you go

This role is built to grow. With strong performance, you can progress into a Junior Content Marketing Specialist position within the team.

Please submit your resume in English.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, People Technology & Analytics
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

At 6sense, we believe exceptional people experiences are powered by great technology, trusted data, and meaningful insights. As the Sr. Manager, People Technology & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, governance, and evolution of our People technology ecosystem while transforming workforce data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role sits at the intersection of People strategy, technology, analytics, and operational excellence. You will own the vision and roadmap for People systems, data governance, workforce analytics, reporting, and AI enablement, ensuring our People organization can scale effectively while delivering an exceptional employee and manager experience.

You will partner closely with leaders across People, Finance, IT, Payroll, Legal, and the broader business to build a modern, data-driven People function that supports growth, improves decision-making, and creates operational efficiency.

This is a highly visible role for a strategic leader who is equally comfortable shaping long-term direction, influencing senior stakeholders, and working directly in Workday to configure, test, troubleshoot, and optimize the system. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with the willingness and technical depth to solve complex operational challenges hands-on.

What You'll Do

People Technology Strategy & Operations

• Own the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of the People technology ecosystem, including Workday, Greenhouse, Pave, and related platforms.

• Serve as a hands-on leader who directly configures, tests, troubleshoots, and maintains business processes, security, reports, integrations, and functionality across the Workday modules in use.

• Develop and execute a multi-year People Technology roadmap aligned with business priorities and organizational growth.

• Ensure the scalability, effectiveness, security, and reliability of People systems and processes.

• Partner with IT, Security, Legal, and key business stakeholders to evaluate, implement, and optimize People technology solutions.

• Lead technology enhancements, vendor management, system upgrades, integrations, and new platform implementations.

• Drive process standardization and automation to improve efficiency and the employee experience.

• Establish strong governance practices for system configuration, change management, documentation, and compliance.

People Analytics & Workforce Insights

• Serve as the organization's trusted leader for workforce analytics, reporting, and People data strategy.

• Develop executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and workforce metrics that enable informed decision-making.

• Translate complex workforce data into clear insights and recommendations for business leaders.

• Partner with Finance and business leaders on workforce planning, headcount management, organizational health, and talent investment decisions.

• Advance predictive and forward-looking analytics capabilities that help anticipate workforce trends and business needs.

• Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and data integrity across all People systems.

Data Governance & Compliance

• Establish and maintain best-in-class People data governance practices.

• Champion data quality, data management standards, and system integrity across the employee lifecycle.

• Ensure compliance with applicable employment, privacy, and data protection regulations.

• Create processes and controls that support audit readiness and operational excellence.

• Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Security teams on compliance requirements and risk mitigation.

AI, Automation & Innovation

• Lead the People organization's approach to AI-enabled productivity and automation.

• Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve employee experiences, and enhance decision-making through emerging technologies.

• Evaluate new tools and capabilities that support recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, employee engagement, and People operations.

• Establish responsible AI governance and adoption practices within the People function.

• Educate and enable People team members on practical applications of AI and automation.

Leadership & Capability Building

• Build and develop a high-performing People Technology and Analytics function.

• Create a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.

• Mentor and develop team members while fostering technical expertise, business acumen, and strategic thinking.

• Serve as a thought partner and trusted advisor to People leadership and business stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

• 8+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HRIS, or related disciplines.

• 3+ years of people leadership experience.

• Deep hands-on Workday configuration and administration expertise across HCM, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, US Payroll, Talent Optimization, and Advanced Compensation, including business processes, security, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.

• Working knowledge of Workday integrations, including Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Studio, Reports as a Service (RaaS), REST APIs, and SOAP APIs.

• Experience leading Workday release planning and regression testing, including assessing release impacts, coordinating end-to-end testing, resolving defects, documenting changes, and ensuring production readiness.

• Familiarity with AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP), including their role in designing and orchestrating secure, scalable workflows that connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems, data, and People processes.

• Strong understanding of workforce analytics, data management, and reporting practices.

• Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decision-making through data and insights.

• Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and technology implementations.

• Experience managing vendors, software evaluations, and technology roadmaps.

• Strong understanding of People processes across the employee lifecycle.

Preferred Experience

• Experience in high-growth SaaS or technology companies.

• Experience supporting global organizations.

• Workday Pro certifications in one or more relevant functional areas, demonstrating advanced platform expertise and a commitment to Workday configuration best practices.

• Knowledge of Greenhouse, Pave, Tableau, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.

• Experience with workforce planning, organizational design, and strategic talent planning.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled HR technologies and automation solutions.

• Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR and other applicable regulations.

Key Competencies

• Strategic Thinking

• Project & Program Management

• Business Acumen

• Data Governance

• Analytical Rigor

• Technology Innovation

• Executive Communication

• Cross-Functional Influence

• Systems Thinking

• Process Improvement

• Change Leadership

• Talent Development

Success in the First 12 Months

• Establish a clear People Technology and Analytics roadmap aligned with business priorities.

• Improve overall data quality, reporting consistency, and system governance.

• Modernize executive workforce reporting and self-service analytics capabilities.

• Streamline and automate key People processes to improve efficiency and employee experience.

• Develop stronger workforce planning and organizational insights capabilities in partnership with Finance.

• Introduce practical AI-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the People function.

• Build a scalable foundation for future growth through technology, analytics, and operational excellence.

Base Salary Range: $132,402.75 - $194,190.70. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Manager - Global Sponsor Banks
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 📝

At Form3, we're building the future of payments. We're looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to shape our global sponsor bank enablement strategy, building the partnerships and operating models that will support our expansion into new markets.

Sitting within our Commercial function, you'll operate at a strategic level, developing relationships with major financial institutions and helping translate complex payment infrastructure requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

This is a commercially focused role with significant strategic ownership. You'll work closely with Product and Engineering and other business functions to ensure our sponsor bank partnerships support long-term growth, market expansion and customer needs.

What you'll be doing:

• Own and shape Form3's sponsor bank enablement strategy, supporting expansion across existing and new markets.

• Build and manage strategic relationships with sponsor banks, financial institutions and payment infrastructure providers.

• Develop scalable sponsor bank engagement models, onboarding frameworks and market-entry playbooks.

• Structure and commercialise network partnership opportunities, balancing commercial objectives with regulatory and operational requirements.

• Translate complex payment infrastructure, scheme and sponsor bank requirements into clear product recommendations.

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Architecture to influence the development and prioritisation of sponsor-bank-enabled platform capabilities.

• Analyse payment flows, clearing, settlement, liquidity and operational requirements to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support market assessments, business cases and commercial propositions for new-market opportunities.

• Establish meaningful KPIs to measure partnership success, market readiness and product adoption.

• Work collaboratively across Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Customer Success to support successful delivery.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

Essential

• Experience developing and managing complex strategic partnerships with banks, financial institutions or payment providers, including structuring and commercialising network partnership arrangements.

• Experience collaborating with Product teams in Payments, Banking, Financial Market Infrastructure or FinTech, translating complex payment, operational and regulatory requirements into clear product direction.

• Strong commercial judgement, with experience supporting business cases, partnership models or go-to-market propositions.

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience working across senior banking, commercial, technical and operational audiences.

Desirable

• Understanding of domestic and international payment ecosystems, including clearing, settlement, sponsor bank operating models, liquidity management and payment scheme participation.

• Experience supporting market expansion, payment rail growth or sponsor bank propositions across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience developing reusable sponsor bank onboarding frameworks or market-entry playbooks.

• Experience establishing KPIs or measuring the effectiveness and adoption of sponsor-bank-enabled capabilities.

• Knowledge of US payment infrastructure and sponsor banking arrangements. Strong UK/EU payments experience is also valued.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage 1: Screening Interview with Talent Team

Stage 2: Interview with Chief Revenue Officer

Stage 3: Case Study Presentation to Senior Leadership Team

Stage 4: Interview with Chief Product Officer

We always aim to stick to the above process; however, there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we're hiring the right fit for the role.

HIRING LOCATIONS 📍

This is a 100% remote position, and we're hiring in the following US states:

• Connecticut

• Florida

• New Jersey

New York




WORDSMITH

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a Sales Manager to lead and scale our SMB NYC team.

You'll own the number for your team, coach a group of full-cycle Account Executives who run high-velocity sales across smaller and mid-sized legal teams, and build the processes that keep a high volume of deals moving. Your focus will be hiring, developing people, and driving consistent team performance across short, fast-moving sales cycles.

This is a fast-paced environment. Things move quickly, priorities shift, and there isn't always a clear playbook. You'll need to make decisions, set the standard, and keep your team focused and moving.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of SMB Account Executives

 - Coach the team to qualify quickly and focus on the deals that matter

 - Raise the bar on efficient discovery and demos with a clear focus on value

 - Hire, onboard, and ramp new Account Executives, including SDRs stepping up

 - Run tight pipeline reviews and keep follow-up strong across the team

 - Work closely with SDRs, Marketing, and Product to sharpen messaging and improve conversion

 - Make CRM the team's operating system for managing volume effectively




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience managing and coaching a high-velocity SaaS sales team

 - Evidence of hitting targets in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

 - Strong qualification skills, and able to teach the team when to push and when to walk away

 - Clear, confident communicator

 - Highly organised and disciplined with pipeline management

 - High energy and resilience; you can drive volume without losing quality
   
   


HOW WE WORK

We're an in-office team. We work together because it helps us move faster, learn quickly, and improve as a group. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

This is a fast-paced environment. Your team will be managing multiple deals at once, and momentum matters.

The people who do well here stay organised, keep control of pipeline, and don't let deals stall.




WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

 - Equity: Stock options with real upside

 - Market: Strong demand and fast-moving buyers

 - Team: A growing group of SMB Account Executives to lead and develop

 - Support: SDR, Marketing, and Product working closely with Sales

 - Progression: Clear path to senior Sales Leadership as we scale




WHY WORDSMITH

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

ABOUT DOIT

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 


THE ROLE

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 - Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 - Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 - Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 - Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 - Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 - Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 - Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 - Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 - Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 - Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 - High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 - Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 


THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 - Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 - Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 - Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 - Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the United States. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the United States.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

2. Role-specific interview

jobs.title: InfoSec Lead
jobs.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.



Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.



Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.



A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.



🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.



 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.



🤝  We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.



💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.




THE ROLE

Orbital has been scaling fast, and we’re scaling or security and compliance with it. We're hiring a senior, NYC-based InfoSec Lead to own our information security due diligence, compliance, and vendor risk end-to-end - bringing structure and consistency to work that's currently covered on a contractor basis.

Now is the time to bring this function in-house, focusing on automating manual tasks (such as customer DDQs), enhancing our compliance stance, and ultimately securing the Infosec function as a proactive enabler of our growth.

This is a full-time InfoSec role, working alongside our UK-based IT Manager. Whilst experience in IT operations or IT management is helpful, the Infosec Lead and IT Manager report independently to our Head of Operations and own separate (but naturally interconnected) remits.

You’ll also work closely with Engineering, Product, Legal and our external Infosec support, to keep security and compliance embedded in how the business runs, not bolted on after the fact.

Based in the US, with ideally some flexibility to come to the New York office.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




INFOSEC & COMPLIANCE DELIVERY

You will:

 - Own our InfoSec strategy and roadmap: set the direction for how security and compliance scale with the business, not just an executor; identify control gaps and weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and track it through to completion.

 - Own our risk program: run risk identification, assessment and treatment, keep the risk register current. You're making the call on what's an acceptable risk.

 - Own third party risk assurance, in both directions: run vendor security reviews for vendors we bring on (or are renewing with) and own customer & vendor due diligence (DDQs) when we’re the ones being assessed.
   
   - Pull in support required from the rest of the business and jump on client calls when needed to resolve DDQs.
   
   - Drive automation on the DDQ side specifically, so it doesn’t eat a disproportionate share of your time as the function matures.

 - Own our existing and future compliance certifications: you’ll be responsible for maintaining compliance with existing standards (ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2) and pursuing future certifications relevant to us. Management of the compliance program will be end-to-end, and involve ISMS management reviews, quarterly access control reviews, audit evidence gathering, scheduling and remediation tracking.
   
   - This also includes keeping policy & public-facing security documentation (eg. our trust centre) current - so certification is a continuously-run capability rather than a periodic scramble.

 - Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Product, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into how we build and sell, and stay close enough to product changes that customer-facing security information is always accurate.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant senior in-house or scale-up InfoSec leadership experience: you've owned due diligence, vendor review, and compliance work end-to-end inside a fast-moving business, not just advised from the outside.

 - Strong understanding of cloud & cloud security, and ideally previous technical background in IT Security or SWE / DevOps.

 - A track record of scaling due-diligence processes, not just running them manually, you know how to spot what can be templated, automated, or self-served, and you make that happen rather than just wishing for it.

 - Comfortable being close to engineering: you don't need to write code, but you're happy sitting in technical conversations, understanding product changes, and knowing enough about IT systems to weigh in sensibly on security-sensitive changes.

 - Pragmatic and delivery-focused: you know the difference between a genuine risk and a distraction, and you keep due diligence and audit work moving at commercial pace rather than becoming a bottleneck.

 - AI-literacy with working familiarity with AI governance (ISO 42001, EU AI Act etc).

 - Comfortable operating independently: this is an individual-contributor role to start, with real ownership of the roadmap rather than a narrow, audit-only remit.

 - Working knowledge of privacy law is important (GDPR/CCPA/US state privacy laws) to partner with our legal function.




WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

 - You want to run day-to-day IT operations or manage IT staff. That sits with our IT Manager, not this role.

 - You prefer tasks defined and handed to you. This is a role for an independent decision maker... you're expected to identify what needs doing, set the plan, and drive it to closure yourself, not wait to be briefed.

 - You feel more comfortable with a narrowly-defined, audit-only remit. This role sits close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, and is expected to actively reduce manual DDQ overhead over time, not just process tickets.




WHY JOIN ORBITAL

 - Shape how security and compliance scale with the business... the processes and playbooks here are still being built.

 - Genuine cross-functional influence: you'll be close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, not sitting outside them.

 - Genuine momentum: $60m Series B, doubling headcount, expanding across two continents.

 - Work alongside a leadership team that treats security as a business enabler, not just a risk function.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.



💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.



💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.



Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.
