 - You'll own experimentation from the analytics side. That means turning loose assumptions into sharp, testable hypotheses, enforcing bulletproof statistical standards and protecting decisions from false positives.

 - You'll model raw event streams into foundational behavioural datasets that enable advanced modelling and self-serve for analytics and data science.

 - You'll debug data issues and optimise tracking to keep data integrity rock solid.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - A proven digital analytics background with Snowplow, GA4, Quantum Metric, PostHog or Contentsquare, plus a deep technical grasp of client-side tracking, from designing dataLayer schemas to tackling data loss from tracking restrictions.

 - Solid SQL skills, including hands-on querying of raw, event-level data, and an eagerness to level up into behavioural data modelling. dbt or Python is a bonus.

 - Real experience supporting product experimentation and A/B testing. Mobile app or gaming experience is a plus.

 - Hands-on experience tinkering with AI tools, automating your daily routines and exploring AI-backed solutions for product analytics.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, exceptional attention to detail and high reliability.

 - Critical thinking, a proactive approach and the confidence to challenge baseline assumptions, including what the AI tells you.
   
   


WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT

You'll be at the heart of product innovation, where your insights directly shape gaming experiences for millions of players. In our high-growth environment, you'll have the freedom to take ownership of impactful projects while collaborating with brilliant minds who value your expertise. Every analysis you deliver will drive real business decisions and help us stay ahead in the competitive gaming landscape.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik Kcentar Sub City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: AI Product Manager, Enterprise AI
jobs.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

As an AI Product Manager, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a set of employee-facing Enterprise AI products. That includes a modern, self-service AI learning experience and AI agentic applications and autonomous agents. You will partner with AI Solutions Engineers, release managers, and business leaders to deliver those products, and you will own the training, enablement, and messaging that make them land. You are a PM who can also teach, write, and tell the story.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Roadmap

• Define the vision, roadmap, and success measures for your products, aligned to Enterprise AI and Corporate Operations OKRs.

• Translate ZEO needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

• Prioritize your backlog using impact, effort, risk, and data, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.

Discovery & User Insight

• Run continuous discovery with ZEOs and functional leaders: interviews, surveys, usage and ticket data, and champion feedback.

• Understand what ZEOs need to learn, how they want to learn, and where AI creates value in their work.

• Map workflows, run pilots and experiments, and use the results to decide what to build, change, or retire.

Delivery & Execution

• Work with AI Solutions Engineers, architects, and vendors in an agile model to ship increments on a predictable cadence.

• Coordinate dependencies with Security, Legal, Data, HR, and Finance so delivery is safe and on time.

• Manage releases of your products from intake through retirement, and keep a clear, current backlog.

Training & Enablement for Your Products

• Own training and enablement for every product you ship: guides, demos, FAQs, live sessions, office hours, and role-based learning paths.

• Build and run a self-service AI learning experience that uses modern formats such as short video, interactive walkthroughs, prompt and skill libraries.

• Deliver build-enablement for ZEOs who create agents, covering agent design basics, testing, and safe use of data and connectors within approved guardrails.

• Recruit, equip, and recognize AI champions, and use them to bring feedback and use cases back to the product team.

Messaging & Communications

• Write and own the messaging for your products and for company-wide AI updates, including launches, guidance, policy and governance changes, and wins.

• Obsess over the right words, audience, and timing. Make complex technical and policy changes clear, accurate, and human.

• Communicate roadmap, status, and trade-offs clearly to teammates, stakeholders, and leadership.

Metrics & Experimentation

• Define and track success metrics for your products, such as self-service resolution, active use, proficiency, learning engagement, time saved, and satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).

• Design pilots and experiments to de-risk investments, and report results with clear recommendations.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Apply Enterprise AI guardrails, access controls, and review processes to your products.

• Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance to meet privacy and security requirements.

• Monitor usage, spot risks or misuse, and implement mitigations.

Business Outcomes You Will Impact

• ZEOs with deeper AI skill, including more ZEOs who can build agents safely.

• Higher self-service resolution and a better employee experience with Zoe.

• AI products that are secure, governed, and easy to use.

• Clear, consistent AI messaging across the company.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a closely related role such as technical program management, business systems analysis, or product operations, ideally for internal or enterprise software.

• Demonstrated ability to take a product or feature from discovery through launch and iteration.

• Working knowledge of LLMs and agentic workflows, and the ability to explain them to non-technical audiences.

• Hands-on daily use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or Glean.

• Excellent writing and messaging skills, shown through a portfolio or work samples.

• Experience designing and delivering training or enablement for cross-functional audiences.

• Experience defining product metrics and using data and qualitative feedback to make decisions.

• Strong stakeholder management in a matrixed environment, working with engineering, security, and legal.

• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, Slack, and Google Workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with conversational AI, knowledge management, or employee self-service products.

• Experience building a learning hub, video, or interactive learning content.

• Experience running a champions or community program.

• Experience with AI governance and responsible AI practices.

• Prosci, CSPO, or similar certification.

• Experience in a high-growth SaaS company.

Why This Role Matters

Zuora wants to move fast and responsibly with AI. This role owns the products and the skills that make that possible, and it has a direct line to the leaders who set Zuora’s AI direction.

About the Team

Zuora’s Corporate Operations team is our internal technology organization. We create technology experiences that connect our teams and empower our global ZEOs with productivity and self-service, while strengthening security, compliance, and scale.

The Enterprise AI team builds, governs, supports, and enables change across Zuora’s AI foundation: frontier model platforms, enterprise search, and a growing portfolio of AI agents. Our focus is a secure, governed foundation that scales, and helping every ZEO build real AI skill on top of it.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

• Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break

• Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)

• Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth

• Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available

• Mental wellbeing resources and support

*Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

• Collaborate deeply across teams and regions

• Learn constantly and iterate often

• Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent, where applicable).

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$115,800—$173,600 USD

jobs.title: Senior Territory Account Executive - Shanghai
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Beijing, China

About the Role

This role will be cover customers in East China remotely, with regular travel to the territory as needed.

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

• Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcer
jobs.description:
The Strategic Sourcer will focus on creating, building, and executing end-to-end sourcing strategies as well as manage a talent attraction strategy to recruit key talent for talent gaps. In addition, this person will build talent pipelines, success profiles, and talent communities.

In this role, you will work with various recruitment and social media systems and platforms, leveraging social channels and technology to create efficient and best-in-class stakeholder experiences. You will act as an advisor, using market analysis and industry research to inform sourcing strategies that enable future capability building and influence stakeholders to act proactively regarding their current/future talent mix and talent market availability.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partner with key stakeholders to build talent pipelines ahead of gaps/vacancies.
• Develop sourcing strategies that will target critical, high-level talent in highly competitive and challenging markets.
• Serve as a Sourcing expert, including leveraging talent market intelligence (LinkedIn Insights and SeekOut), historical data (ATS candidate fill data), and provide recommendations directly with business leaders, Recruiters, and Business HR.
• Build strategic talent networks through external partnerships, conferences, and industry engagement to identify, engage, and hire high-caliber talent aligned with business needs
• Develop deep expertise and seek continuous learning in-focus areas, with the ability to understand and speak in detail about functions, culture, and role responsibilities and showcase AbbVie’s Employee Value Proposition using Smart Recruiters CRM.
• Proactively source passive candidates through advanced search techniques including Boolean search on resume databases, social media, LinkedIn, and industry directories to uncover high quality talent pools.
• Conduct thorough candidate prescreening and facilitate presentation to hiring managers and recruiting team using various Talent Acquisition platforms to maintain/retain accuracy, quality, and integrity of data.
• Nurture Professional pipelines by keeping talent engaged as roles are posted and provides information regarding available opportunities.
• Providing updates and reporting on critical roles and sourcing activities to stakeholders and reporting.
• Develop strong partnerships with Recruiters and candidates to build a qualified candidate bench to meet current and anticipated business needs.
• Build trust and strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, including business leaders, Recruiters, Total Rewards, and Talent Development, and Business HR to understand the key roles and challenges to overcome to secure top talent.
• Gather data around competition and market conditions or trends that may impact on our ability to find and hire the right talent.

• Bachelor's degree required.
• Extensive experience in a strategic sourcing role with contingent and/or retained search knoweldge, preferably in pharmaceutical operations/manufacturing, along with the ability to lead and influence others.
• Progressive CRM experience preferred.
• Experience in successful screening, initial contact, prescreening, and interviewing, both in-depth phone and face-to-face with candidates.
• Ability to create and execute talent strategy for critical roles. This would include a good understanding of lead generation techniques such as internet mining.
• Experience utilizing innovative search techniques to develop talent map/name generation, preferably SeekOut or LinkedIn Insights
• Team player, flexible, high integrity, strong negotiating, and influencing skills
• Demonstrates a consistent track record of delivering results, often in the face of challenges or obstacles.
• Shows an entrepreneurial spirit and a high level of pro-activeness to drive performance. High performer in environments with much autonomy

jobs.title: Területi Értékesítő - Győr
jobs.description:
Szia! Mi vagyunk a Teya.

A Teyát az az egyszerű meggyőződés hívta életre, hogy a helyi vállalkozások jobbat érdemelnek.

Azok a kávézók, éttermek, szalonok, üzletek és vállalkozások, amelyek karaktert adnak az utcáinknak, munkahelyeket teremtenek, és mozgásban tartják a közösségeinket. A pénzügyi szolgáltatások terén viszont régóta nehézségekkel találkoznak. A körülményes eszközbeszerzés, a nehezen elérhető ügyfélszolgálat és a bonyolult folyamatok rengeteg időt, energiát és pénzt vesznek el tőlük ahelyett, hogy a saját vállalkozásukra és ügyfeleikre figyelhetnének.

A Teya azért létezik, hogy ezen változtasson.

Olyan, egész Európa-szintű pénzügyi platformot építünk a helyi vállalkozásoknak, ahol az egyszerű eszközök, az átgondolt dizájn és a valódi emberi segítség áll a középpontban. Partnereink biztos támaszként számíthatnak ránk a cégük menedzselésében, ez a felelősség pedig a mindennapi munkánk alapja.

A dinamikus fejlődésben hiszünk, nem engedünk a minőségből, és a legkisebb részlet felett sem siklunk át. Hisszük, hogy a kimagasló teljesítmény és a valódi vendégszeretet kéz a kézben jár.

Ha szeretnél értékteremtő termékeket fejleszteni, valódi problémákra megoldást találni, és megbízható partnere lenni a helyi vállalkozásoknak, nagyon várjuk a jelentkezésedet!



Miért dolgozz velünk:

Értékesítési képviselőként kulcsszerepet vállalhatsz abban, hogy a magyar kis- és középvállalkozások digitális fejlődését támogasd. Nálunk nemcsak terméket értékesítesz — valódi, hosszú távú partnerségeket építesz, és aktívan formálod ügyfeleink jövőjét.

Feladataid:

 - Új ügyfelek felkutatása és tartós, bizalmon alapuló kapcsolatok kiépítése

 - Piackutatás és új üzleti lehetőségek azonosítása

 - Ügyféltalálkozók szervezése, lebonyolítása és adminisztrációja

 - Aktív részvétel értékesítési módszereink és folyamataink fejlesztésében

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Japan
jobs.description:
Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light

We are Lumineers. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

• Pursuit of greatness: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail

• Meaningful work matters: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward

• Elevate each other: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀

Job Details

• 💼 Revenue team

• 📍 Japan

• 🕜 Full-Time Remote

• 🌐 Fluent in English and Japanese

What you will do
You’ll be the face of Lighthouse for prospective clients, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close. This is a hunter role: you carry a quota, you build your own pipeline, and you’re accountable to outcomes and success. No excuses, just results.
What makes this different: you won’t do it alone. Lighthouse is deploying an agent AI infrastructure — Enablement, Pre-Sales, and Coaching agents — alongside a modern revenue stack. AI handles the prep, the sequencing, and the pattern recognition so you can focus on what matters — building relationships, running sharp discovery, and closing deals.
We work with structured sales methodology, like MEDDPICC to support high-quality deal execution. You’ll advance deals with evidence, protect pricing on value, and forecast with precision. We want to help you use modern tools to become a better seller and achieve great success.

Where you will have impact

• Own your territory and your number. Build and execute a strategic territory plan to generate a net-new pipeline. Maintain 3x pipeline coverage, forecast honestly, and take full accountability for your results. Your quota is your commitment.

• Hunt and build a pipeline. Source a meaningful share of your own pipeline through outbound sequences, ICP targeting, Lighthouse Connect events, and industry conferences. This is not an SDR-reliant role.

• Run a disciplined sales process. Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. Use the AI Pre-Sales Agent to identify gaps before every major call. Advance deals through stage gates with evidence, not optimism. Leverage AI to make your days easier and focus on more selling time.

• Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage the Enablement Agent for call prep, discovery frameworks, and positioning. Use the Coaching Agent to surface patterns in your pipeline and win rate. Push back on the tools when they’re wrong — help make the system smarter.

• Become a hospitality expert. We will help you understand revenue management workflows well enough to run ROI conversations without a pre-sales overlay on every deal. Position an integrated platform versus point solutions. Know the competitive landscape inside out.

• Drive results beyond net-new. Consistently meet and exceed sales targets through new business and by identifying expansion and upgrade opportunities within your accounts. Partner with Product to share market feedback and influence the roadmap. Represent Lighthouse at industry events to build the brand and your

About our team

You’ll join a global Revenue team of 150+ sales professionals across 24 countries. Our team works across the full Lighthouse product suite, helping hotels, chains, and hospitality groups achieve their commercial goals. It’s a collaborative, high-energy environment with real opportunities for career growth and the chance to learn from experienced leaders as we continue to expand our market share.

What's in it for you

• Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.

• Career development: Workshops, frameworks, and training to maximize your professional potential.

• Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.

• Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

Who you are

• 5-7 years in a closing sales role, SaaS experience is a must but hunger and skill matters more than industry tenure.

• Self-directed, coachable, and driven to continuously improve. You seek feedback on your calls, your pipeline, and your positioning — and act on it within the next deal, not the next quarter.

• You treat AI tools as a core part of your selling motion, not a novelty. You adopt new tooling quickly and bend it to your style.

• Experience with MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is that you bring discipline and structure to how you run deals.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to sell on value, not price. Confident engaging stakeholders from GMs to C-suite.

• You want to win. You prospect when it would be easier not to. You follow up one more time. You’re not okay with a bad quarter.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

Learn more about our careers and recruitment process | Our company and leadership team | Beware of recruitment scams

jobs.title: CloudOps Engineer (Network Engineer)
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

As a CloudOps Engineer at Wrike, you have advanced skills in supporting cloud and on-prem data center infrastructure with security in mind. You know how to work with containers, networking, monitoring, automation, and debugging a reasonably complex infrastructure. You feel comfortable defining your own work based on the team OKRs. You can also help others do so when necessary. You are used to proposing meaningful improvements to the existing infrastructure in alignment with architects and tech leads, and you can drive the execution

In this specific role, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Network Infrastructure across hybrid environments. You bring deep, hands-on expertise in architecting resilient network topologies, configuring core routing and switching, managing firewalls, and securing connectivity between cloud providers and on-premise data centers.

Your Impact:

• Keep our infrastructure and company information safe with reliable network security

• Keep our services running smoothly and fast for users around the clock

• Managing the Wrike product infrastructure

• Implementing reliable solutions to ensure a product uptime SLA of 99.9%

• Working with GCP, AWS and other cloud providers in the IaC paradigm

• Introducing and supporting new infrastructure services

• Actively participating in incident response and management, including on-call duties

• Developing and maintaining professional connections within and outside of the team

Your Qualifications:

• Juniper/Cisco devices underlying network infra

• Kubernetes and ArgoCD

• Nginx, HAproxy and Istio for load balancing

• GCP, AWS and Cloudflare are our main cloud providers

• Puppet, Ansible and Terraform for defining everything as a code

• Python to automate everything

• Prometheus (VictoriaMetrics) and Zabbix for monitoring

• Graylog, Logstash, Fluentd for logging

• Jenkins and Gitlab-CI for building pipelines

• Upper Intermediate English skills

Standout Qualities:

• Experience with working with enterprise-grade infrastructure and SaaS solutions

• Profound knowledge of network technologies, data transmission protocols, network architecture, and equipment

• Experience working with BGP, OSPF, EVPN, STP, IPsec protocols

• Familiarity with Linux, iptables, Nginx, HAproxy, and keepalive

• Understanding of information security principles and the ability to apply them to network architecture

• Sufficient scripting skills in Python/Bash or other scripting languages

• Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills

Team Dynamics:

• Your manager will be Dmitrii Vlasov, SysOps Team Lead

• We have two dozen folks in the SysOps Department, consisting of four teams distributed in Prague, Nicosia, Rennes and Tallinn

Our Work Style:

• Scrum based processes (daily standups, biweekly plannings, quarterly plannings)

• Hybrid mode (1-2 days per week)

• On-call shifts in production and development environments

What’s Next?

• Introduction Call with a Recruiter

• Technical interview

• Cultural interview

Benefits & Perks:

• 25 calendar days of paid vacation

• Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)

• Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)

• Hybrid Working Model

• School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)

• Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees

• Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Director
jobs.description:
Sales Performance

• Deliver agreed annual sales, contract value, revenue and margin targets.
• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities across the European data-centre market.
• Identify and pursue opportunities with new and existing data-centre clients.
• Develop large single-country and multi-country sales opportunities.
• Maintain disciplined focus on opportunity progression and conversion.
• Personally drive opportunities through to successful contract award.

Client Engagement

• Develop trusted relationships with senior client decision-makers, influencers and procurement stakeholders.
• Understand client requirements, priorities, procurement strategies and upcoming opportunities.
• Create early engagement with prospective clients ahead of formal procurement processes.
• Lead client meetings, presentations, site visits and commercial discussions.
• Maintain consistent senior-level engagement throughout complex and potentially long sales cycles.

Opportunity and Pursuit Management

• Take end-to-end ownership of qualified sales opportunities.
• Lead responses to RFIs, RFPs and other competitive tender processes.
• Coordinate the internal expertise required to develop compelling and commercially competitive proposals.
• Lead client presentations, commercial discussions and contract negotiations.
• Maintain accurate pipeline information, opportunity management and sales forecasting.
• Ensure commercial momentum is maintained throughout the sales process.

Solution Selling

• Develop a detailed understanding of client security requirements within mission-critical data-center environments.
• Work with subject-matter experts to translate those requirements into commercially attractive security solutions.
• Clearly articulate the value and differentiation of the proposed solution.
• Sell on value, quality, scalability, consistency and operational capability rather than price alone.
• Identify opportunities to expand services and revenue within existing client relationships.

Internal Collaboration and Handover

• Partner with country organisations, account teams, operations, solutions, finance and legal teams to develop and close individual opportunities.
• Operate as part of the Global Clients organisation, maintaining a close connection with the specialist data-centre group.
• Provide a structured handover of closed opportunities to mobilisation and operational teams.

The successful candidate will be an accomplished senior sales professional with a strong record of personally winning significant, complex B2B contracts. Relevant experience should include:

• Significant senior sales experience within data centers, physical security, critical infrastructure, facilities management or another complex outsourced-services environment.
• A demonstrable track record of personally developing and closing major contracts.
• Experience selling to large international and enterprise clients.
• Strong understanding of the European data-center sector and its client environment.
• Experience managing complex and long-cycle sales opportunities.
• Strong experience with major RFPs, tenders and competitive procurement processes.
• Excellent commercial, negotiation and closing capabilities.
• Strong financial understanding, including pricing, margins and commercial models.
• Credibility and confidence when engaging with senior executives and procurement leaders.
• The ability to work effectively across multiple European countries, cultures and internal organisations.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional European languages would be advantageous.
• Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Europe.

The successful candidate will be:

• Sales driven: highly motivated by winning new business and achieving ambitious sales targets.
• A strong closer: able to maintain momentum, navigate complexity and convert opportunities into signed contracts.
• Client focused: capable of understanding what matters to the client and translating this into a compelling commercial proposition.
• Commercially astute: comfortable with pricing, margins, negotiations and complex contractual discussions.
• Proactive: actively creates opportunities rather than relying solely on incoming RFPs.
• Persistent: able to manage long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders without losing momentum.
• Collaborative: capable of bringing together the right internal expertise while retaining clear personal ownership of the sale.
• Executive in approach: credible and confident when engaging senior client stakeholders.

What We Offer

At Securitas we believe in doing the right thing and doing it well. For our customers and our employees. Our employees come from all walks of life and bring with them a multitude of talents and perspectives. We aim for diverse representation throughout the company, and we are committed to equal pay, safe working conditions, gender balance and an inclusive work environment with a wide range of skills and development opportunities.

If it all sounds good for you, don’t hesitate and apply!

PAY: The role's salary is based on the scale, the candidate's location and their experience.

jobs.title: Project Engineer

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.



 


THE ROLE

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.

 - Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 - Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 - Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 - Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 - Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 - Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 - Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 - Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 - Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 - Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 - Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 - Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.



THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 - Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 - Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 - Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 - Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 - People who cannot go deep into product details.

 - Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 - Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 - People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM - AMER
jobs.description:

We're operating at the cutting edge of one of the world's fastest-growing industries, shaping what comes next. Over the last 2 years, Chainalysis has made big bets and moved fast to capture the market opportunity in front of us: we've accelerated growth, landed enterprise-wide contracts at the world's largest financial institutions, completed four acquisitions to build our AI talent and expand our products, and launched our first agentic product to select customers.

Our job is to build and execute a talent acquisition strategy that is inclusive, rigorous, and repeatable around the world. As we enter a period of significant go-to-market growth, we're investing heavily in our sales organization and need a recruiter who can match that pace.



We're looking for a Recruiter, Go-to-Market who will own and drive hiring for sales and go-to-market roles at Chainalysis. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role. You'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top sales talent across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Account Executive roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our enterprise and public sector sales teams, acting as a recruiting partner who understands the business and delivers results.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:




BUILD PIPELINE THROUGH OUTBOUND SOURCING

 - Own pipeline generation for go-to-market roles, with a heavy emphasis on proactive outbound sourcing to find and engage top sales talent

 - Map the competitive landscape across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services to identify where strong Account Executives and quota-carrying sellers work today

 - Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

 - Maintain a high volume of outbound activity to keep pipeline ahead of hiring demand




RUN FULL-CYCLE RECRUITING AT PACE

 - Own the full recruiting lifecycle for go-to-market roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close

 - Manage a high-volume requisition load across enterprise and public sector go-to-market teams

 - Move candidates through the process efficiently while delivering a thoughtful, personalized, and transparent candidate experience at every step

 - Make data-driven decisions about pipeline health, conversion rates, and sourcing channel effectiveness to keep hiring on track




PARTNER WITH HIRING MANAGERS AND THE BUSINESS

 - Build trusted relationships with sales leaders to develop a deep understanding of their teams, priorities, and what great looks like for each hire

 - Guide hiring managers through the recruiting process with clear communication, calibrated expectations, and market insights

 - Share competitive intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and hiring trends across relevant markets

 - Provide regular pipeline updates and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule




CONTRIBUTE TO TALENT ACQUISITION AS A TEAM

 - Champion diversity and inclusion in every search, with intentional focus on engaging candidates from underrepresented backgrounds

 - Share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements across the Talent Acquisition team

 - Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, tools, and candidate experiences

 - Occasionally provide recruiting support for roles outside of go-to-market as priorities and bandwidth allow




WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring sales and go-to-market talent, specifically quota-carrying roles such as Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Business Development Representatives

 - Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline, generate candidate interest through direct outreach, and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

 - Proven track record of recruiting sales talent within the SaaS and Cybersecurity sectors, with a specific focus on candidates who have successfully sold complex solutions into the Fintech, Cryptocurrency, or Traditional Financial Services markets.

 - Comfort operating at high volume and managing multiple open requisitions simultaneously without dropping quality or candidate experience

 - Strong organizational skills with sharp attention to detail and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

 - The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach to working on a small, close-knit Talent Acquisition team

 - Curiosity about our industry and genuine interest in learning the Chainalysis product suite and competitive landscape




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience recruiting for public sector go-to-market roles (Federal, DoD/Intel)

 - Familiarity with government clearance requirements and their impact on candidate pools

 - Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO technology company

 - Experience working with Ashby ATS and sourcing tools

 - Recruiting experience beyond core sales roles, such as professional services, solutions engineering, or customer success



This role is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, High Throughput Biology (Contract)
jobs.location: South San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Scientist to join our team at Xaira Therapeutics on a contract basis. In this role, you will lead the design and execution of innovative experiments that accelerate our drug discovery and development efforts, applying functional genomics and synthetic biology approaches, developing high-throughput screens, and driving new technology initiatives. The successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise and strong laboratory skills, communicate effectively in writing and in person, and work productively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. You will also mentor junior scientists and stay current with the relevant literature and emerging technologies in the field.

This is a contract position with an anticipated duration of approximately 9 months.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of biochemical, molecular, and cell-based assays to support high-throughput screening platform development.

• Scale high-throughput screening strategies for binder discovery in mammalian systems.

• Evaluate and pilot emerging technologies and experimental workflows to strengthen discovery capabilities, and make recommendations on their adoption.

• Develop and optimize automated workflows, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, and process efficiency.

• Partner with drug discovery, computational biology, and AI-based protein design teams to analyze, interpret, and share insights from screening data.

• Independently manage multiple projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality data and alignment with team goals.

• Maintain accurate records of experiments, protocols, and findings, and contribute to internal and external scientific presentations.

Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Immunology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Functional Genomics, or a related field, with 4+ years of postdoctoral or industry experience.

• Candidates with fewer years of experience are encouraged to apply and the title can be adjusted accordingly.

• Proficiency with molecular biology techniques, complex library construction, flow cytometry, and cell line engineering.

• Experience with pooled screening and NGS-based readouts, including library preparation and sequencing QC.

• Experience with high-throughput antibody display technologies, including yeast, phage, or mammalian display, is a plus.

• Familiarity with single-cell genomics workflows (e.g., scRNA-seq, barcoded or multiplexed assays) is a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex experimental issues independently and to guide others through them.

• Strong data analysis capabilities, including proficiency with visualization and statistical software (e.g., GraphPad Prism, R, Python).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present scientific findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.

• Collaborative team player who can work effectively across interdisciplinary teams and drive cross-functional projects.

• Track record of scientific contributions, such as publications, patents, or internal technology development.

Employment Type: Contract

Expected Contract Duration: 9 Months

The base pay range for this position is expected to be $65-$80 hourly; however, the base pay offered may vary depending on the market, job-related knowledge, skills and capabilities, and experience.

Xaira Therapeutics an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that our strength is in our differences. Our goal to build a diverse and inclusive team began on day one, and it will never end.

TO ALL RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Xaira Therapeutics does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or employees. Xaira Therapeutics is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer (US)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

 You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

 - Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

 - Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

 - Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

 - Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

 - Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

 - Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

 - Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

 - Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

 - Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

 - Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

 - Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

 - Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

 - Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

 - Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

 - Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

 - Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

 - Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

 - People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

 - Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

 - Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

 - Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

 - People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

 - Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.
   
   


THE BAR

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights. 

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it. 

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.




LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We're looking for a hands-on Cloud Engineer with strong Google Cloud experience to help migrate enterprise applications and infrastructure from on-premises environments to GCP. This role involves building cloud infrastructure, automating deployments, configuring networking and security, and supporting the migration of Windows-based applications and supporting services.
You'll work closely with Cloud Architects, Data Architects, and application teams to build reliable, secure, and repeatable cloud environments.
We're looking for someone who enjoys hands-on engineering, can troubleshoot independently, and is comfortable working through the challenges of migrating existing enterprise workloads.

Location: Remote – United States

• Build and manage GCP infrastructure using Terraform, including projects, VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, Compute Engine instances, storage, and IAM.

• Deploy and configure Windows Server virtual machines, including IIS-hosted applications and supporting infrastructure.

• Automate Windows server configuration, OS hardening, and IIS setup using Ansible.

• Configure GCP networking components, including Cloud NAT, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Armor, and connectivity to on-premises systems.

Qualifications

• Experience: 5+ years in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering, including hands-on GCP experience

• 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering.

• Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud NAT, and Cloud Load Balancing.

• Experience managing Windows Server environments, particularly Windows Server 2019/2022 and IIS.

• Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools.

• Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT TARRO




OUR VISION

Tarro is building the future of restaurant infrastructure. The U.S. restaurant industry is a trillion-dollar market, but it remains relatively underserved by technology. Running a restaurant comes with a never-ending list of operational work, and many owners spend most of their day on what they have to do rather than what they want to do. We envision a future where they can delegate that work to Tarro and focus on what they love doing.

Restaurant owners want more orders, better margins, and fewer operational headaches. Giving them software is only part of the answer. Our ecosystem brings phone ordering, online ordering, delivery, point of sale, payments, and marketing into one vertically integrated operation. We combine software, AI, and human operations so independent restaurants can hand that work to us end to end.

Using Tarro should feel like having experienced operators, engineers, and marketers working for your restaurant. Our job is to turn that expertise into services owners can rely on, without having to build those teams themselves.

 


OUR TRACTION

Thousands of restaurants have entrusted Tarro with their success. Since 2020, we’ve processed close to $3 billion in restaurant orders, helped those restaurants serve more than 20 million consumers, and taken an estimated 3 million hours of work off their teams’ hands. And we’re still early in our journey.

 


OUR TEAM

We’re a lean team with top talent from OpenAI, Meta, Google, Tesla, Square, Stripe, Shopify, and Citadel. We’re scrappy builders who love to roll up our sleeves and get into the details of improving a restaurant’s operations. Many of us regularly work in restaurants to experience firsthand what our users deal with.

We move quickly, keep process light, and expect high standards of craft. Our leaders stay hands-on, and our teams have the autonomy to make decisions and the responsibility to see them through.

At Tarro, product judgment and technical execution belong together. You’ll be trusted to understand the restaurant’s problem, decide how to solve it, and carry the solution through to something people use every day. If you want to build products restaurant owners depend on, we’d love to work with you.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking to hire a product designer to shape and build the user experiences across multiple Tarro product areas. In this role, you’ll regularly conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and collaborate with product, engineering, and a wide variety of stakeholders. You’ll own decisions, ship regularly, and have a direct impact on our Tarro’s growth and evolution. As a foundational hire on our small but growing design team, you'll not only help build our products but also define how design works at Tarro and shape our design culture.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH:

 - You’ll own the user experience for key high-visibility product initiatives at Tarro, all the way from initial prioritization to concepting, development, launch, and beyond

 - You’ll be part of identifying the right problems to solve, not just working on them

 - You’ll regularly collaborate with product managers, engineers, other designers, and a broad cross-functional team throughout the product development process

 - You will regularly conduct your own user research to drive your decision-making, ranging from focus group discussions to shadowing and interviews, both virtually and on-site

 - You’ll deeply understand our users by getting trained to use our products like they would (you'll take many real customer calls)

 - You’ll join as an early member of the growing Tarro design team and meaningfully contribute to shaping the team’s culture, processes, and ways of working

 - You’ll define and design key workflows while also accounting for edge cases and points of friction, and managing design tradeoffs throughout
   
   


ABOUT YOU:

 - Minimum 5 years of tech and/or agency UX design experience

 - Strong UX fundamentals and visual design skills

 - Demonstrated experience designing and launching features together with engineers and product managers

 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and storytelling skills

 - Bias for action and a drive to get things done, wearing multiple hats as needed
   
   


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience building 0 to 1 products

 - Experience building tools and workflows for internal team members

 - You have experience working in the restaurant industry or on restaurant technology

 - You have experience contributing to and/or creating design systems and tooling
   
   

If you do not meet all the requirements listed above which candidates rarely do, don't worry. We still encourage you to apply!
