jobs.title: Solutions Architect, SF
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. 

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Solutions Architects are the technical tip of the spear in Exa's presales motion. From the first call to the technical win, you're the person who shows prospects what Exa can do and proves it works for their use case. You partner with Account Executives on new accounts and new opportunities, and you're measured on technical wins, POC conversion, and pipeline velocity. 

You'll run discovery with engineers and executives, build demos that land, design and run workshops and proofs of concept, and make the technical case for Exa against alternatives. When a deal needs specialist depth, you pull in our Forward Deployed Engineers. When a deal closes, you hand the customer off to them with everything they need to get to production fast. This is not a demo-only role. You are an engineer who sells.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Lead the technical side of new opportunities alongside Account Executives, from first call through technical win

 - Run discovery to understand a prospect's use case, architecture, data needs, and success criteria, and qualify where Exa fits

 - Build and deliver tailored demos, sample apps, and prototypes that show what Exa can do on the prospect's own problem

 - Design and run workshops and POCs with clear success criteria, timelines, and evaluation plans, then drive them to a decision

 - Win technical evaluations by benchmarking Exa on quality, latency, and cost, and making a clear case against alternatives

 - Handle technical objections and answer security, compliance, and architecture questions

 - Bring in Forward Deployed Engineers as specialists when a deal needs deeper expertise, and run a clean handoff to them after close

 - Feed market signal back to Product: what prospects ask for, where we lose, and what would help us win

 - Build reusable presales assets such as demo environments, reference architectures, and evaluation playbooks


REQUIREMENTS

 - Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build compelling demos, implement POCs end to end, and design and run rigorous evals in head-to-head competitive scenarios

 - 2+ years of hands-on presales or technical sales experience, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company. You've owned the technical side of deals, run discovery and demos with technical buyers, and helped carry opportunities to close

 - Strong communication skills: you can adapt your pitch to CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike, and explain complex technology simply

 - Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

 - High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

 - Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and workshops


YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU...

 - Have worked as a solutions architect, solutions engineer, or sales engineer at a developer-tools, API, or AI company

 - Have built with LLMs, RAG, or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

 - Have helped close revenue or driven commercial outcomes at a previous company

 - Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

 - Love the moment a prospect sees a demo and gets it

 - Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

 This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.



Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Planning & Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the role (What you’ll be doing)

We are looking for a Planning & Procurement Manager to build and lead the Planning and Procurement functions at Eucalyptus AU as the business scales and integrates the Hims & Hers portfolio. This is a hands-on, building role. You will be expected to delve into the detail in areas that need focus building the structure from the ground up — running negotiations, designing frameworks, and leading the S&OP cycle — while also stepping back to lead the function and develop your direct report. It also comes with a people management responsibility (one direct report: the Supply & Product Planner), and developing that person well is genuinely important — but the role is clearly weighted towards hands-on execution. The right candidate is a senior operator who still wants to be close to the work: equally comfortable drafting a supplier contract and presenting category strategy to the leadership team. This is not a role for someone who has moved primarily into oversight and is looking to stay there. The role works closely with the Head of Supply Chain & Fulfilment, the Supply Chain Team, Commercial, Clinical, Legal & Compliance, and external supplier partners. Two things shape how the role operates. First, commercial strategy is set by the Commercial team — this role partners with Commercial to understand it and builds an aligned category and planning strategy on top of it. Second, the Supply & Product Planner (your direct report) owns supply and inventory planning, new product development, and packaging — you set their direction, support their development, and personally own the procurement and planning work at a senior level yourself.

As our Planning & Procurement Manager, you will:

• Design and build the Planning & Procurement operating model — personally establish the frameworks, structures and processes that both functions run on: how procurement decisions are made and governed, how the S&OP cycle connects to supplier management and category strategy, how inventory and demand signals flow into procurement decisions, and how the function’s work connects to Commercial and Clinical priorities. You are building the operating model from scratch — this is hands-on design and implementation work, not a delegated project.

• Build and personally run the S&OP process — design and lead the monthly S&OP cycle yourself, bringing together commercial demand signals, inventory positions, supplier performance, and supply constraints. Ensure the process generates decision-quality outputs for the Head of SC and Commercial stakeholders. Work with the Supply & Product Planner to ensure their inventory and supply planning inputs feed the cycle correctly, and evolve the process over time as the business grows.

• Build the category strategy in partnership with Commercial — partner with the Commercial team to understand the commercial strategy they own, and translate it into an aligned category sourcing and negotiation strategy across Eucalyptus AU’s product categories — personally defining the negotiation levers (volume commitments, MOQs, payment terms, multi-year agreements) that secure competitive landed costs, and leveraging Hims & Hers’ existing global supplier relationships while negotiating terms appropriate for Australian volumes, lead times, and market requirements.

• Own supplier performance and quarterly business reviews — personally run structured QBRs with strategic suppliers, set and track performance scorecards across quality, service, cost, and lead-time reliability, and lead formal performance improvement plans where suppliers fall short of agreed standards — feeding this into the S&OP cadence as a core input.

• Design the supply-risk and contracting framework with Legal — build the framework for identifying and mitigating supply risk across categories (single-source dependencies, lead-time volatility, import and biosecurity exposure), establish the contracting standards, templates, and approval flows in partnership with Legal and Compliance, and ensure all products meet Australian labelling standards and ARTG-compliant requirements, with import duties and biosecurity obligations managed for inbound product.

• Own new product and category launches — partner with Commercial and Clinical on new product lines and personally own the procurement and supply side of bringing them to market: TGA/ARTG registration readiness from a supply standpoint, supplier onboarding and readiness, and launch stock planning. Work closely with the Supply & Product Planner, who supports the operational execution of NPD, while you hold the strategic and commercial accountability.

• Manage and develop the Supply & Product Planner — manage, coach and develop your direct report, who owns supply and inventory planning, new product development, and packaging development and sourcing. Set a clear development plan, provide regular feedback grounded in radical candour, and create the conditions for them to do their best work and grow — this is an important part of the role, even if the balance sits more heavily toward your own hands-on execution.

• Coach the broader team and raise the bar — as a senior person in the Supply Chain function, practise radical candour, set the quality standard for how the function sources and plans, and model inclusive ways of working across the team and with cross-functional partners.

About you (Who you are)

• 6+ years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain planning, ideally within FMCG, pharma, healthcare, or another regulated consumer-goods environment, with a track record of owning a category or function end-to-end.

• A hands-on operator who is energised by working in the detail as much as by the strategy — you design the framework and you build it. You are equally comfortable in a supplier negotiation and in front of a leadership team, and the right fit is someone who still wants to be close to the work, not someone looking to step back from execution.

• Demonstrated experience designing and building procurement or planning frameworks, operating models, and processes from scratch — not just operating within frameworks others have set.

• Comfortable designing and running an S&OP process; hands-on experience with supply and demand planning is highly desirable.

• Experience managing or coaching others; a track record of developing less experienced team members is important given this is a people manager role.

• A proven commercial negotiator who has designed and delivered category strategies and measurable outcomes — not just run tenders under a defined process.

• Strong working knowledge of Australian import, labelling, and regulatory requirements; familiarity with TGA/ARTG registration processes is desirable.

• Analytical and fluent with cost, margin, and inventory data; hands-on experience with ERP and procurement systems is advantageous.

• A collaborative cross-functional partner who can translate commercial strategy into category plans, and bring multiple stakeholders along without direct authority over them.

• Resilient and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-scaling, post-acquisition environment as the product portfolio and supplier base evolve.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Enterprise Connectivity
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

A connected Claude is the difference between a general-purpose chatbot and a real coworker. We're building the connected enterprise on three fronts: zero-touch activation, a thriving connector ecosystem, and an enterprise control plane that lets organizations adopt with confidence. We own the path from discovering a connector to using it every day: default and suggested connectors, one-click setup, connector requests, and the identity and admin pieces that remove setup friction for a whole organization at once.

You'll be a technical leader who owns activation end to end, from the moment someone sees a connector to their first successful use of it. You'll also help to shape the foundations that help the connector ecosystem grow, and the governance controls that make it safe at enterprise scale. You'll partner closely with product, design and data science, and carry real ownership over what we ship next.

What you'll do

• Own connector activation end to end: measure the funnel from discovery to first use to habit, find the biggest drop-offs, and fix them

• Build and run experiments on default connectors, in-product suggestions, connector requests and onboarding flows

• Make setup close to zero-touch, building on open standards like Cross App Access (XAA) and the MCP authorization spec so one approval can turn a connector on for everyone

• Improve the connectors people reach for most, like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, so the first experience works and keeps working

• Lay platform foundations for the connector ecosystem: reusable building blocks that make every new connector easier to launch, discover and activate

• Build out the enterprise control plane: admin controls and governance (domain restrictions, labels, permissions) that help security teams say yes faster instead of blocking rollout

• Partner with product, design, data science and sales to turn usage data and customer feedback into priorities

• Set technical direction and standards for the team, mentor other engineers, and lead with influence rather than authority

Minimum Qualifications

• Have shipped growth or activation work: onboarding flows, funnels, experimentation, and measuring what actually moves usage

• Are comfortable with authorization and identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO), enough to make setup flows simple without cutting corners

• Have built on large platform APIs (Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace or similar) and can debug failures on both sides of the boundary

• Have built platform or ecosystem surfaces that other teams or developers rely on, and care about durable, well-designed APIs

• Understand what enterprise admins and security teams need from policy, permissions and governance at scale

• Use data and user research to decide what to build, and can explain the tradeoffs to product and design partners

• Drive cross-team and cross-company alignment to ship, with influence over authority

Preferred Qualifications

• Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level

• Contributed to or implemented emerging auth standards (IETF OAuth drafts, MCP authorization)

• Experience with data governance or information protection (sensitivity labels, DLP)

• Built admin consoles or policy engines for multi-tenant SaaS

• Run growth experiments on activation funnels

• Built AI products or agent tool integrations (MCP)

• Helped grow a developer or partner ecosystem around a platform

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We're looking for someone with original ideas, exceptional taste, and the production judgment to make them happen. Someone who knows where to spend, where to simplify, and how to create something remarkable within a real budget.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Battery Management
jobs.description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Join our team developing the embedded software that powers next-generation wearable devices, focusing on battery management and power systems. You will architect and deliver firmware that interacts directly with battery hardware, ensuring reliable, efficient, and safe device operation for millions of users.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain battery and power-management firmware for resource-constrained microcontrollers, including fuel-gauge drivers, charge control, and thermal mitigation.

• Integrate and validate fuel gauges and charger ICs at the register level: configuring NVM, setting protection thresholds, implementing JEITA profiles, and supporting capacity-learning features.

• Develop the device-side telemetry stack for battery data, ensuring signals are validated end-to-end against hardware ground truth and actionable for field diagnostics.

• Diagnose and root-cause complex field and laboratory failures that cross hardware/software boundaries, distinguishing root triggers whether in firmware, silicon, or power management peripherals.

• Collaborate with electrical engineering, cell suppliers, hardware validation, and product teams, translating between component specifications and observed fleet behaviors.

• Drive firmware correctness and reliability, particularly in safety-critical decisions like charge termination and power-off thresholds.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience developing production-grade embedded C for microcontrollers.

• Direct experience with embedded RTOS environments (Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar) and bare-metal firmware bring-up.

• Demonstrated skill developing I2C and SPI peripheral drivers, with hands-on debugging using logic or protocol analyzers.

• Experience integrating and debugging Linux kernel drivers, especially within the power supply subsystem.

• Proficient in reading datasheets and implementing register-level and bitfield logic, including management of errata.

• Proven ability to debug on real hardware using JTAG/SWD, serial consoles, and bench instrumentation (e.g., power analyzers, SMUs, thermal chambers).

• Python proficiency for test automation, device log parsing, and field data analysis.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with battery management technologies: fuel gauges, coulomb counting, OCV/impedance-based SoC estimation, charger ICs, JEITA charging, battery NVM configuration, and protection circuits.

• In-depth knowledge of lithium-ion cell behavior, including aging, temperature effects, and failure mechanisms to inform conversations with suppliers and engineering peers.

• Experience analyzing data at fleet scale with SQL or equivalent analytics tools, with a bias toward validating fixes against real-world field data.

• Ownership of hardware components across consumer product lifecycles, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and factory bring-up, with active involvement in failure-analysis loops.

• Track record of responding to production incidents for shipped hardware in the field.

CA Base Pay

$130,000—$170,000 USD

Benefits

Delart provides competitive benefits and compensation across all regions where we operate. In the United States, our benefits package includes premium PPO and HMO medical insurance, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, a company-matched 401(k) plan, and a generous paid time off policy.

Join us in shaping the future of technology. Apply today!

Delart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace for all employees. We strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Employer Brand, Communications & Social
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI is a frontier AI research and deployment company. Frontier research is at the center of how we advance our mission, with researchers, engineers, product leaders, operators, and many other teams working together to turn new capabilities into systems that benefit humanity. The People team helps OpenAI attract, engage, and support the exceptional talent this work requires.

Employer Brand sits at the intersection of Research, Recruiting, Communications, Marketing, and Brand. Its mandate is to establish OpenAI in the talent market as a frontier research lab and make our distinctive research environment, mission, culture, and opportunity for impact relevant and tangible to every priority talent audience.

About the Role

We’re hiring an employer brand professional to bring OpenAI’s talent narrative to life through compelling content, communications, and social media. Reporting to the Employer Brand Manager, you’ll help translate our employer brand strategy into stories and campaigns that help candidates understand our work, our people, and the opportunity to contribute to our mission.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad employer brand responsibilities and a particular focus on writing, content planning, digital, and social storytelling. You’ll develop content that reflects the experiences of our researchers and employees, adapt stories for different audiences and channels, and help deliver a consistent, credible candidate experience.

You’ll work closely with Recruiting, Marketing & Brand, Internal Communications, the broader People team, employees, hiring managers, and external partners to bring projects from idea through publication and measurement.

In this role, you will:

 - Manage the day-to-day employer brand content calendar, coordinating social content, publishing, reviews, and deadlines with channel owners and cross-functional partners.

 - Write and edit social posts, employee stories, careers content, recruiting communications, and other materials that help candidates understand why OpenAI.

 - Identify story opportunities and work with researchers, employees, and hiring teams to turn their experiences into accurate, engaging content across written, visual, and video formats.

 - Partner with Communications and Marketing & Brand to adapt content for social channels, maintain a consistent voice, and test formats that resonate with talent audiences.

 - Support broader employer brand initiatives, including recruiting events, candidate communications, and resources for recruiters and hiring managers.

 - Coordinate content production and review workflows, keeping source materials, permissions, approvals, and project information organized and current. Flag outdated or inconsistent information and escalate sensitive reviews or delivery risks.

 - Track content and campaign performance, gather audience feedback, and use those insights to improve future work, distinguishing observed results from interpretation.

 - Handle sensitive information and employee and candidate stories with care, ensuring accuracy, appropriate approvals, and respect for consent.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience in employer brand, communications, social media, marketing, recruiting, content, events, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter, reporting to the Manager, Talent Acquisition, to support the growth of Vast Satellite, our new line of high-power satellite buses built on the technology proven by Haven Demo and developed for the Haven space stations. This person will be the dedicated recruiter for the program, hiring across thermal, avionics, power, propulsion, GNC, flight software, and manufacturing.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

Responsibilities:

• Own full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer acceptance across multiple open roles and disciplines, as the sole recruiter supporting the satellite program

• Partner with hiring managers and executive leaders to define role requirements, interview plans, headcount priorities, and hiring timelines, and provide candid advice on market conditions

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies by discipline to identify and engage top and passive candidates across aerospace, satellite, defense, and advanced hardware

• Build working knowledge across technical disciplines to run credible intake conversations, screen candidates, and talk through the work with them

• Manage candidate pipelines and drive an efficient and engaging interview process

• Facilitate interview debriefs and guide hiring teams through candidate evaluation and decision-making

• Lead offer discussions and help close candidates while maintaining a strong candidate experience

• Track recruiting metrics, pass-through rates, and pipeline health, and report progress toward hiring goals to leadership

• Ensure consistent recruiting processes and documentation within the ATS

• Represent Vast’s mission and value proposition to candidates throughout the hiring process

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, including hardware or aerospace engineering roles

• Strong domain knowledge in at least one of the following: thermal, avionics, power, propulsion, GNC, flight software, or manufacturing

• Exposure to the other disciplines, or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in new technical areas

• Experience managing multiple searches simultaneously in a fast-paced environment with limited support

• Strong business acumen and executive presence, with experience advising senior leaders

• Demonstrated ability to source and engage passive candidates

Preferred Experience

• We are particularly interested in candidates with recruiting experience across several of the following areas: Avionics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Controls, Power Systems, Propulsion, GNC, Software, and Structures Manufacturing and production engineering Hardware engineering roles including mechanical, electrical, design, and structural

Additional Preferred Experience:

• Experience in space, satellite, defense, or other regulated hardware industries

• Experience using Greenhouse or similar ATS

• Ability to operate autonomously and manage competing priorities

• Strong attention to detail and process discipline

• Experience supporting a program through rapid scale-up, or working in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations

Pay Range: California

$122,000—$165,000 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single-model ASICs.

We are a fully in-person team in West San Jose, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

jobs.title: Managing Director of Development
jobs.description:
This role’s priority application deadline for a guaranteed review of your resume is 11/12/2026. Following this deadline, applications will be reviewed as needed on a rolling basis.

About Democracy Prep Public Schools

Democracy Prep educates responsible citizen-scholars for success in the college of their choice and for lives of active citizenship. In close partnership with families, we empower young people with the skills and values to flourish as community leaders who will strengthen our American democracy and change the world.

Democracy Prep Public Schools (DPPS) is a tuition-free, high-performing public charter network operating in New York serving more than 3,000 students PreK–12 across 10 campuses. Having launched the next phase of our 2025 - 2030 Strategic Plan, DPPS is positioned to achieve the strongest results in our history by accelerating academic outcomes, strengthening long-term sustainability, investing in our people, and expanding our impact responsibly. This is a pivotal moment to help shape and fuel the next chapter of Democracy Prep’s growth.

About the Opportunity

DPPS operates with an annual budget of over $100 million and is entering a pivotal phase of growth, with significant opportunity to build and scale a high-performing development function to support its 2025 - 2030 Strategic Plan. The Managing Director of Development owns Democracy Prep’s philanthropic growth strategy and revenue engine. This leader sets the vision, builds the systems, and drives measurable results across individual, foundation, corporate, and institutional giving. This position operates on our hybrid in-person work model. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with the Deputy Chief of Staff and senior leadership team, the Managing Director leads one of Democracy Prep’s key organizational functions, delivering high-stakes, material impact for the organization. This role shapes funding strategy in direct alignment with Democracy Prep’s strategic priorities, including academic excellence, operational sustainability, programmatic scaling, and regional growth.

Who You Are

• A mission-driven leader with an unwavering commitment to Democracy Prep’s vision of college success and authentic civic engagement for all scholars.

• A self-aware and reflective leader committed to building and sustaining an equitable culture across all aspects of the organization.

• A strategic and entrepreneurial fundraiser with experience securing major gifts from individuals, corporations, and foundations.

• A skilled relationship builder who collaborates effectively across teams, develops long-term internal and external partnerships, and inspires confidence among Board members, donors, and colleagues.

• A compelling communicator with excellent writing and presentation skills, able to synthesize complex information into clear, persuasive messages tailored to multiple audiences.

• A sophisticated development professional with deep knowledge of fundraising programs and strategies, adept at navigating complex institutions, identifying donor alignment, and adapting to rapidly evolving environments.

• A lifelong learner and results-oriented leader who brings creativity, initiative, and rigor to building scalable development programs.

• Educational background: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree or related advanced study preferred.

What You’ll Do

Multi-Year Development Strategy & Revenue Ownership

• Design and lead an ambitious, multi-year development strategy aligned to Democracy Prep’s Strategic Plan, fueling transformational outcomes for students and the adults who serve them.

• Own and drive multi‑million dollar fundraising targets, including annual and multi-year goals.

• Build a diversified funding model integrating individual giving, principal gifts, foundations, corporate partnerships, government opportunities, and advocacy initiatives to advance Democracy Prep’s mission and strategic priorities.

• Identify emerging funding opportunities and proactively build high-capacity donor pipelines.

Major & Principal Gifts Leadership

• Personally manage a focused portfolio of at least 25–40+ high-capacity prospects.

• Secure six-figure and select seven-figure gifts in partnership with the CEO.

• Conduct at least 15–20 strategic cultivation and solicitation meetings annually.

• Build multi-year stewardship and engagement plans for top-tier donors.

• Partner with the CEO to source and cultivate Board-aligned prospects with philanthropic capacity.

Foundation & Institutional Partnerships

• Maintain retention of existing foundation partners.

• Secure at least 3–5 new institutional partnerships annually.

• Lead the preparation and submission of a high volume of grant and foundation applications, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with organizational priorities to maximize funding opportunities.

• Increase foundation revenue year-over-year through proactive relationship management.

• Lead strategic grant positioning in partnership with the Senior Leadership Team to maximize network-wide impact.

Corporate & Strategic Partnerships

• Develop and execute a corporate engagement strategy aligned to our operational model and strategic programmatic priorities.

• Secure corporate partners annually.

• Elevate corporate partnerships beyond sponsorship toward sustained philanthropic investment.

Board Engagement & Philanthropic Culture

• Drive a clear Board giving strategy in partnership with the CEO and Board Chair.

• Support progress toward 100% Board giving.

• Lead and oversee the design and execution of key giving campaigns and donor engagement initiatives, including signature events such as Giving Tuesday and major galas, ensuring each effort drives revenue, strengthens donor relationships, and advances Democracy Prep’s philanthropic strategy.

• Activate Board members and development committees to leverage networks and open doors.

• Build a culture of philanthropy across the organization through leadership coaching and strategic alignment.

• Stay abreast of emerging trends and best practices in education and the broader nonprofit sector to inform strategy, identify new opportunities, and ensure the organization remains competitive in philanthropic engagement.

Infrastructure, Systems & Performance Management

• Implement and optimize a donor management system that provides real-time visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, revenue progress, and donor retention.

• Produce monthly and quarterly dashboards for senior leadership and Board review.

• Build scalable systems that enable long-term revenue growth.

• Collaborate with the Senior Leadership Team and Marketing & Communications to develop the vision, strategy, and supporting materials, such as white papers and organizational assets, for core programs.

Compensation

Salary for this position is $170,000 - $190,000 based on equivalent years of experience. Democracy Prep employees are provided with a benefits package that includes medical, vision, and dental insurance, 403B matching, and parental leave.

Schedule

This is a hybrid position with three days required in our New York City office and two remote days per week.

Democracy Prep is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. Our mission is to educate responsible citizen-scholars who will change the world. We strongly believe that by building a DREAM team that represents numerous perspectives, backgrounds, and areas of expertise, we can achieve this goal together. This is a value we highly support and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Growth Strategist (NYC)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.


THE TEAM

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

 - Founded and exited successful companies

 - Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic

 - Won IMO and IOI gold medals

 - Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.


CORE PRINCIPLES


TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.


OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.


ACTION: GET IT DONE.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.


YOUR ROLE

Growth Strategists at Rox own what happens after a deal closes. You'll take Rox into some of the largest revenue organizations in the world and make sure it changes how their sellers work and what their numbers look like. You'll be the person a RevOps VP calls to plan the next phase, and you'll also be in the room with reps working out why a sequence isn't booking enough meetings.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll run a portfolio of enterprise accounts end to end. That means launching new customers, setting goals with executives, finding out what's driving results and building the business case for expansion. You'll work side by side with sales, product, and engineering. What you learn in the field will shape the product and the playbooks the rest of the team uses. If you want to solve hard business problems with a frontier AI product and see your impact show up in customers' revenue numbers, we'd love to talk.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - The launch. Take the handover from sales and run the first 90 days: stakeholder alignment, the mutual action plan, use-case validation, train-the-trainer, and the first leadership readout.

 - The outcomes. Work with champions and executives to define success metrics with clear baselines, targets, data sources and owners. Then run the weekly operating cadence that hits them.

 - The diagnosis. Dig into sequence performance, adoption and pipeline data to find what’s actually working. Turn what you find into changes reps will make.

 - The executive relationship. Run QBRs and strategy sessions with CROs, VPs of Sales and RevOps leaders, and bring them the next high-leverage play before they ask.

 - The growth arc. Turn proven results into the case for new business units and use cases, working with sales on the commercial side.

 - The product. Bring what you learn in the field straight to engineering and product leads. Shape roadmap priorities, then drive adoption of what ships.

 - The compounding. Build the playbooks, Rox skills and agent workflows that let us grow our enterprise customer base faster than our headcount.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 4+ years in management consulting, strategy or enterprise GTM, with a track record of measurable outcomes delivered alongside client teams.

 - You’ve earned the trust of VP- and C-level leaders and can hold your ground in the room.

 - You’re as comfortable rebuilding a rep’s pipeline as presenting to the C-suite, and you don’t think either is beneath you.

 - You work directly with messy data, whether that’s CRM exports, spreadsheets, or SQL. You build the analysis yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

 - You use AI tools every day and have opinions about where they work and where they don’t.

 - You’d rather have ownership and ambiguity than a well-defined lane.

 - Nice to have: an MBA, a STEM or quantitative background, or experience in RevOps or a high-growth startup.

Location: New York, NY; 5 days a week in office


WHY ROX

 - Momentum: Rox is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst and GV, and trusted by revenue teams at companies like MongoDB, Ramp, TogetherAI, and XBOW.

 - Build at the frontier: You'll work on a frontier AI product alongside the people building it. What you see with customers goes straight to product and engineering and ships into the product.

 - Grow with the function: Growth Strategy is still being built, and strong performers take on more scope quickly. Recent Growth Strategists have been promoted to lead roles within their first year, and there's room to lead a pod, own a segment or help build the function.

 - Compensation: Competitive base plus meaningful equity

 - Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); flexible PTO


APPLY

To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

jobs.title: Partner Operations
jobs.description:
Who we are

Picogrid is a leading venture-backed defense technology company founded to bridge the decades-long gap between modern technology and the critical demands of national security. Today, we're building the essential infrastructure to unify sensors, autonomy, and operators with our technology deployed in active operations around the world. Our mission is to deliver an operational advantage to secure the United States and its allies.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Picogrid’s platform becomes more valuable as more technologies can connect to it and operate together in the field. In Partner Operations, you will be in charge of cultivating and expanding that ecosystem: the processes, data, programs, and cross-functional coordination that turn individual partner relationships into a durable company capability.

You will own the operational partner lifecycle from qualification support and onboarding through technical activation, recurring engagement, field participation, approved external storytelling, and ongoing health reviews. You will work across Engineering, Deployments, Capture, Legal, and Marketing to give every meaningful partner a clear internal owner, current context, defined next steps, and a reliable experience working with Picogrid.

Partner Operations builds the infrastructure that allows the broader ecosystem to onboard, remain engaged, and create sustained operational value, and uses that infrastructure to be the face of our partnership activities to other companies in our ecosystem. You will get close enough to deployments, demonstrations, and technical integrations to understand what partners actually need, not just what appears in a relationship tracker.

Success is measured by the quality, continuity, and usefulness of our partnerships: how quickly partners can engage, how effectively their technologies and teams participate in Picogrid’s work, and whether those relationships grow stronger through real execution.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain Picogrid’s partner system of record, including relationship stage, internal owner, key contacts, agreements, technical status, approvals, commitments, and next actions

 - Design and operate a consistent partner lifecycle spanning intake, qualification support, onboarding, activation, recurring engagement, health reviews, expansion readiness, and responsible offboarding

 - Coordinate cross-functional onboarding across Engineering, Deployments, Capture, Legal, and Marketing so partners understand how to work with Picogrid and internal teams know what has been promised

 - Partner with Engineering to make technical onboarding faster and more repeatable by gathering interface documentation, clarifying integration prerequisites, tracking readiness, and resolving coordination gaps

 - Create repeatable engagement programs—such as partner briefings, technical office hours, working sessions, event participation, and ecosystem updates—that keep relationships useful between deployments and proposals

 - Maintain relationship continuity through clear notes, ownership, handoffs, and follow-through so critical partner context does not disappear when people, priorities, or programs change

 - Support demonstrations, exercises, and selected field deployments to understand how partner technologies perform together and translate those lessons into better onboarding and engagement programs

 - Coordinate approved co-marketing and external storytelling, including logos, compatibility claims, case studies, announcements, and website content, with the evidence and approvals those claims require

 - Develop and track partner-health and program-quality metrics. This includes onboarding time, engagement consistency, technical activation, relationship coverage, data freshness, and participation in relevant programs. Use these to improve the ecosystem
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You are a creative program operator who can turn a broad relationship strategy into practical workflows, useful programs, and consistent execution

 - You care about the depth and durability of relationships, not simply the number of names in a database or agreements signed

 - You create systems people actually use, balancing operational discipline with the speed and judgment of an early-stage company

 - You build trust across external partners and internal teams through preparation, responsiveness, discretion, and dependable follow-through

 - You are technically curious and can work credibly with engineers and operators without pretending to be the person implementing the technology

 - You learn from the field and can translate the reality of deployments, demonstrations, and integrations into better partner programs

 - You move comfortably between detailed operational work and higher-level analysis of where the partner ecosystem needs to improve
   
   


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years of experience in partner operations, ecosystem or alliance programs, program management, business operations, professional services, or a related role

 - Demonstrated experience building or improving a multi-stage operating process involving external relationships and several internal functions

 - Strong program-management skills, including the ability to define owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and follow-up across concurrent workstreams

 - Experience maintaining reliable relationship or program data in a CRM, project-management platform, or comparable system of record

 - Technical literacy sufficient to understand product and integration concepts, coordinate onboarding, and translate between business, engineering, and operational stakeholders

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the judgment to work across executives, technical teams, operators, and external partners

 - Willingness to travel periodically for partner meetings, demonstrations, industry events, and selected field activities
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience owning partner, ecosystem, alliance, or developer-program operations

 - Experience at a startup or high-growth technology company where core processes and systems were still being built

 - Experience in defense technology, aerospace, national security, management consulting, investment banking, or another demanding environment requiring structured analysis and stakeholder management

 - Experience supporting technical integrations, partner onboarding, co-marketing, joint events, demonstrations, or field deployments

 - Familiarity with government customers, military operations, or the defense industrial base
   
   


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Picogrid’s partner ecosystem has grown through real work alongside technology companies, operators, and government customers. Those relationships extend what our platform can connect, strengthen our ability to deliver integrated solutions, and create credible evidence that Picogrid can make diverse systems work together. But relationship depth does not scale through informal knowledge and one-off follow-up alone.

Partner Operations creates the operating layer that allows those relationships to compound. By giving partners a consistent experience, making technical and relationship context visible, maintaining meaningful touchpoints, and learning from joint execution, this role will turn a growing network into a trusted and durable ecosystem advantage.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base salary range: $125,000–$190,000 per year. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation package at Picogrid.

 - Significant stock options with a high potential upside as an early-stage company

 - 401(k) with employer matching

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Relocation assistance provided (if applicable)

 - Unlimited PTO (two-week minimum) and 11 paid holidays per year

 - Paid parental leave for both parents

 - Lunch provided when working in-office and a fully stocked kitchenette

 - Free EV charging at the HQ

 - Unique office in El Segundo, CA stocked with quality coffee, snacks, and craft beer
   
   


EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



#LI-DNP

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy

Picogrid is committed to providing a professional work environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We are an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Spend
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Spend is building the financial operating layer for modern businesses, bringing together corporate cards, expenses, bills and procurement. You'll shape clear, approachable experiences for complex financial workflows and help define how the product comes together across surfaces.

 - Define and drive the product design vision for Spend, from first sketch through shipped product, in partnership with Product and Engineering.

 - Translate complex financial workflows across corporate cards, expenses, bills and procurement into clear, approachable experiences for modern businesses.

 - Lead end-to-end design across desktop web, mobile web and native app experiences, partnering closely with engineers through critical moments from exploration to launch.

 - Shape product strategy, roadmap and customer validation while helping establish the design culture and principles for the team.

 - Build deep domain knowledge and connect work across the Spend product so experiences hold together as a coherent system.

 - Partner with cross-functional teams, including the design systems team, to create scalable solutions rather than isolated screens.

You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 7+ years of experience as a UX or product designer, with expertise across desktop web, mobile web and native app experiences.

 - A strong portfolio demonstrating complex systems, multi-channel user journeys and intricate object relationships, not just polished screens.

 - Proficiency in UX methods including generative research, information architecture, interaction design and user testing.

 - The ability to think in systems and translate complex financial or operational workflows into intuitive product experiences.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - A proven track record of leading projects end to end in ambiguous environments.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to shape requirements, scope work, test ideas and ship high-quality experiences.

Preferred

 - Experience designing products for financial services, fintech, expense management, corporate cards, procurement or other complex business workflows.

 - Experience working across multi-entity, multi-currency or audit-sensitive products.

 - Experience contributing to product strategy, roadmap development and customer validation.

 - Experience working with or contributing to a design system across multiple product surfaces.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You're not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

 - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Design at Airwallex sits close to the centre of our product, which is exactly what makes it a team for designers who are looking for impact, not just execution. You’ll work side by side with product and engineering from day one, shaping the system and challenging the brief to deliver the best outcomes for our customers, influencing what gets built and how it comes together.

The access our designers have to senior leadership is real. The problems are complex, the standards are high, and the impact is visible at global scale. Airwallex is growing fast, and design is expected to keep pace. This is a genuinely exciting stage to be doing work that matters.

If you want real influence, ambitious work, and the chance to grow fast alongside smart, driven builders, this is the place to do it.

 


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
