jobs.title: Lead System Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is seeking a Lead System Integration Engineer to serve as the critical technical bridge between our Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware and Software teams. In this role, you will be the connective tissue that ensures complex PCBA designs and embedded software modules are seamlessly integrated and rigorously aligned with high-level system requirements. You will own the technical stewardship of the BMS integration lifecycle, driving the architectural coherence and functional performance necessary to deliver our groundbreaking 100-hour iron-air energy storage systems.  



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Orchestrate the integration of BMS hardware (sensors, actuators, and power circuitry) with embedded software control modules to ensure seamless functional performance.

 - Lead the decomposition of high-level system requirements into actionable, bi-directionally traceable, and testable specifications for both hardware and software teams.

 - Establish and manage Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and Hardware-Software Interface (HSI) definitions to govern communication and clear pinout expectations.

 - Oversee the development of validation and integration plans, including the use of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and System Integration Test Beds to verify safety and reliability under diverse conditions.

 - Drive the execution of Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) and Circuit FMEA (CFMEA) to proactively identify and mitigate integration-level risks.

 - Act as the central partner for Design, Test, and Validation teams, reconciling interface nonconformities and maintaining architectural integrity from prototype to production.

 - Champion standardized Systems Engineering workflows (V-model, ASPICE) and mentor junior engineers in requirement linking and design coverage assessment.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, product integration, or technical lead roles within deep-tech industries (e.g., Energy Storage, Automotive, or Aerospace).

 - Deep knowledge across multiple disciplines, including electrical schematic analysis, power electronics, and embedded real-time software development.

 - Mastery of requirement management tools (e.g., Jama, Polarion, or DOORS) and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools such as Catia Magic or SysML.

 - Demonstrated experience with Battery Management Systems, including battery charging/discharging logic, thermal monitoring, and fault management strategies.

 - Strong command of the Systems Engineering V-model and familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or UL 1998).

 - Proven ability to conduct root-cause analysis for complex system-level failures and conduct detailed power and load budget analyses.

 - Exceptional technical communication skills with the ability to translate high-level product goals into actionable technical strategies for multidisciplinary teams.



#LI-Onsite



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer, San Francisco
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex’s corporate network needs to remain secure, reliable and scalable as our global footprint grows. You’ll own critical network infrastructure and help shape the systems, practices and team capabilities that support our people across regions.

 - Build the foundations of Airwallex’s corporate network and help shape the team structure and capabilities needed as we grow.

 - Design, deploy and maintain secure, highly available LAN, WAN, wireless and VPN infrastructure across our global offices and regions.

 - Design multi-region hybrid network patterns connecting physical offices, data centres and cloud environments, including AWS and Alibaba Cloud.

 - Configure and operate global connectivity across international leased lines and domestic internet connections, working across mixed-vendor environments.

 - Lead the configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and wireless access points.

 - Own CorpNet as a first responder and escalation point for complex network incidents, taking issues through to resolution and completing after-action reviews.

 - Partner with CorpSec, ProdSec, Engineering, Product, IT Engineering, Workplace and other teams to integrate network solutions and support business initiatives.

 - Work with IT Engineering and IT Support to troubleshoot endpoint network issues and build core networking capability across the team.

 - Use infrastructure-as-code and automation, including Terraform and Ansible, to improve network consistency and operational efficiency.

 - Develop and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations and operational procedures.

 - Evaluate networking technologies and solutions that support Airwallex’s continued growth.

 - Mentor and coach network engineers, share knowledge, support skill development, manage performance and help attract strong talent.

 - Participate in a global follow-the-sun on-call rotation for corporate networking issues, with occasional after-hours or weekend work for network upgrades where needed to minimise business disruption.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - Senior-level experience designing, implementing and maintaining Juniper and Palo Alto Networks solutions.

 - Demonstrated experience working in a global, multi-vendor networking environment, including technologies such as Juniper, Palo Alto, Cisco and Aruba.

 - Experience with networking solutions for mainland China and international connectivity.

 - Strong fundamentals in Wi-Fi technology and endpoint engineering; hardware experience is a plus, including Juniper Mist, Cisco Meraki or Aruba.

 - Expert command-line configuration skills across networking hardware and vendors, including JunOS and IOS.

 - Experience operating and troubleshooting complex corporate network environments.

 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

 - Ability to move quickly and make sound decisions with incomplete information when supporting a global business.


PREFERRED

 - Strong knowledge of Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect, Prisma and Prisma Cloud.

 - Experience managing or leading a team of network engineers, ideally in a startup or scaling environment.

 - A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, alongside five or more years of relevant experience.

 - Understanding of common identity standards, including SAML, OAuth and SSO.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, including AWS or GCP.

 - Understanding of RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, ACLs and common access-management principles in security and corporate IT environments.

 - Experience working with SaaS-based systems and applications.

 - Strong understanding of MDM systems across macOS and Windows, including Kandji, Jamf and Intune.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

jobs.title: Territory Account Executive, Philippines
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore

About the Department

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

About This Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of commercial accounts in the Philippines market. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Role Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Required Experience

• Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infranomics
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Infranomics team builds the software and data foundations that help OpenAI understand, plan, and improve the economics of its infrastructure. The team works across engineering and finance to make infrastructure spend visible, allocate capacity effectively, and improve efficiency as our products grow.

Our systems support the CPU, network, storage and GPU infrastructure behind products such as ChatGPT, the API, and Codex. We are expanding these foundations to connect resource usage, cost, forecasting, and planning so teams can make better decisions at scale.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Software Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and operation of systems for infrastructure cost and efficiency. You will build the platforms that explain where infrastructure spend goes, identify opportunities to improve utilization, and help teams plan the capacity they need.

We ideally want direct experience building and operating software for infrastructure economics, such as usage metering, cost attribution, resource efficiency, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity planning. You should have owned systems that connect compute, storage, or network consumption to cost and help teams make measurable efficiency and investment decisions.

You will set technical direction for a growing area while staying close to the code. Working with infrastructure engineers, product teams, finance, and leadership, you will turn ambiguous business and engineering problems into reliable software, shared data, and measurable improvements. This role offers substantial autonomy and the opportunity to shape how OpenAI manages its infrastructure investment.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. This is an on-site role.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Define the technical direction and roadmap for infrastructure cost and efficiency systems, and lead projects from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and ongoing operation.

 - Build billing, usage metering, and cost attribution systems that connect infrastructure spend to resources, workloads, services, and the teams that own them.

 - Develop data pipelines and shared data models that combine cloud billing, resource inventory, and utilization signals into a dependable view of cost and capacity.

 - Build tools for budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning that help teams anticipate demand, allocate resources, and inform procurement decisions.

 - Identify underutilized resources and other sources of waste, then partner with engineering teams to deliver and measure improvements while preserving performance and reliability.

 - Create APIs, reporting tools, and automated controls that help teams understand their consumption, manage budgets, and make informed infrastructure tradeoffs.

 - Provide technical leadership across teams, mentor engineers, and own the correctness, scalability, and production behavior of the systems you build.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have over 7 years of experience designing, building, and operating production software and distributed systems, with technical ownership across multiple teams or a significant infrastructure domain.

 - Have built systems for infrastructure efficiency, cloud cost attribution, usage metering, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity management, and can connect that work to measurable outcomes.

 - Remain a hands-on engineer who can move between architecture, implementation, debugging, and operational improvements.

 - Understand how compute, storage, and networking consumption translate into cost, and can reason about the tradeoffs among utilization, performance, reliability, and growth.

 - Care deeply about data correctness and can build trustworthy systems from complex billing and operational data.

 - Work effectively across engineering, finance, product, and leadership, translating broad goals into a clear plan and driving adoption without relying on formal authority.

 - Thrive with substantial autonomy, take ownership of loosely defined problems, and make pragmatic decisions as requirements evolve.

 - Have experience building internal platforms that give engineering teams visibility into cloud spend, resource utilization, and ownership.

 - Have experience developing batch or streaming data pipelines, financial data platforms, or large-scale analytics systems.

 - Have experience with Kubernetes, public cloud infrastructure, or resource management systems across cloud and on-premises environments.

 - Have experience automating resource allocation, cost allocation policies, budget tracking, or capacity forecasting.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: General Manager(02634) - 1500 N Wayne St
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically general managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance& punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tilebricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

18 Years Old

Valid Driver License

Open Availability

Additional Job DetailsStooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Scheduling Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

About the Role

Seen Health is looking for a highly organized and proactive Scheduling Coordinator to help ensure our participants receive timely access to care and services across our interdisciplinary team (IDT). This role coordinates internal scheduling across all internal visits, such as initial and bi-annual assessments, PCP and nurse visits, social work consults, and day center services, while serving as a key connector between our clinical and operational teams.

You'll be responsible for keeping participant schedules organized, resolving scheduling conflicts, and ensuring services are coordinated efficiently across teams. You'll work closely with members of Clinic, Guest Services, Transportation, and IDT teams to ensure participant needs are met and scheduling details don't fall through the cracks.

We're looking for someone who goes beyond simply filling calendar slots. You'll get the opportunity to identify gaps in scheduling workflows, speak up when processes aren't working, and help build better ways of coordinating care. The ideal candidate is energized by solving problems, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to continuously improve how we work.

Responsibilities

Participant Scheduling & Coordination

• Schedule internal services, including participant assessments, treatments, PCP visits, and Day Center attendance, ensuring schedules align with participant needs and care plans.

• Coordinate schedules across care settings, balancing participant needs, staff availability, and operational constraints to minimize conflicts and make efficient use of available resources.

• Schedule initial assessments and onboarding activities across multiple disciplines, including medical, therapy, social work, Day Center, and nursing. Identify transportation needs and coordinate with the Transportation Team to support a smooth onboarding experience.

• Monitor upcoming and outstanding scheduling needs, proactively following up with relevant teams to ensure participants receive timely care and required activities are completed on schedule.

• Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, last-minute cancellations, changes, and urgent scheduling needs to ensure continuity of care.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Act as a key point of contact for internal participant scheduling, helping coordinate services across the Clinic, Social Work, Home Care, Transportation, and Day Center teams.

• Ensure relevant teams have accurate, up-to-date information about participant schedules, changes, and outstanding scheduling needs.

• Work closely with clinical and operational teams to resolve scheduling barriers, clarify ownership, and ensure participants can access the services they need.

Process Improvement & Problem Solving

• Identify recurring scheduling bottlenecks and coordination challenges, working with relevant teams to address root causes.

• Help build and refine scheduling processes, tools, and tracking mechanisms to improve visibility, reduce manual follow-up, and support timely care delivery.

• Take ownership of complex or ambiguous scheduling challenges, collaborating across teams to find effective solutions rather than simply passing issues along.

Documentation & Administrative Support

• Enter and update participant schedules and related information in the EMR and other relevant systems, ensuring records are accurate and current.

• Track scheduled services and outstanding activities to help ensure required care and assessments are completed within applicable operational and regulatory timeframes.

• Adapt to the evolving needs of the PACE program and support additional scheduling-related tasks as needed.

Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in healthcare operations, medical scheduling, care coordination, or a related field.

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong time-management and organizational skills.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Traffic Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies.

Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7—from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing.

You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate.

This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds.

 - Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management.

 - Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation.

 - Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure.

 - Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action.

 - Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses.

 - Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts.

 - Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure.

 - Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing.

 - Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance.

 - Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure.

 - Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems.

 - Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution.

 - Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries.

 - Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it.

We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking layer listed above.

jobs.title: Business Development & Capture Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Technical Assent seeks an analytical, execution-oriented Business Development & Capture Manager to support federal growth through opportunity qualification, customer and market intelligence development, and capture execution.

This hybrid position combines two complementary responsibilities:

Business Development — approximately 40%: Lead the evaluation and qualification of identified federal opportunities, converting initial market intelligence and capability assessments into evidence-based Pursue/No Pursue recommendations.

Capture Management — approximately 60%: Support and independently execute assigned capture activities, including customer intelligence development, competitive analysis, teaming strategy, capture planning, and solution positioning.

The position works across Technical Assent's federal target markets, with an emphasis on VA, DoD, and DHS. Candidates should bring meaningful experience in either VA or DoD and demonstrate the ability to apply their knowledge across other agencies.

The successful candidate will combine disciplined analysis, federal market knowledge, strong execution skills, and practical AI proficiency.

We seek an individual who can rapidly investigate unfamiliar opportunities, distinguish fact from speculation, identify the information needed to make sound decisions, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

The Business Development & Capture Manager works closely with the Executive Team, Capture Manager, and Service Delivery leaders.

Primary Responsibilities

Business Development and Opportunity Qualification — 40%

• Receive opportunities identified through Technical Assent's market surveillance, forecasting, and initial capability-screening processes.

• Evaluate opportunities against Technical Assent's target markets, capabilities, acquisition eligibility, competitive positioning, and growth priorities.

• Research customer mission requirements, buying organizations, acquisition history, incumbent contractors, likely competitors, and procurement timelines.

• Identify relevant customer stakeholders and develop appropriate plans to obtain and validate customer intelligence.

• Assess existing customer access, partner relationships, and competitive barriers.

• Identify gaps in Technical Assent's capabilities, past performance, contract access, or competitive position.

• Develop preliminary win hypotheses and identify actions required to establish a credible pursuit.

• Prepare concise, evidence-based qualification briefs and Pursue/No Pursue recommendations.

• Coordinate task-based research and industry engagement assignments with Industry Development Advisors.

• Maintain accurate opportunity records, qualification evidence, risks, and decisions in monday.com.

• Support market and agency account planning in coordination with the CEO and designated account sponsors.

Capture Management — 60%

• Execute assigned capture workstreams under the direction of the lead Capture Manager.

• Develop customer profiles, stakeholder maps, competitive assessments, incumbent analyses, and intelligence registers.

• Support development and maintenance of capture plans, milestones, win themes, discriminators, and action plans.

• Research and assess prospective teaming partners against defined capture requirements.

• Coordinate partner outreach, teaming discussions, and capture-related follow-up activities.

• Collaborate with service delivery leaders to identify relevant technical capabilities, past performance, and solution evidence.

• Support capture readiness reviews and capture-to-proposal transition activities.

• Independently lead assigned pursuits when authorized, based on complexity, workload, and demonstrated readiness.

• Maintain accurate capture records and ensure assigned actions are completed on schedule.

• Contribute to win/loss assessments and continuous improvement of capture practices.

AI Proficiency and Professional Judgment

Technical Assent operates in an AI-enabled business environment. We expect every member of our Growth Team to use artificial intelligence thoughtfully and effectively to improve the speed, quality, and productivity of their work.

AI proficiency is a requirement, not a substitute for professional expertise or critical thinking. We do not accept unverified AI-generated content, generic analysis, fabricated evidence, superficial recommendations, or polished deliverables that lack substantive insight. Every employee remains personally accountable for the accuracy, reasoning, originality, and business value of their work, regardless of the tools used to produce it.

We expect the Business Development & Capture Manager to:

• Use AI to accelerate research and analysis while independently validating material facts and conclusions.

• Distinguish authoritative evidence from assumptions, inference, and unsupported AI-generated claims.

• Apply professional judgment to interpret information, challenge assumptions, and develop defensible recommendations.

• Produce concise, actionable work products that demonstrate genuine understanding of the customer, competitive environment, and business decision.

• Improve workflows through appropriate automation without compromising quality, confidentiality, or accountability.

• Explain and defend their analysis, recommendations, and decisions without relying on AI-generated narratives.

We measure the value of the thinking, not the volume of the output.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• Five or more years of federal business development, opportunity qualification, capture management, or closely related experience.

• Demonstrated experience researching and qualifying federal professional services opportunities.

• Meaningful federal market experience with VA or DoD and working knowledge of federal acquisition processes, competitive procurements, and government contracting markets.

• Ability to analyze customer requirements, incumbents, competitors, teaming options, and acquisition feasibility.

• Demonstrated experience contributing to capture plans, win strategies, competitive assessments, or successful federal pursuits.

• Familiarity with GovTribe, SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, USAspending.gov, and federal acquisition forecasts.

• Practical proficiency using AI-assisted research and analytical tools.

• Strong independent judgment, analytical reasoning, written communication, and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent assignments and work across agency boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with CRM and pipeline management systems.

• Experience using AI-enabled workflows to improve research, qualification, or capture productivity.

• Knowledge of federal management consulting, service design, customer experience, organizational transformation, business process improvement, modernization, change management, or program management.

THE COMPANY

Technical Assent is passionate about services –in government, business, and not-for-profit. We design exceptional service experiences, engineer them to be robust, and deliver real capability and business outcomes for our clients. You will be working on government programs that have strategic importance to our client. Your team will work IN and ON the client’s core mission –helping them to deliver their services day-to-day while simultaneously looking for opportunities to improve. Our work is Driven by Evidence, Grounded in Understanding, and Focused on Impact.

A LITTLE ABOUT OUR CULTURE

We look for these attributes in our teammates.

• Our team combines the creative and the pragmatic to deliver the results that matter most to our clients. We see beauty when art and science come together.

• We seek self-starters, people who are confident in tackling challenges independently and bringing this to high-performing teams. We continually seek feedback from our customers and employees, looking for opportunities to grow.

• We are a small company which gives you an essential voice in shaping our culture. You will help grow our culture, and you will grow from the experience, too.

You will be part of a team to take an improvement concept and transform it into a capability –an asset that provides measurable value to our client’s mission. The team will work with users, prototype, develop, and deliver new capabilities. We hold ourselves accountable to impacting outcomes.

Additional Information:
Come as you are - Technical Assent is committed to a workplace free of discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. Hiring decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We offer a highly competitive benefits package to all full-time employees that includes:

• Flexible PTO

• Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision)

• FSA and HSA

• Short and long-term disability

• 401(k) with employer contributions, training and wellness allowances, and commuter benefits.

• OneMedical primary care membership

• Charitable contribution matching

• Training, Education, and Certification stipend

jobs.title: Electronics Design Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT 

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems. 





JOB OVERVIEW

As an electronics design engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and integrating the low voltage electrical system within high-performance power converters to meet reliability, EMC, and safety requirements. You will define cabinet-level electrical architecture, manage harnessing and interconnects, and ensure proper distribution of power, signals, and control across subsystems. Your work will span the full product lifecycle—from concept development and component selection to schematic capture, validation, and support through production.  

 


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own the full hardware development lifecycle—from requirements definition and modeling through schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, testing, validation, and manufacturing support.

 - Define and implement the low voltage electrical architecture for cabinet-based systems, including cabinet microprocessors, power supplies, power distribution, interconnects, and signal processing and routing.

 - Select appropriate LV components such as microcontrollers, interface circuits, fuses, relays, contactors, terminal blocks, and power supplies based on system requirements and reliability targets.

 - Create system block diagrams, schematics, and harness documentation to support cross-functional development and manufacturing.

 - Ensure electrical interface integrity across PCBs, sensors, actuators, and communication buses (e.g., CAN, RS-485, Ethernet, LV analog/digital I/O).

 - Collaborate with mechanical teams on enclosure layout, cable routing, shielding, and grounding strategies for EMI/EMC performance.

 - Support validation and bring-up of LV systems during prototype and production builds, including DVT and integration testing.

 - Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards such as UL, CE, and IEC for low voltage systems.

 - Coordinate with firmware, test, and manufacturing teams to ensure proper system behavior, integration, and serviceability.




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We’re open to candidates with both mid and senior-career experience. Scope and responsibilities will scale with the right candidate.



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS 

 - Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

 - 2+ years of experience in low voltage electrical system design, including cabinet-level LV system architecture and component designs, ideally in energy, automotive, or industrial control applications.

 - Strong knowledge of cabinet-level LV power distribution and signal architecture.

 - Experience selecting and integrating LV components (relays, fuses, terminal blocks, etc.) for multi-voltage systems (e.g., 12V, 24V, 48V).

 - Familiarity with harness design, connector systems, and creating electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.

 - Understanding of EMC best practices and grounding/shielding techniques.

 - Proficiency with electrical CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

 - Hands-on experience with debugging, testing, and validating electrical systems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and similar tools.

 - Experience with manufacturing processes, including design for manufacturability (DFM), volume production, and development of manufacturing test procedures and test equipment.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with LV systems in high-voltage environments

 - Familiarity with fieldbus communication protocols like CAN or industrial ethernet.

 - Knowledge of control cabinet UL/IEC compliance and wire derating, spacing, and thermal considerations.

 - Experience in creating wiring harnesses and managing cable assemblies with third-party suppliers.

 - Exposure to cross-functional design with firmware and mechanical engineering teams.

 - Experience with failure mode analysis and root cause investigations of LV electrical systems.

 - Knowledge of safety-critical system design, including interlocks and redundant controls.

 

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power. 

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The base salary for this role ranges from $110,000 to $130,000 per year.

jobs.title: Network Infrastructure Engineer, Global Network Infra (WAN)
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Global Network Infrastructure team is responsible for building and operating the global network backbone that connects our rapidly expanding compute infrastructure. Our work enables reliable, high-performance connectivity across data centers, cloud service providers, and network points of presence (PoPs), supporting the infrastructure behind OpenAI's research and products.

As OpenAI continues to scale its compute footprint globally, we are expanding our network infrastructure to meet increasing demands for capacity, reliability, and operational efficiency. Our team works across physical network design, carrier connectivity, network deployment, and operational troubleshooting to deliver resilient infrastructure at exceptional scale.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Network Infrastructure Engineer to help design, deploy, activate, and operate OpenAI's global wide area network (WAN) infrastructure.

In this role, you will take direct ownership of bringing new network connectivity online, working closely with fiber providers, cloud service providers, and internal infrastructure teams to establish reliable connectivity across our global backbone.

You will be involved in everything from physical network design and circuit provisioning to troubleshooting complex connectivity issues across Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3. You will play a critical role in expanding our network footprint, bringing new PoPs online, and ensuring that our infrastructure operates reliably as OpenAI continues to grow.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the infrastructure, thrive on solving difficult networking problems, and bring an automation-first mindset to scaling network operations.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Design, deploy, and support WAN infrastructure across data centers, network PoPs, and cloud connectivity environments.

 - Own the end-to-end activation and turn-up of network circuits, working directly with fiber carriers and cloud service providers to establish and validate connectivity.

 - Troubleshoot complex network issues across physical, Layer 2, and Layer 3 infrastructure, including optical signal problems, FEC errors, routing issues, and connectivity failures.

 - Diagnose and isolate network failures across carrier, cloud provider, and internal infrastructure boundaries, driving issues through resolution.

 - Contribute to physical network infrastructure design, including port mappings, fiber and cable layouts, optical distribution frames (ODFs), and connectivity planning.

 - Monitor network health, circuit utilization, and performance to proactively identify capacity constraints and reliability risks.

 - Build automation and tooling to streamline network provisioning, deployment validation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows.

 - Collaborate with network engineering, data center infrastructure, and external service providers to support the expansion of OpenAI's global backbone.

 - Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain the reliability and availability of critical network infrastructure.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Have hands-on experience deploying, activating, and troubleshooting WAN circuits with telecommunications carriers, fiber providers, or cloud service providers.

 - Have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including optical networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, BGP, and Layer 2/3 connectivity.

 - Are comfortable debugging network issues across multiple layers, from physical fiber connectivity and optical errors to routing and traffic forwarding.

 - Have experience working with data center networking, carrier infrastructure, cloud interconnects, or large-scale WAN environments.

 - Understand physical network infrastructure concepts such as fiber cabling, port mappings, optical distribution frames, and network equipment connectivity.

 - Can independently investigate ambiguous connectivity problems, isolate root causes, and work across internal and external teams to restore service.

 - Thrive in a fast-moving environment where infrastructure requirements evolve rapidly and engineering decisions have a direct impact on global scale.

 - Experience building or operating large-scale backbone networks, hyperscale data center networks, or cloud provider interconnect infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with optical transport technologies, network telemetry, and advanced troubleshooting of physical network links.

jobs.title: Business Manager – AI
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Business Manager – AI to lead the development and growth of artificial intelligence and predictive intelligence solutions within our Industrial Asset Intelligence business.

Working closely with the General Manager you will connect AI, data, software, robotics, sensing and automation capabilities to solve real industrial challenges. You will guide priority initiatives from customer discovery and solution design through to pilot, validation, deployment, adoption and commercial scale.

This is a senior role for a practical technology leader who can balance innovation with safety, governance, reliability and commercial value. You will help shape our AI roadmap, build scalable customer offerings and support the transition from point-in-time inspection to continuous monitoring, predictive maintenance and predictive assurance.

Key Responsibilities but not limited to:

• Develop and maintain a commercially focused AI, data and predictive intelligence roadmap aligned with customer needs and business priorities.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams through discovery, solution architecture, development, pilot, validation, deployment and ongoing support.
• Translate operational and asset-management challenges into practical, secure and scalable AI-enabled solutions.
• Build predictive asset intelligence capabilities using inspection, sensor, operational, engineering and historical data.
• Establish clear stage gates and provide evidence-based recommendations on whether initiatives should stop, pivot, proceed or scale.
• Partner with business and commercial leaders to turn proven capabilities into repeatable offerings, paid pilots, proposals and sustainable revenue opportunities.
• Support AI use cases and business cases for the Network Operations Centre, Sovereign Data Centre and broader Digital Trust Chain.
• Set fit-for-purpose standards for AI governance, model validation, monitoring, cybersecurity, data use, human oversight and lifecycle management.
• Build collaboration across AI, data, software, robotics, sensing, engineering, operational technology and commercial teams.
• Identify capability gaps and recommend recruitment, development, partnership, technology investment or acquisition strategies.

About You

You are a strategic and hands-on leader who understands both the potential and the practical realities of deploying AI in complex industrial environments. You can communicate with executives, customers, engineers, technical specialists and field teams, turning complex concepts into clear operational and commercial decisions.

To be successful, you will bring:

• Senior leadership experience across AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, data, software, automation or related digital technologies.
• A strong record of taking complex technology solutions from concept into production, adoption and measurable business or customer outcomes.
• Experience in asset-intensive sectors such as industrial services, infrastructure, energy, water, utilities or resources.
• Commercialisation experience covering customer discovery, business cases, pilots, pricing, service design and scalable offerings.
• Strong technical judgement across AI/ML, data engineering, software architecture, systems integration, automation and model lifecycle management.
• Knowledge of contemporary AI applications, including predictive modelling, anomaly detection, computer vision, deep learning, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents.
• An understanding of cloud, edge and on-premises architectures, including data sovereignty, cybersecurity, connectivity, scalability and whole-of-life cost.
• A current driver’s licence and the willingness and ability to travel regularly.
• Relevant tertiary qualifications are highly desirable, although substantial experience in industrial technology, AI, data or automation may be considered.

Why Join SGS?

This is an opportunity to shape how AI, predictive intelligence and automation are applied across real-world industrial operations. You will work with specialist teams and established businesses to create trusted solutions that improve safety, reliability, decision-making and asset performance while developing differentiated services for customers across Australia and the wider SGS network.

If you are ready to combine ambitious thinking with disciplined delivery and measurable commercial outcomes, we encourage you to apply.

Working at SGS means joining an innovative, Global company. Here are some of the benefits to working for SGS.

•    As a company, we have embraced the shift to flexible work

•    Sustainability is embedded in our culture and the way we do business

•    Paid parental leave

•    Paid time for volunteering day and blood donations

•    Corporate health & wellbeing offers

•    Ongoing learning & development

•    Career development opportunities (Nationally and Globally)

•    SGS Rewards: Our employee benefits platform with access to retail and online discounts and cashback

COME TO WORK AND BE 100% YOU

SGS Australia supports a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities, and cultures – including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people living with disability. Providing employment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people is an important part of our SGS Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP). We truly believe the diversity among us will continue to foster a strong, innovative, and forward-thinking workplace.

SGS Australia acknowledges and pays respect to the past, present and future Traditional Custodians and Elders of this nation and the continuation of cultural, spiritual, and educational practices of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

jobs.title: Summer Camp Director, TEST 2027
jobs.description:
Galileo is looking for an experienced leader to join our team as a Camp Director. Camp Directors lead our dynamic summer camps for K–8th grade, serving as both site General Manager and the public face of the organization.

You will open and operate a Camp Galileo location serving campers and their families within your community! You will lead a dynamic seasonal team of educators as well as enthusiastic entry-level staff to create joyful, safe environments and ensure smooth daily operations. With a focus on exceptional camper and family experiences, you will uphold program quality, foster creativity, and deliver excellence in customer care, curriculum, and team leadership.

Why This Role Matters

Galileo started in 2002 with a single summer camp in Palo Alto, named for Galileo Galilei, one of history’s great innovators. Today we run 90+ sites across eight states, and Camp Directors are still the people who give each camp its own traditions and magic. Our mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world, and at camp, you’re the one who makes that real for campers, families, and staff every day.

You will be Accountable for

Bringing Galileo’s Spirit to Life

• Infuse camp with joy, tradition, and creativity

• Build an inclusive environment where every camper, staff member, and family feels seen, supported, and inspired

Leading with Ownership and Vision

• Own every aspect of your camp’s launch, from preseason planning through end-of-summer wrap-up

• As both operational lead and culture builder, oversee every detail from daily camp operations to parent communication while delivering an exceptional program

Keeping Camp Safe and Running Smoothly

• Prioritize camper safety, family trust, and program fidelity at all times

• Anticipate needs, adapt quickly, and problem-solve on the fly so camp runs seamlessly, even when things don’t go as planned

Developing and Managing Your Team

• Train and mentor a staff of 7 to 40 (depending on site size), including educators and entry-level staff, while actively building your team culture

• Provide clear expectations for instructional and program standards, ongoing feedback, and professional development

• Own core management responsibilities such as training support, scheduling, payroll, and ongoing performance management

Embracing Challenge and Innovation

• Use the Galileo Innovation Approach (GIA) to encourage curiosity and problem-solving

• Lead your team in turning challenges into opportunities, keeping both spirit and operations aligned to Galileo’s mission

• Communicate openly with your Field Program Manager, seek out feedback, and turn it into action

• Take ownership of your own professional development, staying self-motivated to learn, grow, and improve throughout the summer

Building Strong Partnerships

• Serve as the primary face of camp within the community

• Communicate proactively with families, facilities partners, and cross-functional teams

• Collaborate with your Field Program Manager and cultivate trust with community partners, staff, and campers

Location & Work Schedule:

This is a seasonal role running March–September 2027, with a schedule divided into three phases. Exact dates will vary based on hire date and specific site operating dates:

• Phase One: Training & Prep (March–June): 5 to 15 hours per week, depending on tenure and start date — mostly flexible and remote, with some required scheduled and in-person commitments. This phase includes in-person training(s), a Bay Area retreat, scheduled virtual training(s), marketing events, and on-site prep at your camp location during the week leading up to camp. Some events may take place during evenings and weekends.

• Phase Two: On-Site (June–August): On-site hours typically range from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM (M-F), up to 50 hours per week over 5–8 weeks, depending on camp placement.

• Phase Three: Wrap-Up (Aug–Sept): Up to 5 hrs total, remote, for final admin tasks and staff reviews.

Compensation:

(Year 1 estimate):

• Preseason (Feb–June): Earn hourly pay ($22-24/hour) for flexible, part-time prep and training

• Camp Season (June–Aug): Transition to a weekly salary ($1,400/week plus an additional $50/week for each year of returning tenure in this role) as a full-time, exempt Camp Director during summer operations

• Postseason (Aug–Sept): Wrap up with light part-time work, paid hourly ($22-24/hour)

• Bonus/Commission: Earn an additional $1 per camper-week enrollment, plus potential commission for add-on weeks

Exact compensation may vary and will be based on multiple factors, including geography and Galileo camp director tenure. Our pay practices are guided by a commitment to equity and informed by market benchmarking and internal audits to minimize bias and ensure fairness across all roles.

Perks:

• Free camp for your child(ren) or two giftable weeks (incl. extended care)

• 15% Friends & Family discount

• Priority nomination for financial assistance for someone you know

• 3+ years of experience working directly with students in an education setting (out-of-school time, teaching, education administration, camps/recreation, etc.) is required

• Minimum 1 year of experience managing or supervising adult staff is required

• Proven experience creating safe, inclusive environments for children and building trust with families

• Proven experience setting clear expectations, giving ongoing feedback, and coaching staff to improve

• Demonstrated ability to manage operational details like scheduling, staffing, and payroll

• Track record of staying calm and making sound decisions in fast-paced situations, including safety issues and challenging conversations with families

• Strong written and verbal communication with families, partners, and supervisors

• Experience with hands-on, project-based learning (STEAM, art, design, maker programs) is a plus

• Availability for part-time remote work starting Feb 2026, and full-time on-site work starting June 2026 (dates vary by location)

• Willingness to travel in the region to up to 3 in person marketing events, in the preseason

• Ability to complete all required training before camp begins

• Ability to meet state requirements to work with children, including mandated screenings and Adult & Child First Aid/CPR/AED certification

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.

Additional Information

Please note that our job descriptions are a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks, and duties.

We comply with the ADA and provide reasonable accommodations that allow qualified applicants/employees to perform the essential functions of the job. To request an accommodation, contact our Human Resources team.

During the onboarding process, in accordance with applicable local and state requirements, you may be required to complete a Tuberculosis (TB)
